qe: What is 'Amalgam'?
qh: 'अमलगम' (Amalgam) क्या है?
e: Amalgam wo mishradhatu (alloy) hoti hai jismein ek ya adhik dhaatuon ke saath paara (mercury) mila hota hai; ismein paara mukhya hissa hota hai, isliye ye sadharan mishradhatu se alag pehchaani jaati hai. Paara kamre ke tapman par drav rehta hai tatha kai dhaatuon ko aasaani se ghula leta hai, isliye dant bharne (dental filling), purane mirror tatha sone-chaandi ke sikka (coin) banane mein iska istemal hua karta tha. Iske ulat peetal (brass, tamba+zinc), kansa (bronze, tamba+tin) tatha steel mein paara bilkul nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: paara (mercury) wali mishradhatu ko amalgam kehte hain - dant bharne mein istemal hone wala mishran isi ka udaharan hai.

qe: Which refining process is used to obtain 'Ultra-pure' Semiconductors like Silicon and Germanium?
qh: सिलिकॉन और जर्मेनियम जैसे 'अति-शुद्ध' अर्धचालक प्राप्त करने के लिए किस शोधन प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Zone refining wo vidhi hai jismein dhaatu ya ardh-chaalak kalai ki ek lambi dandi par chipka kar ek chhote garam kshetra (zone) ko dheere-dheere upar se niche ya niche se upar chalaya jaata hai; ashudhiyaan drav zone ke saath bah jaati hain tatha dandi ke ek sire par jama ho jaati hain. Isi karan isse 99.999% se bhi shudh silicon tatha germanium milte hain, jo electronik chips tatha transistor banane ke liye zaroori hain; iske ulat Mond ya Van Arkel vidhi dhaatuon (nickel, titanium) ke liye hoti hai. Iske ulat Bayers vidhi alumina ke liye tatha froth flotation ashuddhi hatane ke liye hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ultra-pure semiconductor (silicon tatha germanium) paane ke liye zone refining vidhi istemal hoti hai, jo drav zone ke saath ashuddhi ko hata deti hai.

qe: The 'Mond Process' is specifically used for the extraction and refining of which metal?
qh: 'मॉन्ड प्रक्रम' (Mond Process) का उपयोग विशेष रूप से किस धातु के निष्कर्षण और शोधन के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Mond vidhi mein nikel ki ashuddh dhaatu ko carbon monoxide (CO) gas ke saath lagbhag 50 degree C par kriya karaai jaati hai, jisse nikal carbonyl (Ni(CO)4) naam ki vaaspasheel (volatile) raashi banti hai; ushe aage garam karke 180 degree C par todne par shudh nikal milta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki nikal carbonyl asaadharan roop se aasaani se banta tatha banta hai tatha vaasp ke roop mein bah jata hai, isliye ise aasaani se alag kiya ja sakta hai - yahi Mond vidhi ka khaas gun hai. Iske ulat tamba, loha ya sone ki aisi vaaspasheel carbonyl nahi bante, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Mond vidhi nikel ke nishkarshan tatha shuddhikaran ke liye vishesh roop se istemal hoti hai (nikal carbonyl ke zariye).

qe: Which method is used for the refining of Zirconium (Zr) and Titanium (Ti)?
qh: ज़िरकोनियम (Zr) और टाइटेनियम (Ti) के शोधन के लिए किस विधि का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Van Arkel vidhi mein Zr tatha Ti jaisi dhaatu ko iodine ke saath garam karke unka vaaspasheel iodide banaya jaata hai; ushe alag kamre mein tungsten ke taar par lagbhag 1400 degree C par todne par atyant shudh dhaatu milti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki in dhaatuon ka iodide aasaani se banta tatha ek saaf kamre mein tootta hai, isliye ye ashudhiyaan peeche chhod deta hai - isi se bhaRiy arab (nuclear) tatha hawai jahaz ke kaam ke liye shudh dhaatu milti hai. Iske ulat zone refining ardh-chaalak ke liye tatha liquation tin-sisa ke liye istemal hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: zirconium tatha titanium ke shuddhikaran ke liye Van Arkel vidhi (iodide vidhi) istemal hoti hai, jo vaaspasheel iodide se shudh dhaatu deti hai.

qe: What is the chemical formula of 'Rust'?
qh: 'जंग' (Rust) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: Rust (loha mein jang) ka rasayanik sutra Fe2O3.xH2O hota hai; yani jang mukhya roop se hydrated iron(III) oxide hota hai, jismein loha ki oxidation se bana oxide paani ke anuon ke saath juda rehta hai. Yahi karan hai ki nami wali hawa mein loha jaldi kharab hota hai, kyunki paani tatha oxygen dono mil kar ushe oxide (jang) mein badal dete hain tatha dhaatu kamzor ho jaati hai. Iske ulat Fe3O4 (magnetite, jo jang se alag kaala oxide hai) tatha FeO (ferrous oxide) ke sutra is prashn ke uttar nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: jang (rust) ka sutra Fe2O3.xH2O hota hai - yahi hydrated iron oxide hai jo loha ko kharab karta hai.

qe: Which 'Allotrope' of Phosphorus is the most reactive and glows in the dark (Chemiluminescence)?
qh: फास्फोरस का कौन सा 'अपररूप' सबसे अधिक क्रियाशील है और अंधेरे में चमकता है?
e: White phosphorus ko shvet phosphorus bhi kehte hain tatha yahi phosphorus ka sabse kriya-sheel (reactive) pratyaroop (allotrope) hota hai; iski sajaavat tetrahedral (P4) hoti hai tatha iske bandhan tani huye (strained) hote hain, isliye ye aasaani se oxygen se kriya karta hai aur hawa mein halka hara-neela chamak deta hai. Isi karan ise andhere mein rakhkar dikhane par ye roshni chhodta hai (chemiluminescence) tatha hawa mein rakhne par bhadak uthta hai; iske ulat red phosphorus zyada sthir hota hai tatha match banane mein istemal hota hai. Iske ulat black phosphorus sabse sthir tatha kam kriya-sheel hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: white phosphorus sabse kriya-sheel phosphorus pratyaroop hai jo andherak mein chamakta hai (chemiluminescence) tatha isliye ushe paani ke andar rakha jaata hai.

qe: The 'Contact Process' is used for the industrial production of which acid?
qh: 'संपर्क प्रक्रम' (Contact Process) का उपयोग किस अम्ल के औद्योगिक उत्पादन के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Contact (kontakt) vidhi mein sulfur dioxide (SO2) tatha hawa ki oxygen, V2O5 utprek (catalyst) ki upasthiti mein 400-450 degree C par mil kar sulfur trioxide (SO3) banate hain; SO3 ko paani mein ghulane par sulfuric acid (H2SO4) milta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki utprek tatha niyantrit tapman se abhikriya tez tatha poori chalti hai, isliye yahi H2SO4 banane ki mukhya audyogik vidhi hai - duniya mein sabse adhik banne wala aml yahi hai. Iske ulat haber vidhi ammonia ke liye tatha ostwald vidhi nitric acid ke liye hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sulfuric acid (H2SO4) ke audyogik utpadan ki Contact vidhi hai, jismein SO2 ko V2O5 utprek par SO3 mein badla jaata hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in the 'Vulcanization' of rubber to give it elasticity and strength?
qh: रबर को लोच और मजबूती देने के लिए उसके 'वल्कनीकरण' (Vulcanization) में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sulfur wo non-metal hai jise praakritik rabar ke saath garam karne par rabar ki long-chain anuon ke beech 'sulfur ke pul' (cross links) ban jaate hain; isse rabar ki sathirta, lachak tatha majbooti badh jaati hai tatha wo garmi mein naram nahi padta. Yahi kriya 'vulcanization' kehlati hai tatha tyre, sole tatha anya rabar utpadon mein yahi sulfur ka istemal hota hai; iske ulat phosphorus, nitrogen tatha carbon ye kaam nahi karte. Isi gun se rabar ka istemal mausam ki marammat tatha khelon mein bhi hota hai. Exam point: rabar ke vulcanization (garmi tatha khinchav ko sahne wali banane) ke liye sulfur non-metal ka istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Anodizing'?
qh: 'एनोडीकरण' (Anodizing) क्या है?
o: Forming a thick oxide layer on Aluminum
e: Anodizing ek vidyut-rasayanik (electrochemical) kriya hai jismein aluminium ko vidyut ke dhan chor (anode) ka bana kar uski satah par oxide ki moti tatha sthir parat chadhai jaati hai; isse aluminium ka rang taaza rehta hai tatha wo jang (corrosion) se bach jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aluminium par oxide ki ye parat r ndh (holes) wali hoti hai tatha usme rang bhi bhara ja sakta hai, isliye rango wale aluminium ke taambe (frames), bartan tatha hawai jahaz ke hisse isi vidhi se bante hain. Iske ulat plating (jaise chromium chadhana) mein anya dhaatu ki parat banti hai, oxide ki nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: anodizing mein aluminium par oxide ki moti tatha rakshak parat banai jaati hai - isi karan ye skhalan (corrosion) tatha rang khone se bachata hai.

qe: Which metal is the 'Main Constituent' of the alloy Duralumin?
qh: मिश्र धातु ड्यूरालिन (Duralumin) का 'मुख्य घटक' कौन सी धातु है?
e: Duralumin ek mishradhatu hai jismein mukhya hissa aluminium ka hota hai tatha uske saath tamba (copper), magnesium tatha manganese thoda-thoda mila hote hain; iska anupat is tarah hota hai ki halkapan tatha majbooti dono saath milein. Isi karan ise hawai jahaz ke dhaanche, rail ke dabbe tatha sipahi (vehicles) ke hisson mein istemal karte hain, kyunki iska ghanatva kam hone par bhi loha jitni majbooti deta hai. Iske ulat peetal tatha kansa mein aluminium nahi hota (wahan tamba mukhya hota hai), isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: duralumin mishradhatu ka mukhya tatva aluminium hota hai - iske saath copper, magnesium tatha manganese milaakar halki tatha majboot dhaatu banti hai.

qe: The 'Self-reduction' process is typically used for the extraction of which metal?
qh: 'स्व-अपचयन' (Self-reduction) प्रक्रिया का उपयोग आमतौर पर किस धातु के निष्कर्षण के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Self-reduction (sw-avkaran) wo vidhi hai jismein dhaatu ke sulfidic ayask (ore, jaise copper pyrites) ko siraf garam karne par usi ayask ka sulfur oxygen ke saath mil kar oxide ban jaata hai tatha bacha hua sulfide us oxide ko dhaatu mein badal deta hai - yani bahari reducer ki zaroorat nahi padti. Isi karan tamba (copper) ke nishkarshan mein ye vidhi bahut upyogi hai, kyunki tamba ke ayask mein sulfur tatha loha dono hote hain tatha sulfur khud hi kanghi ka kaam kar deta hai. Iske ulat aluminium tatha sODium ke liye vidyut apghatan (electrolysis) chahiye, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: copper ke nishkarshan mein self-reduction vidhi istemal hoti hai - ismein ayask ka hi sulfur kanghi (reducer) ka kaam karta hai.

qe: What is 'Flowers of Sulfur'?
qh: 'सल्फर के फूल' (Flowers of Sulfur) क्या है?
o: Fine powder of Sulfur obtained by sublimation
e: Flowers of sulfur wo baareek peela choora (powder) hai jo sulfur ki bhaap (vaasp) ko thanda karne par milta hai - yani ye sublimation dwara praapt sulfur hota hai; iske ulat sulfur ka drav (molten) roop alag hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sulfur garam hone par seedha bhaap ban jaata hai tatha thanda hone par baareek powder ke roop mein jama hota hai, isliye ise 'flowers' (phool jaisa) kaha jaata hai; isi se sulfur ke oushadh tatha dawa banti hain. Iske ulat sulfur ke crystalline roop (jaise rhombic tatha monoclinic) alag pratyaroop hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: flowers of sulfur sulfur ka wo baareek choora hai jo sublimation se milta hai - isi liye iska rang peela tatha roop phool jaisa hota hai.

qe: Which 'Alloy' is used in making surgical instruments?
qh: सर्जिकल उपकरण बनाने में किस 'मिश्र धातु' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Stainless steel ek mishradhatu hai jismein loha ke saath chromium (lagbhag 18 pratishat) tatha nikal (8 pratishat) mila hota hai; chromium satah par oxide ki patli parat bana deta hai, isliye ye jang (corrosion) nahi lagta tatha jivanu-janit (sterile) rakhna aasan hota hai. Isi karan shaly-chikitsa (surgery) ke auzaar, chhuri, tatha aspataal ke bade bartan isi dhaatu se bante hain, kyunki inhe baar-baar garam karke jivanu-mukt kiya ja sakta hai. Iske ulat peetal tatha kansa mein chromium nahi hota tatha wo khane ke saath kriya kar sakte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: shaly-chikitsa ke auzaar banane ke liye stainless steel (loha + chromium + nikal) mishradhatu istemal hoti hai, kyunki ye jang tatha jivanuon se surakshit rehti hai.

qe: Which chemical is known as 'Quicksilver'?
qh: किस रसायन को 'क्विकसिल्वर' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Paara (mercury) ko 'quicksilver' (chaalaki chandi) kehte hain, kyunki ye sadharan tapman par drav rehta hai tatha bahut tez chalda (flows fast) chandi jaisa chamakdar dikhta hai. Yahi karan hai ki purane thermometer, barometer tatha bijli ke switch mein paara bhara jaata tha; par iski bhaap zehirili hoti hai, isliye aaj iska istemal kam kiya ja raha hai. Iske ulat sone (gold), chandi (silver) tatha tamba (copper) sabhi thos hote hain tatha unhe quicksilver nahi kehte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: quicksilver ka naam paara (mercury) ka hai - yahi ekmatr sadharan tapman par drav dhaatu hai tatha isi karan chaalaki lagti hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in 'Safety Matches'?
qh: 'सुरक्षा माचिस' में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Safety match (surakshit tili) ke moO par lal (red) phosphorus tatha aksidkarak (oxidizing agent) tatha gandhak (sulfur) ki parat hoti hai, jabki match box ki satah par thodi lal phosphorus tatha kaanch ka choora hota hai - ragadne par ye garam hokar aag pakadta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki lal phosphorus peele (white) phosphorus se bahut kam kriya-sheel tatha ze hirile hota hai, isliye tili bina ragade jal nahi sakti tatha bachche ke haath mein bhi surakshit rehti hai. Iske ulat white phosphorus hawa mein khud jal uthta hai (isliye wo vikalp galat hai) tatha kaala phosphorus san-sheel (inert) hota hai. Exam point: safety matches mein lal (red) phosphorus ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye sthir tatha kam zehirila hota hai tatha ragadne par hi aag deta hai.

qe: The process of 'Liquation' is used for refining metals with:
qh: 'द्रवगलन' (Liquation) की प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किन धातुओं के शोधन के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Liquation vidhi un dhaatuon ke shuddhikaran ke liye istemal hoti hai jinka galaank (melting point) kam hota hai tatha jo aasaani se pighal jaate hain; ismein ashuddh dhaatu ko dhalte hue tapti (inclined) satah par garam kiya jaata hai, isse shuddh dhaatu pehle pighal kar bah jaati hai tatha ashudhiyaan peeche reh jaati hain. Isi karan tin (tin) tatha sisa (lead) jaisi dhaatuon ke shuddhikaran ke liye yahi vidhi upyukt hai, kyunki unka galaank itna kam hota hai ki pighalne par unhe alag karna aasaan ho jaata hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha loha jaise uchch galaank wale dhaatuon ke liye yahi vidhi nahi chalti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: liquation vidhi kam galaank wali dhaatuon (tin tatha lead) ke shuddhikaran ke liye istemal hoti hai.

qe: Which gas is released when 'Aluminum' reacts with Sodium Hydroxide ($NaOH$)?
qh: जब 'एल्यूमीनियम' सोडियम हाइड्रोक्साइड ($NaOH$) के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करता है तो कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Aluminium par kshaar (NaOH) ka ghol daalne par dhaatu ki satah par bani oxide ki parat toot kar aluminium sodium aluminate banata hai tatha is kriya ke dauran hydrogen (H2) gas ke bulble nikalte hain; isi liye aluminium par NaOH ya gaahni (drain cleaner) daalna khatarnaak hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aluminium aik aml (acid) tatha kshaar dono se kriya karne wali dhaatu hai, isliye ye ghar ki safai wale padarthon se bhi kharab ho jaati hai; iske ulat NaOH ko aluminium ke sandas mein rakhna gas tatha ushma paida karta hai. Iske ulat oxygen ya chlorine gas is kriya mein nahi nikalti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium tatha NaOH ki kriya se hydrogen gas nikalta hai - isi karan aluminium par kshaar daalna khatarnaak hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Flux' used in the extraction of Copper to remove Iron oxide ($FeO$)?
qh: कॉपर के निष्कर्षण में आयरन ऑक्साइड ($FeO$) को हटाने के लिए किस 'गालक' (Flux) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Tamba (copper) ke nishkarshan mein ayask ko garam karne par FeO (iron oxide) banata hai, jise hatane ke liye silica (SiO2) ko flux ke roop mein milaya jaata hai; silica FeO ke saath milkar iron silicate (dhaatu-pachhi) banata hai jo halka hokar upar tair jaata hai tatha aasaani se hata diya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki flux ka kaam ashuddhi ko ek aisi padarth mein badalna hai jo dhaatu se aasaani se alag ho jaaye; isi karan smelting ke samay flux ka sahi chunav bahut zaroori hota hai. Iske ulat choona (limestone) tatha sodium carbonate silica ke saath flux ka kaam nahi karte (wo acidic ashuddhi ke liye hote hain), isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: copper ke nishkarshan mein FeO hatane ke liye silica (SiO2) flux istemal hota hai - yahi FeO ke saath milkar halka dhaatu-pachhi banata hai.

qe: Which 'Alloy' is used to make coins and is composed of Copper and Nickel?
qh: सिक्के बनाने के लिए इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली मिश्र धातु कौन सी है जो कॉपर और निकेल से बनी होती है?
e: Cupro-nickel ek mishradhatu hai jismein mukhya roop se tamba (copper) tatha nikal hota hai; ise sikka (coin) banane ke liye isliye istemal karte hain kyunki ye mazboot hota hai, ghisne par kam ghista hai tatha sadharan hawa mein jald jang nahi lagta. Iska karan yahi hai ki sikkon ki talaab (surface) par ungliyon ke pasine ka kam asar hota hai, isliye sikka lamba chalta hai tatha uski chamak bani rehti hai; isi karan bharat tatha kai deshon ke sikka isi mishradhatu ke bane hote hain. Iske ulat peetal (tamba + zinc) tatha kansa (tamba + tin) ke gun sikka ke liye upyukt nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sikka banane wali mishradhatu cupro-nickel hoti hai, jismein tamba tatha nikal hote hain - yahi jang-rahit tatha tal-harit dhaatu hai.

qe: What is 'Dead Burnt Plaster'?
qh: 'मृत दग्ध प्लास्टर' (Dead Burnt Plaster) क्या है?
e: Dead burnt plaster wo jalaa hua plaster hota hai jismein paani ka poora hissa nikal jaata hai, isliye uska rasayanik naam anhydrous calcium sulfate (CaSO4) hota hai; iska matlab yahi hai ki usmein koi krystal-paani (water of crystallization) nahi bachti. Iska ek khaas gun yahi hai ki ye jald sakht nahi hota (isliye 'dead' kaha jaata hai), isliye ise gharon ki dhaanche wali plaster tatha bartanon (moulds) mein istemal karte hain, jahan jaldi jamna nuksan karta hai. Iske ulat plaster of Paris (CaSO4.1/2H2O) usse alag hota hai jo paani ke saath jald sakht ho jaata hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dead burnt plaster chemically anhydrous calcium sulfate (CaSO4) hota hai - ismein krystal-paani nahi hoti tatha isi karan ye der se sakht hota hai.

qe: Which 'Metal' is used in the 'Photoelectric Cell' because it emits electrons easily when exposed to light?
qh: 'प्रकाश-विद्युत सेल' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने पर आसानी से इलेक्ट्रॉनों का उत्सर्जन करती है?
e: Photo-electric cell (prakash-vidyut koshika) mein cesium dhaatu ka istemal hota hai, kyunki cesium ke bahari kosh mein electron bahut dheela bandha hota hai tatha roshni padne par wo aasaani se nikal jaata hai - is gun ko photoelectric effect kehte hain. Isi karan cesium se bane cell roshni ki matara ke saath vidyut paida karte hain, jo solar detector, automatic darwaze tatha camera ke light-meter mein kaam aate hain; iske ulat tamba tatha loha electrons itni aasaani se nahi chhodte. Iske ulat photoelectric cell ke liye rubidium bhi upyukt hai, par cesium sabse sanvedansheel maana jaata hai. Exam point: photoelectric cell mein cesium dhaatu ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye roshni padne par aasaani se electron chhod kar bijli paida karti hai.

qe: The 'Pitting Corrosion' is most commonly seen in which material?
qh: 'पिटिंग जंग' (Pitting Corrosion) सबसे अधिक किस सामग्री में देखी जाती है?
e: Pitting corrosion ek sthanik (localized) jang hai jismein dhaatu ki satah par chhote-chhote gaadhe (pits) ban jaate hain; ye khaas taur par stainless steel mein dikhta hai, kyunki kisi ek sthan par chromium ki rakshak oxide parat toot jaati hai tatha wahan gaadha banta jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki chloride (jaise namak ke paani) ki upasthiti mein ye parat kamzor pad jaati hai tatha gaadhe ke bheetar oxygen nahi pahunchta, isliye wahan jang tez hoti hai - isi karan samundar ke paas stainless steel bhi kharab hota hai. Iske ulat aluminium par aisi gaadhe nahi bante, wahan satah par failne wali jang hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pitting corrosion mukhya roop se stainless steel mein dikhti hai, khanas taur par salt (chloride) wale paani mein uski rakshak parat tootne se.

qe: Which of the following is considered a 'Noble Metal' due to its resistance to oxidation and corrosion?
qh: ऑक्सीकरण और जंग के प्रति अपने प्रतिरोध के कारण निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'उत्कृष्ट धातु' माना जाता है?
e: Platinum ek 'noble metal' hai, kyunki ye hawa ki oxygen tatha aam amlon se kriya nahi karta tatha uchch tapman par bhi chamakdar tatha saaf bana rehta hai; isliye ishe 'saumya' dhaatu kaha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki platinum ki satah par electron chhodne (oxidation) ki pravriti bahut kam hoti hai, isliye ushe ratna, bijli ke contact, tatha utprek (catalyst) ke roop mein istemal karte hain - jaise car ke catalytic converter mein. Iske ulat loha tatha tamba aasaani se jang ya patina pakad lete hain, isliye wo noble nahi hote. Exam point: platinum ek noble metal hai, kyunki ye oxidation tatha jang se bacha rehta hai tatha uchch tapman par bhi saaf rehta hai.

qe: What is the primary cause of 'Minamata Disease' discovered in Japan?
qh: जापान में खोजी गई 'मिनीमाता बीमारी' का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
e: Minamata rog Japan ke Minamata kshetra mein 1950 ke dashak mein paaya gaya tatha iska karan paara (mercury) ka zehira tha, jo ek rasayanik factory ke kachre ke saath samudri paani mein mila tha. Yaha paara samudri machhliyon tatha shankh (shellfish) mein jama ho gaya tatha un logon ne jo ye machhli khaate the unke sharer mein pahunch kar mastishk tatha snayu ko nasht kar diya - isse kampti (tremors), dhundhla dikhna tatha lakwa (paralysis) hua. Iske ulat cadmium se Itai-Itai rog tatha sisa (lead) se plumbism hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Minamata rog ka mukhya karan paara (mercury) ka zehira tha, jo samudri khaane ke saath logon ke sharer mein pahuncha tatha mastishk ko kshati pahunchai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Bulletproof' glass and armor plating due to its high strength-to-weight ratio?
qh: उच्च शक्ति-से-भार अनुपात के कारण बुलेटप्रूफ ग्लास और कवच प्लेटिंग में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Titanium ki khaas baat uski majbooti tatha halkapan ka mila-jula gun hai; iska ghanatva loha se kam hota hai par uski majbooti (weight ke hisaab se) adhik hoti hai, isliye ise bamboo-proof (bulletproof) glass, helmet tatha viman (aircraft) ke dhaanche mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki titanium hawa mein bhi apni satah par oxide ki patli parat bana leta hai, isliye jang nahi lagta tatha goli ki tez urja sokhne mein madad karta hai; iske ulat loha bhaari hone ke karan ye laabh nahi deta. Iske ulat isi gun ke karan titanium ko 'strategic metal' bhi kehte hain, isliye yahan titanium hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: goli-rodhak (bulletproof) glass tatha armour mein titanium ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye loha se halka par usse zyada mazboot hai tatha jang nahi pakadta.

qe: Which disease is caused by chronic 'Cadmium' poisoning, leading to brittle bones and joint pain?
qh: लंबे समय तक 'कैडमियम' के विषाक्त प्रभाव से कौन सा रोग होता है, जिससे हड्डियां कमजोर और जोड़ों में दर्द होता है?
e: Itai-Itai rog Japan mein cadmium ke pradushan se hua tha; cadmium wale paani se kheton mein chawal ugaye gaye tatha us chawal ko khane wale logon ke sharer mein cadmium jama hone se haddiyan kamzor ho gayi tatha jod-jod mein dard hone laga. Iska karan yahi hai ki cadmium calcium ke sthan par haddi mein baith jaata hai tatha ushe bhangur (brittle) bana deta hai, isliye chhoti chot par bhi haddiyan toot jaati thi; isi karan ise 'ouch-ouch' rog bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat paara se Minamata tatha sisa se plumbism hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: cadmium ke pradushan se hone wala rog Itai-Itai hai - ismein haddiyan bhangur ho jaati hain tatha jodon mein dard rehta hai.

qe: What is 'Misch Metal' primarily composed of?
qh: 'मिश धातु' (Misch Metal) मुख्य रूप से किससे बनी होती है?
e: Misch metal ek mishran hai jismein lagbhag 50 pratishat lanthanid (durlabh mitti / rare earth) dhaatuen tatha baaki loha tatha chhoti matara mein carbon, silicon tatha sulfur hote hain; ise misch (German bhasha mein 'mixed') kaha jaata hai. Iska mukhya upyog lighter (chakmak) ki chingari wali dhaatu tatha khaas steel ke mishar mein hota hai, kyunki lanthanid dhaatuen hawa se kriya karke aasaani se chingari paida karti hain. Iske ulat ye keval ek dhaatu nahi balki dhaatuon ka mishran hai, isliye tamba-nikal ya loha-chromium jaisa jod yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: misch metal mukhya roop se lanthanid (rare earth) dhaatuon tatha loha ka mishran hota hai, jise lighter ki chingari wali dhaatu banane mein istemal karte hain.

qe: Which heavy metal is most commonly found in 'Lead Storage Batteries' used in households?
qh: घरों में इस्तेमाल होने वाली लेड स्टोरेज बैटरियों में कौन सी भारी धातु पाई जाती है?
e: Lead storage battery (sisa-sanchayak) mein electrode lead (Pb) ke bante hain tatha electrolyte patla sulfuric acid hota hai; isi karan gaadi ke battery mein sisa ka bhaar adhik hota hai tatha ushe sambhalna padta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki lead aasaani se vidyut-rasayanik kriya deta hai tatha baar-baar use kiya ja sakta hai (recharge ho jaata hai), isliye yahi sbse aam dharelu battery hai - par iske kachre (scrap) ko galat tore se phenkne par sisa mitti tatha paani mein mil kar zehira failaata hai. Iske ulat lithium tatha nikal jaisi dhaatuen nayi battery mein aati hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: dharelu lead storage battery mein mukhya bhaari dhaatu sisa (lead) hota hai, jo electrode banata hai tatha baar-baar recharge hone deta hai.

qe: Which metal is known as the 'Strategic Metal' because it is vital for a country's defense and economy?
qh: किस धातु को 'रणनीतिक धातु' (Strategic Metal) कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह रक्षा और अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है?
e: Titanium ko 'strategic metal' kehte hain, kyunki ye hawai jahaz, missile, submarine tatha sainik vaahan (tank) ke liye atyant zaroori hai tatha iske utpadan par desh ki suraksha tatha arthavyavastha nirbhar karti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki titanium loha se halka par usse adhik mazboot hai tatha samudri paani tatha uchch tapman par bhi kharab nahi hota, isliye yuddh ke saman mein iska istemal sabse adhik hota hai; iske ulat ise aam dhaatuon ki tarah aasaani se nahi khareeda ja sakta. Iske ulat sone tatha platinum mehange hote hain, par unhe 'strategic' nahi kaha jaata, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: titanium ko strategic metal kaha jaata hai, kyunki ye rakchha (defence) tatha hawai jahaz ke liye atyant zaroori halki tatha mazboot dhaatu hai.

qe: The 'Plumbism' medical condition refers to the poisoning caused by which metal?
qh: 'प्लंबिज्म' (Plumbism) चिकित्सीय स्थिति किस धातु के कारण होने वाले विषाक्तता को संदर्भित करती है?
e: Plumbism sisa (lead) ke zehira se hone wali bimari hai; ismein sisa sharer mein jama ho kar khoon banaane wali kriya ko rok deta hai tatha mastishk, gurda tatha snayu ko kshati pahunchata hai - iske lakshan pet dard, kamzori, kampta (tremors) tatha bachcho mein dimag ki kamzori hote hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sisa haemoglobin banane mein zinc tatha loha ki jagah baith jaata hai, isliye khoon ki kami (anemia) ho jaati hai; isi liye purane rang, paint tatha battery ke kachre se bachcho ko door rakhna chahiye. Iske ulat paara se Minamata tatha cadmium se Itai-Itai rog hota hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: plumbism ka matlab sisa (lead) ka zehira hai - ye khoon tatha mastishk ko kshati pahunchata hai, isliye battery tatha purane paint se savdhani zaroori hai.

qe: Which element is used as a 'Dopant' in Silicon to create a p-type semiconductor?
qh: पी-प्रकार का अर्धचालक बनाने के लिए सिलिकॉन में किस तत्व को डोपेंट के रूप में मिलाया जाता है?
e: Silicon ek chatur-sanyojak (tetravalent) ardh-chaalak hai; ismein thodi matara mein aisa tatva milaya jaata hai jismein teen hi electron hote hain (jaise boron), isse ek electron ki kami wali jagah (hole) banti hai tatha wo p-type (positive) ardh-chaalak ban jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki boron ke paas silicon se ek electron kam hota hai, isliye yahan 'chhidra' (hole) vidyut ka bahav karne lagta hai - yahi p-n junction tatha transistor ke banane ka aadhaar hai, jise diode tatha computer chip mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat phosphorus tatha arsenic mein paanch electron hote hain, isliye wo n-type banate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: silicon mein p-type ardh-chaalak banane ke liye boron (teen-electron wala tatva) dopant ke roop mein milaya jaata hai.

qe: What is the main component of 'Fool's Gold'?
qh: 'मूर्खों का सोना' (Fool's Gold) का मुख्य घटक क्या है?
e: Fool's gold (murkh ka sona) ka rasayanik naam iron sulfide (FeS2) hai tatha ise 'pyrite' bhi kehte hain; iska peela chamakdar rang sone jaisa dikhta hai, isliye bahut log ise sona samajh kar dhhokha kha jaate hain. Iske ulat asli sone (gold) mein sulfur nahi hota tatha wo zyada bhaari tatha narm hota hai, isliye sone tatha pyrite ko aasaani se alag kiya ja sakta hai - pyrite kathor hota hai tatha usse halka sunhari choora girta hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha silica kee bhi pehchaan alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: fool's gold mukhya roop se iron sulfide (FeS2, pyrite) hota hai - iska chamakdar peela rang sone jaisa hota hai par ye sone se alag hoga tatha kam keemti hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Nuclear Control Rods' to absorb neutrons efficiently?
qh: न्यूट्रॉनों को कुशलतापूर्वक अवशोषित करने के लिए 'परमाणु नियंत्रण छड़ों' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nuclear control rods (nabhik niyantran chhad) mein cadmium jaisi dhaatu ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye neutron (nabhik kanon) ko bahut prabhavi taur par sokh (absorb) leti hai tatha nabhik abhikriya ki gati ko niyantrit karti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki cadmium neutron ko pakad kar ushe sthir bana deta hai, isliye control rod ko andar-bahar karne se reactor ki urja kam ya zyada ki ja sakti hai tatha reactor 'runaway' nahi hota; isliye ise boron ke saath reactor ke suraksha tantra mein bhi istemal karte hain. Iske ulat tamba tatha loha neutron ko itni aasaani se nahi sokhte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: nabhik reactor ke control rods mein cadmium ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye neutron ko sokh kar abhikriya ko niyantrit rakhta hai.

qe: The 'Hardness' of steel is increased by adding which element during its manufacture?
qh: स्टील के निर्माण के दौरान किस तत्व को मिलाकर उसकी 'कठोरता' बढ़ाई जाती है?
e: Steel ki kathorata (hardness) badhane ke liye usmein carbon ki matara badhai jaati hai; carbon loha ke atomon ke beech ghusskar ek aisi sajaavat banata hai jisse loha ke parat aasaani se sarak nahi paate, isliye dhaatu kathor tatha mazboot ban jaati hai. Isi karan carbon ki matara 0.2 pratishat se 1.5 pratishat tak badhane par steel ka istemal chhari, chaku tatha machine ke hisson ke liye hota hai; par bahut adhik carbon se steel bhangur ho jaata hai. Iske ulat chromium jang rokta hai tatha nikal majbooti deta hai, par kathorata ka mukhya kaam carbon ka hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: steel ki kathorata badhane ke liye carbon milaya jaata hai - yahi loha ke atomon ke beech baith kar dhaatu ko mazboot banata hai.

qe: Which metal is found in 'Vitamin B12' (Cyanocobalamin)?
qh: 'विटामिन बी12' (सायनोकोबालामिन) में कौन सी धातु पाई जाती है?
e: Cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12) mein mukhya dhaatu cobalt hota hai, jo ek corrin chakra ke beech mein baithta hai; isi karan is vitamin ka rang laal hota hai tatha ye khoon ki koshikaon tatha snayu ke liye zaroori hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki cobalt sharer mein khoon banane (erythropoiesis) tatha DNA banane mein sahayak hota hai; iske ulat iski kami se khun ki kami (anemia) tatha snayu ki samasya ho jaati hai, isliye ise aam taur par injection ke roop mein diya jaata hai. Iske ulat loha tatha tamba alag kaam karte hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke uttar nahi hain. Exam point: vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin) mein cobalt dhaatu maujood hoti hai - isi karan ye khoon tatha snayu ke liye zaroori vitamin hai.

qe: What is 'White Gold' usually an alloy of?
qh: 'व्हाइट गोल्ड' आमतौर पर किसका मिश्र धातु होता है?
e: White gold ek aisi mishradhatu hai jismein sone (gold) ke saath platinum, palladium ya nikal mila hota hai; sone ko safed rang dene ke liye yahi safed dhaatuen milai jaati hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki shudh sona peela tatha narm hota hai, isliye safed dhaatuen milane se ushe safed chamak tatha mazbooti milti hai - isi karan white gold ki anguthiyan tatha gehne bante hain. Iske ulat ismein tamba ya loha mukhya nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi (in dhaatuon se peela rang hi gehra hota hai). Exam point: white gold sone tatha platinum/palladium/nikal ki mishradhatu hoti hai - isi karan ye safed dikhti hai tatha gehne banane mein kaam aati hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in 'Vulcanized' tires to make them heat resistant?
qh: 'वल्कनीकृत' टायरों को गर्मी प्रतिरोधी बनाने के लिए किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Vulcanized tyre (vulcanized rabar) mein sulfur ke pul anuon ke beech ban jaate hain, isliye ush bhi tapman badhne par rabar naram nahi padta tatha ghisne se jaldi nahi ghista - yahi karan hai ki tyre tatha anya mausami saman mein sulfur ka istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sulfur ke bandhan se rabar ki anu-shrankhla sthir ho jaati hai, isliye gaadi ke chalte samay tyre garam hone par bhi tikta hai tatha sadak ki ragad (friction) ko sahta hai; iske ulat bina vulcanization rabar garmi mein chipak jaata tatha jal jaldi jata. Iske ulat phosphorus tatha carbon ye sthirta nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vulcanized tyre (garmi-sahishnu) banane ke liye sulfur ka istemal hota hai - yahi rabar ki shrankhlaon ke beech pul banakar ushe mazboot karta hai.

qe: Which metal is known for having the 'Highest Electrical Conductivity'?
qh: किस धातु को 'उच्चतम विद्युत चालकता' के लिए जाना जाता है?
e: Chandni (silver) sabse adhik vidyut-chaalakta wali dhaatu hai - iska matlab yahi hai ki usmein mukta electron bahut aasaani se chalte hain, isliye iski vidyut-pratirodhakta (resistivity) sabse kam hoti hai. Isi karan sabse shudh vidyut ke kaam (jaise chhote contact switch tatha satellite ke taar) mein silver ka istemal hota hai, par ye mehanga hone ke karan aam tar ke liye tamba (copper) istemal hota hai jo silver ke baad doosre sthan par hai. Iske ulat sone tatha tamba ki chaalakta silver se kam hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sabse adhik vidyut-chaalakta (electrical conductivity) chandni (silver) ki hoti hai; isi ke baad tamba aata hai, jise aam tar mein istemal karte hain.

qe: What is 'Galena' the principal ore of?
qh: 'गैलेना' (Galena) किसका प्रमुख अयस्क है?
e: Galena (PbS) lead (sisa) ka pramukh ayask hota hai, jismein lead tatha sulfur milkar sulfide banate hain; ise jalaa kar pehle oxide banaya jaata hai tatha aage kanghi (carbon) se lead ki dhaatu nikaali jaati hai. Iska pehchaan-lakshan yahi hai ki galena ka rang dhantla sisa jaisa hota hai tatha uski chamak dhaatu ki tarah hoti hai, isliye ise purane zamane se sisa banane ke liye istemal karte the; iske ulat zinc, tamba tatha loha ke ayask alag hote hain. Iske ulat zinc blende (ZnS) tatha chalcopyrite (CuFeS2) isse alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: galena (PbS) lead dhaatu ka pramukh ayask hai - isse sisa nikaalne ke liye pehle oxide tatha phir kanghi se dhaatu banai jaati hai.

qe: Which metal was used in ancient times as a 'Sweetener' (Lead sugar) in wine, leading to widespread poisoning?
qh: प्राचीन काल में शराब में 'स्वीटनर' (लेड शुगर) के रूप में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता था, जिससे व्यापक विषाक्तता हुई?
e: Puraane zamane mein sisa (lead) ke mishran ko wine mein milaya jaata tha, kyunki lead acetate mitha hone ke karan ushe 'lead sugar' kaha jaata tha tatha wo kharaab wine ka khatta swaad chhupa deta tha. Par isse hazaaron log plumbism (sisa ke zehir) ke shikar ho gaye tatha unhe pet dard, kamzori tatha mastishk ki samasyaen hui; isi liye aaj sisa ke khane-pine ke saath sambandh par sakhti se rok hai. Iske ulat is kriya mein sone, chandi ya tamba ka istemal nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: puraane wine ko mitha tatha swaad se bharpoor banane ke liye lead (sisa) ko 'lead sugar' ke roop mein milaya jaata tha, jisse widespread sisa-zehira faila.

qe: Which process is used for the mass production of 'Steel' from molten pig iron?
qh: पिघले हुए पिग आयरन से 'स्टील' के बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bessemer vidhi wo pehli sasta audyogik tareeka tha jismein drav pig iron (kaccha loha) ke bheetar hawa (oxygen) ki tez dhara chhodi jaati hai; isse loha mein maujood carbon, silicon, manganese tatha sulfur oxid hokar hat jaate hain tatha steel banta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki hawa ki oxygen loha ki ashuddhiyon ko pakad leti hai tatha unhe gaadha (slag) ya gas ke roop mein bahar kar deti hai, isliye thodi hi der mein badi matara steel ban jaati hai - yahi karan ise steel ke bade utpadan ke liye upyukt banata hai. Iske ulat open hearth tatha L-D vidhi baad mein aayi, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: drav pig iron se badi matara mein steel banane ke liye Bessemer vidhi istemal hoti hai, jismein hawa ki oxygen ke zariye ashuddhiyan hatai jaati hain.

qe: In the Blast Furnace, the 'Zone of Reduction' occurs at what temperature range?
qh: वात्या भट्टी (Blast Furnace) में 'अपचयन क्षेत्र' किस तापमान सीमा पर होता है?
e: Blast furnace (dhmaun bhatti) mein gasen upar ki or badhti hain tatha ayask niche ki or utarta hai, isliye alag-alag oonchai par alag tapman tatha alag rasayanik kriya hoti hai; 'zone of reduction' wo hissa hota hai jahan tapman lagbhag 400-700 degree C hota hai tatha wahan loha ke oxide (Fe2O3, Fe3O4) se oxygen nikal kar loha banna shuru hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki reduction ka kaam carbon monoxide (CO) gas karti hai, jo upar se niche jaate hue oxide se milta hai; iske ulat isse niche (zone of combustion, lagbhag 1500-2000 degree C) mein coke jalta hai tatha sabse garam bhaag hota hai. Iske ulat 1200-1500 degree C ke bhaag mein dhaatu pighalti hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: blast furnace ka zone of reduction lagbhag 400-700 degree C par hota hai, jahan CO gas loha ke oxide ka reduction karti hai.

qe: What is the chemical composition of 'Stainless Steel'?
qh: 'स्टेनलेस स्टील' की रासायनिक संरचना क्या है?
e: Stainless steel ki sanrachna mein loha (iron) mukhya dhaatu hota hai tatha uske saath carbon, chromium tatha nikal milaye jaate hain; chromium lagbhag 18 pratishat tatha nikal lagbhag 8 pratishat milaane se ye '18/8 steel' ban jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki chromium hawa ke sampark mein aakar apni rakshak parat khud bana leta hai tatha nikal dhaatu ko majbooti deta hai; isi karan ye jang (corrosion) se bacha rehta hai tatha garam tatha chikne padarthon (khane) ke saath kriya nahi karta - isi liye bartan tatha aspataal ke auzaar isi ke bante hain. Iske ulat ismein tamba tatha tin jaisi dhaatuen nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: stainless steel ka mishran loha, carbon, chromium tatha nikal ka hota hai - isi se jang-rahit tatha khane-yogya dhaatu banti hai.

qe: Which gas is known as 'Producer Gas' and is used as fuel in the Open Hearth process?
qh: किस गैस को 'प्रोड्यूसर गैस' कहा जाता है जिसका उपयोग ओपन हर्थ प्रक्रिया में ईंधन के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Producer gas (utpadak gas) wo mishran hota hai jismein carbon monoxide (CO) tatha nitrogen (N2) hoti hain; ise coke par hawa ki seemit (limited) matara guzaar kar banaaya jaata hai, isliye iski jyoti neeli tatha ushma kam hoti hai par ye sasti hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki hawa se aane wali nitrogen gas ke saath CO mil jaati hai, isliye ye gas open hearth tatha bhatti (furnace) jaisi jagahon par indhan ke roop mein istemal hoti hai; iske saath ismein thodi matara mein CO2 bhi hoti hai. Iske ulat ismein hydrogen ya methane mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: producer gas carbon monoxide (CO) tatha nitrogen (N2) ka mishran hota hai - ise coke par seemit hawa guzaar kar banaaya jaata hai tatha ye bhatti ke indhan ke roop mein kaam aati hai.

qe: The 'L-D Process' (Linz-Donawitz) is a modern method for manufacturing:
qh: 'एल-डी प्रक्रिया' (L-D Process) किसके निर्माण की एक आधुनिक विधि है?
e: L-D vidhi (Linz-Donawitz vidhi) ek aadhunik tareeka hai jismein drav pig iron ke upar shudh oxygen (O2) ki tez dhara chhodi jaati hai; isse carbon tatha anya ashuddhiyan tezi se oxid hokar hat jaati hain tatha steel banta hai (Bessemer se behtar tatha kam samay mein). Iska karan yahi hai ki shudh oxygen hawa se kai guna tez asar karti hai tatha ushma bhi zyada deti hai, isliye ye sasta tatha tez tareeka ban gaya - aaj duniya ka adhiktam steel isi vidhi se banta hai. Iske ulat ye aluminium, tamba ya sOda banane ki vidhi nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: L-D (Linz-Donawitz) vidhi drav pig iron se steel banane ki aadhunik tareeka hai, jismein shudh oxygen ki dhara istemal hoti hai.

qe: Which form of Iron is used for making 'Anchors' and 'Chains' because it is tough and fibrous?
qh: 'लंगर' और 'जंजीर' बनाने के लिए लोहे के किस रूप का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह सख्त और रेशेदार होता है?
e: Wrought iron (pitttal loha) mein carbon ki matara bahut kam hoti hai tatha usmein ghaan (slag) ke baareek resh pirote rehte hain, isliye wo 'reshdar' tatha akhand (tough) hota hai - jhatka lene par tootta nahi balki mudh jaata hai. Isi karan ise jahaz ke langar (anchor), zanjeer tatha aise hisson mein istemal karte hain jahan bhaar tatha jhatka sahana padta hai; iske ulat cast iron bhangur hota hai tatha jhatke se toot jaata hai. Iske ulat steel isse adhik kathor par kam lachakdar hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: langar tatha zanjeer aise hisson ke liye wrought iron istemal hota hai, kyunki usmein carbon kam tatha resh zyada hone se wo akhand aha tatha jhatka sahta hai.

qe: What is 'Spiegeleisen'?
qh: 'स्पीगेलआइजन' (Spiegeleisen) क्या है?
o: An alloy of Iron, Manganese, and Carbon
e: Spiegeleisen (spiegel = darpan) ek mishradhatu hai jismein loha ke saath manganese (lagbhag 15-30 pratishat) tatha carbon (lagbhag 5 pratishat) hota hai; iska chamakdar krystal-roop darpan jaisa dikhta hai, isliye yahi naam pada. Iska upyog steel banane mein hota hai, kyunki manganese steel se oxygen tatha sulfur hata deta hai tatha uski majbooti badhata hai; isi karan Bessemer vidhi mein ise milaya jaata hai. Iske ulat ismein nikal ya chromium mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: spiegeleisen loha, manganese tatha carbon ki mishradhatu hoti hai - ise steel banane ke samay milaya jaata hai taaki ashuddhiyan hatai ja sakein.

qe: Which reaction represents the 'Zone of Combustion' in the Blast Furnace?
qh: वात्या भट्टी में कौन सी प्रतिक्रिया 'दहन क्षेत्र' (Zone of Combustion) का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है?
e: Blast furnace ke 'zone of combustion' (jalan ka bhaag) mein coke (carbon) hawa ki oxygen se kriya karke carbon dioxide (CO2) banata hai tatha saath mein bahut ushma paida hoti hai - yani kriya C + O2 se CO2 + ushma hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yahi bhaag bhatti ka sabse garam hissa hota hai (lagbhag 1500-2000 degree C), isliye yahin se dhaatu pighalne ki shuruaat hoti hai; iske baad bani CO2 upar jaakar coke se milkar CO banati hai jo reduction karta hai. Iske ulat CO + O2 ya Fe + O2 wali kriya us bhaag ki nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: blast furnace ke zone of combustion mein C + O2 se CO2 tatha ushma banti hai - yahi bhatti ka sabse garam bhaag hota hai.

qe: What is 'Cast Iron' primarily used for?
qh: 'ढलवा लोहा' (Cast Iron) मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Cast iron (dhala hua loha) mein carbon ki matara adhik (2-4 pratishat) hoti hai, isliye wo kathor hote hue bhi bhaunka (brittle) hota hai tatha tej chot se toot jaata hai; isi karan ise wahan istemal karte hain jahan saancha (shape) chahiye tatha jhatka kam padta hai. Iske mukhya upyog patari ki neev (railway sleepers), khane-pakane ke tave tatha bhatti (kadhai) tatha machine ke bhaari base banane mein hote hain, kyunki ye saanchi likar banta hai tatha ghisav sahta hai. Iske ulat zanjeer tatha langar ke liye wrought iron chahiye (kyunki wahan jhatka padta hai), isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cast iron ka istemal rail ki neev, tave tatha bhaari base mein hota hai - kyunki ismein carbon adhik hone se ye saanchi likar kathor banta hai.

qe: Which element is removed from Pig Iron to convert it into Steel?
qh: पिग आयरन को स्टील में बदलने के लिए उसमें से कौन सा तत्व निकाला जाता है?
e: Pig iron (kaccha loha) mein carbon ki matara adhik (lagbhag 4 pratishat) hoti hai, isliye wo bhangur tatha kamzor hota hai tatha seedha kaam nahi aata; steel banane ke liye ismein se bahut saara carbon hinana padta hai, jise oxid karke CO2 ya CO ke roop mein bahar kiya jaata hai (jaise Bessemer ya L-D vidhi mein). Iska karan yahi hai ki carbon ki matara hi loha ke gun tay karti hai - ise hatate hi loha akhand tatha lachakdar ban jaata hai, jo machine tatha dhaanche ke liye zaroori hai. Iske ulat sulfur tatha phosphorus bhi hataye jaate hain, par mukhya roop se carbon ki matara ghatai jaati hai, isliye wahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: pig iron ko steel banane ke liye usme se adhik matara ka carbon (excess carbon) oxid karke hataya jaata hai.

qe: In the 'Open Hearth Process', the lining of the furnace can be 'Basic' or 'Acidic'. What is a 'Basic' lining made of?
qh: 'ओपन हर्थ प्रक्रिया' में भट्टी का अस्तर बेसिक या अम्लीय हो सकता है। 'बेसिक' अस्तर किसका बना होता है?
e: Open hearth bhatti ki antari parat (lining) us kachche maal tatha gaadhe (slag) ke hisaab se chuni jaati hai; 'basic' lining ke liye magnesite (MgO) tatha dolomite jaisa kshaariya padarth lagaya jaata hai, kyunki ye acidic ashuddhi (silica) ko saaf karne wale gaadhe ko sahta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki silica wala acidic gaadha kshaariya parat ko todega nahi, isliye ye jodi sahi baithti hai; iske ulat acidic lining ke liye silica (sand) ka istemal hota hai, jo basic gaadhe ke saath bigad jaata hai. Isi tarah sahi jodi chunne se bhatti lamba chalti hai tatha steel ki shuddhata badhti hai. Exam point: open hearth bhatti ki basic lining magnesite (MgO) ki hoti hai, kyunki ye acidic ashuddhiyon ko hatane wale kshaariya gaadhe ko sahti hai.

qe: The 'Slag' produced in the Blast Furnace is used for:
qh: वात्या भट्टी में बनने वाले 'धातुमल' (Slag) का उपयोग किसमें किया जाता है?
e: Blast furnace mein bante gaadhe (slag) ka mukhya hissa calcium silicate (CaSiO3) jaisa hota hai; ise phenkne ke bajaye road banane tatha cement ke utpadan mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ismein cement banane ke liye zaroori calcium tatha silicon pehle se mila hua hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki slag ushma-rodhak tatha ghan hone ke karan cement tatha brick jaisa saman banane mein kaam aata hai tatha road ki neev (base) ko mazboot karta hai - isi se kachre ka sadupyog hota hai. Iske ulat ise khane-pine ke bindu ya bijli ke taar banane mein istemal nahi karte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: blast furnace ka slag road banane tatha cement ke utpadan mein istemal hota hai - isi karan yahi audyogik up-utpad (by product) faydemand maana jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Invar' steel used for?
qh: 'इन्वार' (Invar) स्टील का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Invar ek khaas mishradhatu hai jismein loha (63 pratishat) tatha nikal (36 pratishat) mila hota hai; yahi anupat ushe lagbhag shunya prasaar gunank (almost zero expansion) deta hai, yani usmein tapman badhne par lambai nahi badalti. Isi karan isse napi (measuring tapes) tatha pendulum wali ghadi (clock) banai jaati hai, kyunki mausam badalne par bhi naap sahi rehna chahiye; iske ulat sadharan steel tatha peetal ke naap tapman ke saath badal jaate hain. Iske ulat tungsten steel ke tool kaam aate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: invar steel ka istemal naap-patti tatha pendulum ghadi mein hota hai, kyunki usmein tapman ke saath prasaar lagbhag nahi hota.

qe: Which type of 'Steel' contains Chromium and Vanadium and is used for making 'Axles'?
qh: किस प्रकार के स्टील में क्रोमियम और वैनेडियम होता है और इसका उपयोग धुरों (Axles) को बनाने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Alloy steel wo steel hoti hai jismein loha tatha carbon ke saath chromium, vanadium, nikal ya molybdenum jaisi dhaatuen jaan-boojh kar milai jaati hain; chromium majbooti tatha jang-raksha deta hai tatha vanadium aks (axle) tatha spring ko akhand tatha jhatka-sahishnu banata hai. Isi karan gadi ke aks, gear tatha machine ke bhaari hisse isi steel se bante hain, kyunki wahan baar-baar jhatka tatha ghisav padta hai. Iske ulat sadharan carbon steel itna majboot nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: chromium tatha vanadium wali alloy steel se aks banaye jaate hain, kyunki ise jhatka tatha ghisav sahan karne ki zaroorat hoti hai.

qe: The 'Charge' of a Blast Furnace consists of:
qh: वात्या भट्टी के 'प्रभार' (Charge) में क्या शामिल होता है?
e: Blast furnace ke 'charge' ka matlab wahan daala gaya kachcha maal hai tatha ismein teen cheezein milai jaati hain - ayask (ore, jisse loha milta hai), flux (choona patthar ya dolomite, jo ashuddhi hatata hai) tatha indhan (coke, jo ushma deta hai tatha kanghi ka kaam karta hai). Iska karan yahi hai ki teeno ke bina kriya poori nahi hoti; ayask se dhaatu, flux se gaadha tatha coke se ushma milti hai, isliye unka anupat sahi rakhna zaroori hota hai. Iske ulat slag ya drav steel charge ka hissa nahi hote (wo utpad tatha nikalne wale padarth hain), isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: blast furnace ka charge ayask, flux tatha indhan ka mishran hota hai - isi se loha nikaala jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of the gas exiting from the top of a Blast Furnace?
qh: वात्या भट्टी के शीर्ष से निकलने वाली गैस की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Blast furnace ke sire se nikalti gas mein carbon monoxide (CO) tatha nitrogen (N2) mukhya hote hain tatha uske saath CO2 tatha dhool bhi mili hoti hai; kyunki ismein CO jalti hai, isliye ye gas indhan ka kaam kar sakti hai. Isi karan ise saaf karke (dust hata kar) bhatti ke heater tatha anya upyogon mein jalaya jaata hai, jisse koyle ki bachat hoti hai; iske ulat ye keval gair-upyogi dhuan nahi hai. Iske ulat oxygen ya nitrogen ki shudh gas is bhaag se nahi nikalti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: blast furnace ke sire se nikalne wali gas ek jalti gas (fuel gas) hoti hai, jismein CO tatha N2 hote hain - isi liye ushe do-baar upyog kiya jaata hai.

qe: Which method of 'Corrosion Prevention' is most suitable for heavy machinery?
qh: भारी मशीनरी के लिए 'जंग की रोकथाम' की कौन सी विधि सबसे उपयुक्त है?
e: Bhaari machine tatha lohe ke bade ojaar sadak tatha khule aasman mein rehte hain, isliye unhe jang se bachane ke liye chapchapa tel (grease) tatha oil ki parat lagai jaati hai; yahi tarika bhaari machinery ke liye sabse upyukt maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tel tatha grease paani tatha oxygen ko satah tak pahunchne hi nahi dete, isliye jang shuru hi nahi hoti tatha purani parat ko hata kar nayi parat aasaani se lagai ja sakti hai. Iske ulat painting, galvanizing tatha anodizing naye chhote hisson ke liye achhe hote hain, par bhaari machinery par unhe baar-baar lagana mushkil hota hai. Exam point: bhaari machinery ko jang se bachane ke liye greasing tatha oiling (snigdhan) sabse upyukt tarika hai, kyunki ye hawa tatha paani ko satah tak pahunchne nahi deta.

qe: What is 'Tungsten Steel' primarily used for?
qh: 'टंगस्टन स्टील' का मुख्य उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Tungsten steel (jise high speed steel bhi kehte hain) mein tungsten ki matara adhik hoti hai, isliye ye bahut tapman (lagbhag 1000 degree C) par bhi apni kathorata bani rakhti hai; isi karan ise driller, lathe tatha anya katai (cutting) ojaar banane mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki kaam karte samay ojaar garam ho jaate hain tatha ushma par sadharan steel narm pad jaata hai, jabki tungsten wali steel tez katai karti rehti hai - yahi 'high speed' naam ka aadhaar hai. Iske ulat ye keval bartan ya ghadi ke spring ke liye nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: tungsten steel ka istemal tez katai wale ojaar (high speed cutting tools) banane mein hota hai, kyunki ye uchch tapman par bhi kathor bani rehti hai.

qe: In the 'Hall-Heroult' process for Aluminum, what is the role of 'Cryolite' ($Na_3AlF_6$)?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम के 'हॉल-हेरॉल्ट' प्रक्रम में क्रायोलाइट ($Na_3AlF_6$) की क्या भूमिका है?
o: To lower the melting point of Alumina
e: Hall-Heroult vidhi mein alumina (Al2O3) ka galaank bahut adhik (lagbhag 2045 degree C) hota hai, isliye usmein cryolite (Na3AlF6) milaya jaata hai; isse mishran ka galaank lagbhag 950-1000 degree C tak gir jaata hai. Isi karan vidyut apghatan (electrolysis) kam ushma par ho paata hai tatha alumina ghul kar aayan ke roop mein bah jata hai, jisse aluminium nikalta hai - yahi cryolite ka mukhya kaam hai. Iske ulat cryolite kanghi ya utprek nahi hai, keval galaank ghatane wala (paighaamak) hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Hall-Heroult vidhi mein cryolite (Na3AlF6) alumina ka galaank ghatane ke liye milaya jaata hai, jisse bijli ki bachat hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Cathode' made of in the electrolytic cell for Aluminum extraction?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम निष्कर्षण के लिए इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक सेल में 'कैथोड' किसका बना होता है?
e: Aluminium nikalne wali vidyut-rasayanik koshika (electrolytic cell) mein cathode (rin chhor) ke roop mein loha ki tanki ka istemal hota hai jiski antari satah carbon (graphite) ki parat se bnai jaati hai - yani cathode carbon-lined steel tank hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki drav (molten) aluminium cathode par jama hota hai tatha carbon ko chhodkar wo tanki se chhipakta nahi, isliye ushe aasaani se nikaala ja sakta hai; sath hi carbon uchch tapman sahta hai. Iske ulat anodes carbon ke bante hain, isliye cathode ke liye wahi jod sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium nikalne ki electrolytic koshika mein cathode loha ki tanki hoti hai jiski antari parat carbon (graphite) ki hoti hai - wahan aluminium jama hota hai.

qe: Why do the 'Anodes' in Aluminum extraction need to be replaced periodically?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम निष्कर्षण में 'एनोड' को समय-समय पर बदलने की आवश्यकता क्यों होती है?
o: They react with evolved Oxygen to form CO2
e: Aluminium ke nishkarshan mein carbon (graphite) ke anode istemal hote hain, par ye anode apne aap oxygen se kriya karke jala jaate hain - anti-mein anode par paida hua oxygen carbon ke saath mil kar carbon dioxide (CO2) banata hai. Isi karan anodes ko kuchh hafton mein badalna padta hai, jabki cathode salamat rehta hai; iske ulat ye keval tapman se nahi balki rasayanik kriya se ghista hai. Iske ulat cathode par aluminium jama hone se jala nahi jaata, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium nikalne ke dauran carbon anodes oxygen se mil kar CO2 banakar jala jaate hain, isliye unhe samay-samay par badalna padta hai.

qe: Which ore is concentrated by the 'Froth Floatation' process before extracting Copper?
qh: तांबे के निष्कर्षण से पहले किस अयस्क को 'झाग प्लवन' (Froth Floatation) प्रक्रिया द्वारा सांद्रित किया जाता है?
e: Froth floatation vidhi sulfidic ayask ke liye sabse upyukt hai, kyunki sulfide ke kan paani ko chhodte hain tatha tel (pine oil) se chipak kar jhaag ke saath upar tair jaate hain - isi karan copper pyrites (CuFeS2) ko is vidhi se sadhta (concentrate) kiya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ayask ka sulfide hissa paani se door rahta hai tatha gangue (ashuddhi) paani mein dubki reh jaati hai, isliye ye dono aasaani se alag ho jaate hain. Iske ulat oxide wale ayask (jaise bauxite) tatha haematite ke liye yahi vidhi nahi chalti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: copper pyrites (sulfidic ayask) ko copper nikaalne se pehle froth floatation vidhi se sadhta kiya jaata hai, kyunki wahan tel tatha paani ka gun kaam aata hai.

qe: What is 'Copper Matte'?
qh: 'कॉपर मैट' (Copper Matte) क्या है?
o: A mixture of Cu2S and FeS
A mixture of CuO and FeO
e: Copper matte wo pighla hua mishran hota hai jismein Cu2S (copper sulfide) tatha FeS (iron sulfide) hote hain; ye blast furnace ke niche jama hota hai jab ayask ko smelt kiya jaata hai, kyunki wahan ke tapman par sulfide hi drav roop mein rehte hain. Iska matlab yahi hai ki matte mein loha tatha tamba dono sulfide ke roop mein hote hain tatha isse aage loha hatakar tamba (blister copper) nikaala jaata hai; iske ulat matte kisi ek dhaatu ka shudh roop nahi hai. Iske ulat copper oxide ya carbonate wala mishran is naam se nahi jaana jaata, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: copper matte Cu2S tatha FeS ka pighla hua mishran hota hai - isse aage loha hata kar blister copper banta hai.

qe: The 'Bessemer Converter' used in copper metallurgy is used to produce:
qh: कॉपर धातुकर्म में प्रयुक्त 'बेसेमर परिवर्तक' किसका उत्पादन करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bessemer converter mein copper matte ko hawa ke zariye oxid kiya jaata hai; isse loha ka sulfide oxid hokar silica ke saath gaadha banata hai tatha tamba ka sulfide oxid hokar drav tamba (blister copper) deta hai. Blister copper ka naam isliye pada ki uski satah par SO2 gas ke bulble nikal jaane se chilte (blister) bante hain; iske ulat shudh tamba (electrolytic copper) aage ke padav mein milta hai. Iske ulat bina oxid kiye tamba ya uske mishran is converter se nahi nikalte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Bessemer converter mein copper matte se blister copper banta hai - uski satah par SO2 ke bulble se chilte pad jaate hain, isliye ye naam pada.

qe: Which process is used to purify 'Blister Copper' to 99.9% purity?
qh: 'ब्लिस्टर कॉपर' को 99.9% शुद्धता तक शुद्ध करने के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Blister copper mein 98-99 pratishat tamba hota hai tatha uske saath sone, chandi tatha anya ashudhiyaan mili hoti hain; ushe 99.9 pratishat se bhi shudh banane ke liye vidyut shuddhikaran (electrolytic refining) kiya jaata hai. Ismein shudh tamba cathode par jama hota hai tatha ashudhiyaan ya to ghul (electrolyte) mein chali jaati hain ya gaadha (anode mud) ban jaati hain - isi gaadhe se sone tatha chandi jaisi keemti dhaatuen bhi milti hain. Iske ulat liquation ya zone refining yahan kaam nahi karti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: blister copper ko 99.9% se bhi shudh banane ke liye electrolytic refining vidhi istemal hoti hai - ismein cathode par shudh tamba jama hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Flux' added to remove Iron impurity during copper smelting?
qh: तांबे के प्रगलन (smelting) के दौरान लोहे की अशुद्धियों को हटाने के लिए कौन सा 'गालक' मिलाया जाता है?
e: Copper smelting mein ayask se mila loha oxide (FeO) tamba ko bhaunka tatha kamzor banata hai, isliye ushe hatane ke liye ret (sand, SiO2) daali jaati hai; ret us loha oxide ke saath judkar ek halka gaadha banati hai jo drav tamba ki satah par tair aata hai tatha alag kar diya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki flux ka chunav ashuddhi ke swabhaav par nirbhar karta hai - basic ashuddhi ke liye acidic flux (silica) sahi baithta hai. Iske ulat choona (limestone) tatha anya kshaariya flux yahan FeO ke liye upyukt nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: copper smelting mein loha ki ashuddhi (FeO) hatane ke liye ret (silica) daali jaati hai - ye milkar halka gaadha banati hai jo tamba se alag ho jaata hai.

qe: Which metal is obtained as a 'Byproduct' during the electrolytic refining of Copper?
qh: तांबे के विद्युत अपघटनी शोधन के दौरान कौन सी धातु उप-उत्पाद के रूप में प्राप्त होती है?
e: Tamba ke electrolytic shuddhikaran mein anode par ashuddh tamba tatha cathode par shudh tamba lagta hai; jab vidyut pravah hoti hai to anode ki ashudhiyaan to ghul mein chali jaati hain tatha sone (gold) tatha chandi (silver) jaisi keemti dhaatuen anode ke niche gaadha (anode mud) banakar jama ho jaati hain. Isi karan tamba shodhak (refinery) se sone tatha chandi up-utpad (byproduct) ke roop mein milte hain, jisse unka kharcha nikal aata hai; iske ulat zinc tatha nikal aise gaadhe mein nahi milte. Exam point: copper ke electrolytic shuddhikaran ke dauran sone tatha chandi up-utpad ke roop mein milte hain, jo anode mud mein jama ho jaate hain.

qe: What is the common name of the ore 'Malachite'?
qh: 'मैलाकाइट' (Malachite) अयस्क का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: Malachite (CuCO3.Cu(OH)2) ek hara (green) rang wala tamba ka ayask hai, isliye ise 'green copper ore' kehte hain; iska rang tamba ki satah par bani patina (halki hara parat) se milta-julta hai, jise purane mandir tatha Statue of Liberty par bhi dekha ja sakta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye tamba ka basic carbonate hota hai tatha ismein paani ke anu (crystal paani) bhi judte hain, isliye uski chamak tatha rang bhinn hota hai; isi karan ise gehne tatha rango ke liye bhi istemal karte the. Iske ulat azurite (nila) tatha cuprite (laal) isse alag rang wale ayask hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: malachite ka common naam green copper ore hai - yahi tamba ka hara basic carbonate ayask hota hai.

qe: Which Aluminum alloy is used for making 'Kitchen Utensils' because of its high corrosion resistance?
qh: उच्च संक्षारण प्रतिरोध के कारण रसोई के बर्तन बनाने के लिए किस एल्यूमीनियम मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Hindalium ek aluminium ki mishradhatu hai jismein aluminium ke saath magnesium tatha manganese mila hota hai; iska rang safed-chamakdar hota hai, isliye ise bartan (kitchen utensils) banane mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki aluminium par jaldi oxide ki parat ban jaati hai tatha ye khaane ke padarthon (khaTTe-padarth) se kriya nahi karta, isliye bartan saaf tatha tikau rehte hain; sath hi ye halka hone se sambhalna aasaan hota hai. Iske ulat peetal tatha stainless steel bhaari tatha mehange padte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bartan banane ke liye hindalium (aluminium ki mishradhatu) istemal hoti hai - kyunki ye halki tatha jang-rahit hoti hai.

qe: What is the percentage of Aluminum in 'Duralumin'?
qh: 'ड्यूरालिन' में एल्युमीनियम का प्रतिशत कितना होता है?
e: Duralumin mein aluminium ki matara lagbhag 95 pratishat hoti hai tatha baaki hissa tamba (copper, lagbhag 4 pratishat), magnesium tatha manganese ka hota hai; isi karan ye halki hone par bhi loha jaisi takat rakhti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aluminium kam ghanatva wala hota hai tatha milai gayi dhaatuen uski majbooti badha deti hain, isliye hawai jahaz ke dhaanche (frame) tatha rocket ke hisson mein iska istemal hota hai - yahan bhaar kam karna bahut zaroori hota hai. Peetal tatha kansa ka parivar alag hai, kyunki unmein aluminium ki matara lagbhag shunya hoti hai. Exam point: duralumin mein aluminium ki matara lagbhag 95% hoti hai tatha uske saath copper-magnesium-manganese - isi liye ye halki tatha mazboot mishradhatu hai.

qe: The 'Baeyer's Process' is used for:
qh: 'बेयर प्रक्रम' (Baeyer's Process) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
e: Baeyer ki vidhi bauxite (aluminium ka ayask) se silica tatha loha ki ashuddhi hatane ke liye istemal hoti hai; ismein ayask ko NaOH ke saath garam kiya jaata hai, jisse aluminium sodium aluminate banakar ghul jaata hai jabki ashudhiyaan avilep (insoluble) reh jaati hain. Iske baad ghole ko thanda tatha beejit (seeded) karne par shudh aluminium hydroxide jama hota hai, jise garam karke alumina milta hai - yahi aluminium nikalne ka pehla kadam hai. Iske ulat ise tamba ya loha shudh karne ki vidhi nahi kaha ja sakta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Baeyer ki vidhi bauxite ayask ke shuddhikaran ke liye istemal hoti hai, jismein NaOH se alumina alag kar liya jaata hai.

qe: In copper extraction, 'Poling' is used to remove:
qh: तांबे के निष्कर्षण में 'पोलिंग' (Poling) का उपयोग किसे हटाने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Tamba ke nishkarshan mein 'poling' wo kriya hai jismein pighle tamba mein hara (green) lakdi (pole) daal kar uski bhaap guzari jaati hai; lakdi ki bhaap tamba mein mile cuprous oxide (Cu2O) ko kanghi (reduce) karke shudh tamba bana deti hai tatha gasen bahar nikal jaati hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki Cu2O tamba ko bhaunka tatha vidyut ka kamzor chaalak banata hai, isliye ushe poora hatana zaroori hota hai - is ke bina tamba bijli ke taar ke liye upyukt nahi hota. Iske ulat sulfur tatha loha is kriya se nahi hate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: poling kriya se cuprous oxide (Cu2O) hatai jaati hai, jisse pighla tamba shudh tatha achha vidyut-chaalak ban jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Azurite' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'एज़ुराइट' (Azurite) क्या है?
e: Azurite (2CuCO3.Cu(OH)2) tamba ka basic carbonate ayask hai tatha iska rang gehra nila (blue) hota hai; ismein tamba ke saath carbonate tatha hydroxyl samooh hote hain, isliye ye 'basic copper carbonate' kehlata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein paani ke anu tatha CO2 dono judte hain, isse uska nila rang banta hai tatha ushe rang-tatha-chitrogi (painting) mein istemal karte the; iske ulat malachite (hara) ke saath ye joda joda banta hai. Iske ulat cuprite (Cu2O) isse alag, laal rang wala ayask hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: azurite tamba ka basic carbonate (nila rang wala) hota hai - isi karan ise blue copper ore bhi kehte hain.

qe: Which gas is responsible for the 'Blisters' in Blister Copper?
qh: ब्लिस्टर कॉपर में 'फफोले' (Blisters) पड़ने के लिए कौन सी गैस जिम्मेदार है?
e: Blister copper ki satah par bulble (blister) carbon dioxide se nahi balki sulfur dioxide (SO2) gas ke nikalne se bante hain, kyunki us dauran copper sulfide oxid hota hai tatha sulfur dioksaid banakar bahar nikalta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki conversion ke samay bacha hua sulfur oxygen se mil kar gas banta hai tatha drav dhaatu ki satah par jama hokar chhilte banata hai; isi karan is tamba ko blister copper kaha jaata hai. Iske ulat CO2 tatha H2S is kriya ke mukhya utpad nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: blister copper mein satah par bante chhilte (blisters) sulfur dioxide (SO2) gas ke nikalne se hote hain.

qe: What is 'Ruby Copper'?
qh: 'रूबी कॉपर' (Ruby Copper) क्या है?
e: Ruby copper (cuprite, Cu2O) tamba ka ek laal rang wala oxide ayask hai; ise ruby (panna) jaisa laal rang hone ke karan ruby copper kaha jaata hai tatha yahi tamba ka sabse shudh ayask bhi maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein sulfur ya anya ashuddhi kam hoti hai tatha tamba oxide ke roop mein hi hota hai, isliye isse tamba nikaalna aasaan hota hai; iske ulat chalcopyrite (CuFeS2) tatha malachite isse alag hote hain. Iske ulat ye tamba sulfate ya silicate nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ruby copper tamba ka oxide ayask cuprite (Cu2O) hota hai - iska laal rang tatha shudhta ise khaas banate hain.

qe: Aluminum is often used as a 'Reducing Agent' in the extraction of which metals?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम का उपयोग अक्सर किन धातुओं के निष्कर्षण में 'अपचायक' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Aluminium kanghi (reducing agent) ki tarah kaam kar sakta hai, isliye chromium tatha manganese jaisi dhaatuen nikaalne ke liye iska istemal hota hai - haalanki ye vidhi mehangi padti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aluminium ki oxygen ke saath lagav bahut adhik hoti hai, isliye wo oxide se oxygen kheench kar uncha-tapman wali dhaatu ko shudh roop mein chhod deta hai (is kriya ko thermite vidhi kehte hain). Iske ulat ise loha nikaalne ke liye aam taur par nahi lete, kyunki wahan coke sasta rasta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: chromium tatha manganese ke nishkarshan mein aluminium ko kanghi (reducing agent) ke roop mein istemal karte hain, kyunki ye uchch tapman par oxide se oxygen kheench leta hai.

qe: Which metal is most commonly found as a 'Native Element' (pure form) in geological deposits?
qh: भूवैज्ञानिक निक्षेपों में कौन सी धातु आमतौर पर 'मूल तत्व' (शुद्ध रूप) के रूप में पाई जाती है?
e: Gold (sona) hi wo dhaatu hai jo zameen ki satah par sabse adhik matara mein shudh (native) roop mein milta hai, kyunki uski rasayanik kriya-sheelata bahut kam hoti hai tatha wo hawa, paani tatha amlon se asar nahi leta. Isi karan nadon (rivers) ki ret (sand) mein chhote sone ke tukde (nugggets) milte hain tatha purane zamane mein yahi roop sabse aam tha; iske ulat loha tatha tamba hawa tatha paani se kriya karke oxide ban jaate hain. Iske ulat silver bhi shudh milta hai par gold se kam matara mein, isliye is prashn ka sahi jod gold hi hai. Exam point: bhu-geel (geological) satah par sabse adhik shudh roop mein milne wali dhaatu sona (gold) hai - kyunki ye kriya-sheel nahi hota tatha kharab nahi hota.

qe: The 'Serpeck’s Process' is used to purify bauxite containing which impurity?
qh: 'सर्पेक प्रक्रम' (Serpeck’s Process) का उपयोग किस अशुद्धि वाले बॉक्साइट को शुद्ध करने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Serpeck ki vidhi un bauxite ke liye kaam aati hai jinmein silica (SiO2) ki ashuddhi bahut zyada ho; aise ayask ko coke ke saath uchch tapman par garam kiya jaata hai, isse silica reduce hokar silicon ki bhaap ban jaata hai tatha aluminium nitride bachta hai, jise aage bhaap (jal) se kriya karaakar alumina paaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki umum vidhi (Bayer) silica wale bauxite par kam asar karti hai, isliye is mushkil ayask ke liye alag reeti lazmi ho jaati hai; isi tarah anya vidhiyan (Hall tatha Baeyer) sabhi ayaskon par kaam nahi karti. Iske ulat ye bilkul bauxite ki shuddhta nahi hai, keval silika-ashuddhi hata ne ke liye khas javab hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Serpeck ki vidhi silika wale bauxite ke liye upyukt hai - ismein ayask ko coke ke saath uchch tapman par garam karke silica alag kiya jaata hai.

qe: Which metal is the 'Lightest' of all solid elements and is essential for electric vehicle batteries?
qh: सभी ठोस तत्वों में कौन सी धातु सबसे 'हल्की' है और इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन बैटरी के लिए आवश्यक है?
e: Lithium sabse halka solid dhaatu hai (aghanatva lagbhag 0.53 g/cm3) tatha uski kitni hi lagbhag 20 mahine tak ikatha nahi, isliye ye ikhlaqi (light) tatha tez chalan karne wale bijli-vahan (battery) ke liye sabse upyukt dhaatu hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki lithium-ion battery mein lithium ka sangeh (ions) ek ion se dusara ion tak turant pahunchte hain, isse charge tezi se bhar tatha karak bhara ja sakta hai; isi liye mobile, laptop tatha electric gaadi mein yahi battery lagti hai. Iske ulat loha tatha tamba bhaari hone ke karan ye laabh nahi de paate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sabse halka tatha electric vehicle battery ke liye zaroori solid dhaatu lithium hai.

qe: What is the 'Kroll Process' used to extract?
qh: 'क्रोल प्रक्रम' (Kroll Process) का उपयोग किसके निष्कर्षण के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Kroll vidhi mein titanium ke ayask (rutile) ko pehle chlorine ke saath kriya karaakar titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4) banaya jaata hai; ushe shudhh karne ke baad magnesium ke saath uchch tapman par kanghi (reduce) kiya jaata hai, jisse titanium ki dhaatu tatha magnesium chloride milte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki titanium ko uske oxide se seedha carbon ki madad se nikaalna bahut mushkil hota hai, isliye is badi vidhi ka istemal hota hai; isi vidhi se bhariy arab tatha hawai jahaz ke liye shudh titanium milta hai. Iske ulat ye aluminium ya tamba nikaalne ki vidhi nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Kroll vidhi se titanium nikaala jaata hai - ismein TiCl4 ko magnesium se kanghi (reduce) kiya jaata hai.

qe: Which allotrope of Sulfur is stable at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर सल्फर का कौन सा अपररूप स्थायी होता है?
e: Sulfur ke do prachlit pratyaroop (allotropes) hote hain - rhombic (octahedral) tatha monoclinic (prismatic); 95.6 degree C se niche ka tapman, yani saadharan kamre ka tapman, rhombic sulfur ke liye sthir hota hai. Isi karan thanda sulfur peela tatha kathor krysTal `rhombic` roop mein milta hai tatha ushe pighla kar thanda karne par alag roop (monoclinic) ban sakta hai; dono ke ghanatva tatha aakaar alag hote hain. Iske ulat plastic sulfur tatha white phosphorus (phosphorus ka pratyaroop) is prashn ke uttar nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sadharan tapman par sulfur ka sthir pratyaroop rhombic sulfur hota hai - 95.6 degree C se upar monoclinic ban jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Transition Temperature' of Sulfur?
qh: सल्फर का 'संक्रमण तापमान' (Transition Temperature) क्या है?
e: Sulfur ka rhombic tatha monoclinic roop ka tapman ke saath parivartan ek nishchit bindu par hota hai, jise transition temperature kehte hain; ye tapman lagbhag 95.6 degree C hota hai. Is tapman se niche rhombic sthir rehta hai tatha usse upar monoclinic, isliye ise sulfur ke pratyaroopon ke beech ka 'badlav bindu' kaha jaata hai; isi tam ka pata karne se ye samjha ja sakta hai ki garam sulfur kis roop mein hoga. Iske ulat 119 degree C par sulfur pighalta hai tatha 444 degree C par ukbalta hai, isliye wo aankde transition temperature nahi hain. Exam point: sulfur ka transition temperature 95.6 degree C hota hai - isi tapman par rhombic sulfur monoclinic mein badal jaata hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in 'Vulcanization' to make rubber tougher for rugged road conditions?
qh: खराब सड़कों की स्थिति के लिए रबर को अधिक सख्त बनाने हेतु 'वल्कनीकरण' में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Kharab sadak tatha tirchhe mausam ke liye rabar ko tikau banane ke liye usmein sulfur mila kar tapaya jaata hai (vulcanization); isse anu-shrankhlaon ke beech sulfur ke pul ban jaate hain tatha rabar ghisav tatha ushma ko sahne lagta hai. Isi jodne se rabar garmi mein naram nahi padta tatha sadak ki ragad (friction) tatha bhaar ko sahan karta hai, isliye truck tatha tractor ke tyre isi se bante hain. Iske ulat phosphorus tatha carbon ye gun nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: kharab sadak tatha kharab mausam ke liye rabar ko mazboot tatha ghisav-sahishnu banane ke liye sulfur (vulcanization) istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'White Phosphorus' stored in to prevent it from catching fire spontaneously?
qh: 'सफेद फास्फोरस' को स्वतः आग पकड़ने से रोकने के लिए किसमें संग्रहीत किया जाता है?
e: White (peela-safed) phosphorus hawa ki oxygen se itna kriya-sheel hota hai ki hawa mein rakhne par apne aap jal uthta hai, isliye ushe paani ke andar doobaa kar rakha jaata hai - paani ushe hawa tatha oxygen se alag kar deta hai. Isi karan ise kaat-tarash (cutting) karne ke samay bhi paani ke andar hi kaam karte hain tatha ushe kabhi kholi (nangi) hawa mein nahi chhodte; iske ulat red phosphorus hawa mein sthir rehta hai tatha ushe paani mein rakhna zaroori nahi hai. Iske ulat tel ya kerosene (koyle ke tel) mein rakhne se oxygen to rukti hai par uske saath kriya ka khatra rehta hai, isliye sahi tarika paani hi hai. Exam point: white phosphorus ko paani mein dabakar rakha jaata hai, taaki wo hawa ki oxygen se kriya karke apne aap aag na pakad le.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Surgical Implants' because it is bio-compatible and does not corrode in the body?
qh: 'सर्जिकल इम्प्लांट्स' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह बायो-कम्पैटिबल है और शरीर में संक्षारित नहीं होती है?
e: Titanium ka ek bada gun yahi hai ki wo jeev-sharir ke saath santulit (bio-compatible) rehta hai tatha uske saath kriya nahi karta - yani usse allergic ya zehirila asar nahi hota, isliye asli haddi ke joda (joint), dant ke implant tatha dil ke valve mein titanium ka istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki titanium par oxide ki patli sthir parat ban jaati hai tatha sharir ki taral (fluid) ushe kharab nahi karti, isliye body saajish (implant) sal-ha-saal chalte hain; iske ulat sasta tamba tatha steel sharir ke saath kriya kar sakte hain. Iske ulat isi karan titanium ke ojaar halke bhi hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sharir ke andar rakhe jane wale surgical implants ke liye titanium istemal hota hai, kyunki ye bio-compatible hota hai tatha sharir mein jang nahi hota.

qe: Which allotrope of Carbon is used as a 'Dry Lubricant' in heavy machinery?
qh: भारी मशीनरी में 'सूखे स्नेहक' (Dry Lubricant) के रूप में कार्बन के किस अपररूप का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Graphite carbon ka wo pratyaroop hai jismein paratein (layers) hoti hain tatha unke beech kamjor bandhan hone se parate aapas mein aasaani se sarak jaati hain; yahi gun ushe chikna (slippery) banata hai tatha ise 'dry lubricant' ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki bhaari machinery mein tel ya grease lagana kai baar mushkil ya ganda hota hai, isliye graphite ki patli parat ko firz (furnace), turbine tatha lock-chabi mein istemal karte hain - yahan ye uchch tapman par bhi jal nahi jaata. Iske ulat heera tatha fullerene chikne nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bhaari machinery mein sukhe snigdhak (dry lubricant) ke roop mein graphite istemal hota hai, kyunki uski paratein sarak kar chikahat dete hain.

qe: What is 'Steel' with a high percentage of Nickel and Chromium called?
qh: निकेल और क्रोमियम के उच्च प्रतिशत वाले 'स्टील' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Jab steel mein nikal tatha chromium dono ki matara badha di jaati hai to ushe stainless steel kaha jaata hai; chromium dhaatu ki satah par apne aap ek rakshak parat banata hai tatha nikal ushe majbooti deta hai. Isi karan bartan, aspataal ke ojaar tatha khidki ke chaukhat aadi isi steel se bante hain - ye garam tatha khaane ke padarthon se bhi kriya nahi karta tatha chamakdar bana rehta hai. Iske ulat carbon steel mein ye gun nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: nikal tatha chromium ki adhik matara wali steel ko stainless steel kehte hain - isi karan ye jang-rahit tatha majboot hoti hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Mobile Phone' capacitors and is often called 'Blood Mineral' due to mining conflicts?
qh: मोबाइल फोन के कैपेसिटर में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है जिसे खनन संघर्षों के कारण अक्सर 'ब्लड मिनरल' कहा जाता है?
e: Tantalum ek dhaatu hai jo capacitor (vidyut sangehak) mein istemal hoti hai, kyunki iski satah par oxide ki bahut patli parat banti hai jo moti sangeh-kshamata deti hai; isliye mobile phone, laptop tatha camera ke chhote capacitor isi dhaatu se bante hain. Iska ek dukhad pahlu yahi hai ki iska ayask coltan Congo jaisi jagahon mein milta hai tatha wahan iske khanan par jhagde tatha balatkar (violence) hone ke karan ise 'blood mineral' kaha jaata hai; isi karan 'conflict free' mineral ki maang badh rahi hai. Iske ulat sone tatha tamba kapasitor ke liye yahi khaas gun nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: mobile capacitor mein istemal hone wali dhaatu tantalum (coltan se) hoti hai - ise khanan ke jhagde ke karan 'blood mineral' kehte hain.

qe: Which non-metal is used in the 'Haber Process' for synthesizing Ammonia for fertilizers?
qh: उर्वरकों के लिए अमोनिया संश्लेषण की 'हैबर प्रक्रिया' में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Haber vidhi mein nitrogen tatha hydrogen ko uchch dabav tatha tapman par utprek (catalyst) ki upasthiti mein mila kar ammonia (NH3) banaaya jaata hai; yahi ammonia aage se urea tatha anya khaad (fertilizers) bante hain, isliye nitrogen is prashn ka jod hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki hawa mein nitrogen ki matara bahut adhik (78 pratishat) hai tatha ye ammonia ka mukhya tatva hai; iske ulat oxygen tatha CO2 is kriya ke krmaak nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Haber vidhi mein ammonia (khaad) banana ke liye nitrogen non-metal ka istemal hota hai - hawa se yahi nitrogen liya jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Babbitt Metal' primarily used for?
qh: 'बैबिट मेटल' (Babbitt Metal) मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Babbitt metal ek mishradhatu hai jismein tin, antimony, tamba tatha sisa jaisi dhaatuen mili hoti hain; iski khaas baat yahi hai ki ye naram (soft) hoti hai tatha usmein ghisav kam hota hai, isliye ise engine ke bearings (dhaatu pads) mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki bearing mein ghisav tatha ushma sahan karne ke liye narm par takatwar parat chahiye, jisse crank-shaft aasaani se ghum sake tatha ghisaav kam ho; iske ulat peetal tatha steel itne narm nahi hote. Iske ulat bhaari machine tatha karkhana ki ghanti isi se banti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Babbitt metal ka mukhya istemal engine ke bearings mein hota hai - kyunki ye naram tatha ghisav-sahishnu mishradhatu hoti hai.

qe: Which gas is evolved when 'Zinc' reacts with concentrated Sulfuric Acid?
qh: जब 'जिंक' सांद्र सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करता है तो कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Zinc par saandrit (concentrated) sulfuric acid daalne par ye salkar (salt) banata hai tatha sulfur dioksaid (SO2) gas ke tez dhuan wala nikalta hai; isi karan ye kriya zinc ki pehchaan ke liye bhi istemal hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki zinc todh (strong) dhaatu hai tatha H2SO4 ushe oxid karke SO2 banata hai, jabki patla (dilute) H2SO4 se zinc hydrogen gas deta hai - isi karan acid ki matara ka dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai. Iske ulat hydrogen tatha oxygen SO2 ke saath nahi nikalte, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi.
