Exam point: zinc tatha saandrit sulfuric acid ki kriya se sulfur dioxide (SO2) gas nikalta hai, jabki patla acid se hydrogen nikalta hai.

qe: The 'Hope’s Apparatus' is related to the study of which property of water?
qh: 'होप का उपकरण' (Hope's Apparatus) पानी के किस गुण के अध्ययन से संबंधित है?
e: Hope ka yantra paani ke asaadharan prasaar (anomalous expansion) ke gun ka adhyayan karne ke liye istemal hota hai; ismein paani ko chhote-chhote tapman-antar par thanda karke ye dekha jaata hai ki 4 degree C par uska ghanatva sabse adhik hota hai tatha tapman badhne ya ghatne par wo failta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paani ka ye gun barf tairne tatha 4 degree C par talab ke neeche jeevon ke bache rehne ka bhi kaaran hai; iske ulat ye yaantra tapman maapne ya vidyut ke liye nahi hai. Iske ulat ushma-chaalakta ka pramaan bhi is yantra se mool roop se nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Hope ka yantra paani ke asaadharan prasaar (anomalous expansion, 4 degree C par adhiktam ghanatva) ke gun se juda hai.

qe: Which metal is used to make 'Permanent Magnets' (Alnico)?
qh: 'स्थायी चुंबक' (Alnico) बनाने के लिए किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Alnico ek mishradhatu hai jismein aluminium (Al), nikal (Ni) tatha cobalt (Co) mukhya hote hain tatha uska naam in teeno dhaatuon ke aarambhik aksharon se bana hai; ise pakke chumbak (permanent magnets) banane ke liye istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mishran chaumbakta ko lamba banaaye rakhti hai tatha uchch tapman par bhi kamzor nahi padti, isliye speaker, motor tatha gaadi bhramak (magnetos) mein iska istemal hota hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha loha wale mishran aise pakke chumbak nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pakke chumbak (permanent magnet) banane ke liye alnico mishradhatu istemal hoti hai, jismein aluminium, nikal tatha cobalt mukhya hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of the oxide of Aluminum ($Al_2O_3$)?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम के ऑक्साइड ($Al_2O_3$) की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Aluminium oxide (Al2O3) ek ubhay-bhaavi (amphoteric) oxide hai, kyunki ye aml tatha kshaar dono ke saath kriya karke lavan deta hai - HCl ke saath aluminium chloride tatha NaOH ke saath sodium aluminate banata hai. Isi karan aluminium ke bartan khatte tatha kshaariya dono padarthon se dheere-dheere kharab ho sakte hain, isliye un par oxide ki parat raksha karti hai; isi karan alumina ko ubhay-bhaavi oxide ka saaf udaharan maana jaata hai. Iske ulat ye keval amliya (acidic) ya keval kshaariya (basic) nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium oxide (Al2O3) ek amphoteric (ubhay-bhaavi) oxide hai - ye aml tatha kshaar dono se kriya karke lavan banata hai.

qe: Which element is used as a 'Shield' against X-rays and Gamma rays in hospitals?
qh: अस्पतालों में एक्स-रे और गामा किरणों से बचाव के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग 'शील्ड' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: X-ray tatha gamma-ray chhabi (radiographs) leta samay sharir se bahar nikalne wali kirnon ko rokne ke liye sisa (lead) ka apron tatha shield istemal karte hain, kyunki lead ka ghanatva adhik hone ke karan ye kirnein usmein se aasaani se nahi nikal paati. Yahi karan hai ki X-ray room ki deewarein bhi lead ki patli parat se dhaki hoti hain tatha radio-active padarth ko bhi sisa ke dibbe mein rakha jaata hai; iske ulat aluminium tatha tamba in kirnon ko poori tarah nahi rok paate. Iske ulat lead ki zehira hone ke baavjud iska yahi upyog sabse aam hai, isliye ise savdhani se sambhalna padta hai. Exam point: hospital mein X-ray tatha gamma-ray se bachav ke liye sisa (lead) ka shield istemal hota hai, kyunki iska ghanatva in kirnon ko rok deta hai.

qe: What is 'Wood's Metal' known for?
qh: 'वुड्स मेटल' (Wood's Metal) किसके लिए जाना जाता है?
o: Having an extremely low melting point
e: Wood's metal ek aisi mishradhatu hai jiska galaank bahut kam (lagbhag 70 degree C) hota hai, kyunki usmein bismuth, sisa, tin tatha cadmium aise anupat mein milte hain jo galaank ko gira dete hain; yahi uski pehchaan hai. Isi karan ise aag-bujhaane wale shower (sprinkler) ki cap tatha bhaap bhatti ki suraksha valve mein istemal karte hain - jab aag ya ushma badh jaati hai to ye pighal kar paani ka raasta khol deta hai. Iske ulat iska upyog kathor katai ke ojaar ya taar banane mein nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Wood's metal apne atyant kam galaank (lagbhag 70 degree C) ke liye jaana jaata hai - isi liye ye aag-bujhaane wale suraksha valve mein kaam aata hai.

qe: Which mineral found in pegmatite rocks is a source of Lithium and Beryllium?
qh: पेगमाटाइट चट्टानों में पाया जाने वाला कौन सा खनिज लिथियम और बेरिलियम का स्रोत है?
e: Lepidolite ek mika (mica) jaisa mineral hai jo pegmatite chattanon mein paaya jaata hai tatha ismein lithium tatha beryllium jaisi halki dhaatuen milti hain; yahi karan hai ki ise in dhaatuon ka srot maana jaata hai. Iska mahatva aaj isliye badh gaya hai ki lithium battery tatha beryllium ke mishran (aerospace) ke liye zaroori hain tatha unka khanan lepidolite tatha spodumene se hota hai; iske ulat ismein tamba, loha ya sone mukhya roop se nahi hote. Isliye lithium tatha beryllium ka srot hone ke karan yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: pegmatite chattanon mein milne wala lepidolite mineral lithium tatha beryllium ka srot hota hai - isi karan ye aaj bahut mahatvapurn hai.

qe: Which element is known as the 'Metal of Hope' because of its role in future green energy?
qh: भविष्य की हरित ऊर्जा में भूमिका के कारण किस तत्व को 'आशा की धातु' (Metal of Hope) के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Lithium ko 'metal of hope' kaha jaata hai, kyunki green energy (harit urja) tatha bijli se chalne wale vahan (electric vehicles) ki battery ke liye yahi dhaatu sabse zaroori hai; yahi karan hai ki duniya bhar mein lithium ke khanan tatha ayask (spodumene tatha lepidolite) par zor diya ja raha hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki lithium battery ka bhaar kam hota hai tatha wo jaldi charge hoti hai, isliye ye paryavaran ke liye saaf aane wali urja ka aadhaar maani jaati hai; iske ulat loha tatha tamba aane wali takneek mein nahi aa paate. Iske ulat ye 'blood mineral' jaisa vivaadit nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lithium ko metal of hope kehte hain, kyunki bhavishy ki green energy tatha electric vehicle battery ke liye yahi mukhya dhaatu hai.

qe: What is 'Promethium' unique for in the Lanthanide series?
qh: लैंथेनाइड श्रृंखला में 'प्रोमेथियम' (Promethium) की क्या विशेषता है?
o: It is found in gold mines
It is the only radioactive lanthanide
e: Promethium lanthanide shrankhla (series) ka ekmatr aisa tatva hai jo sadharan taur par radio-active hota hai; ismein koi sthir samsthanik (stable isotope) nahi hota, isliye ye lambe samay tak prakritik roop mein nahi tikta. Isi karan iska istemal vishesh jagahon par hota hai, jaise purane ghadion tatha machine ke chhote bijli-srot (nuclear battery) tatha mote (coating) mein, aur ye chhabi (imaging) mein bhi kaam aata hai; iske ulat baaki lanthanide (jaise lanthanum, cerium) sthir hote hain. Iske ulat ye keval ek utpad (byproduct) nahi balki sabse bhari lanthanide hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lanthanide shrankhla mein promethium hi ekmatr radio-active tatva hai - isiliye iska istemal vishesh urja-srot tatha chhabi mein hota hai.

qe: Which metal is used as a 'Thermometer' fluid for measuring very high temperatures (up to 2000°C)?
qh: अत्यधिक उच्च तापमान (2000°C तक) मापने के लिए थर्मामीटर में किस तरल धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Gallium ki khaas baat yahi hai ki wo lagbhag 30 degree C par hi pighal jaata hai par uski ukbalan (boiling point) lagbhag 2400 degree C hoti hai; isi liye ye bahut uchch tapman tak drav (liquid) roop mein hi rehta hai. Isi karan ise thermometer mein bhar kar lagbhag 2000 degree C tak ka tapman maapa jaata hai, kyunki sadharan paara tatha anya drav itne uchch tapman par bhaap ban kar ud jaate hain; iske ulat paara 357 degree C par hi ukbal jaata hai. Iske ulat gallium vidyut ke paripath (semiconductor) tatha sOda (LED) mein bhi kaam aata hai, isliye ise keval thermometer ka padarth samajhna galat hoga. Exam point: bahut uchch tapman (lagbhag 2000 degree C) maapne wale thermometer mein gallium drav istemal hota hai, kyunki ye kam tapman par pighalta hai par uchch tapman tak drav rehta hai.

qe: Which 'Rare Earth' element is used to make the strongest permanent magnets (Neo-magnets)?
qh: सबसे मजबूत स्थायी चुंबक (नियो-मैग्नेट) बनाने के लिए किस 'दुर्लभ मृदा' तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Neodymium (Nd) ek 'rare earth' (durlabh mitti) tatva hai jise loha tatha boron ke saath mila kar 'neodymium magnet' (neomagnet) banaaya jaata hai; ye duniya ka sabse mazboot pakka chumbak (permanent magnet) maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iski chumbakiya sajaavat bahut choti par kathin (hard magnetic) hone ke karan bade chumbak wahi kheenchav deti hai, isliye ise speaker, hard disk, earbud aur wall-clock jaisi choti-cheejon mein lagate hain - jahan halka par prabal chumbak chahiye. Iske ulat loha-chumbak (soft iron) tatha alnico itni jagah tatha itni takat nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sabse mazboot pakka chumbak (neo-magnet) banane ke liye neodymium (rare earth) istemal hota hai - isi karan ye aaj bijli tatha motor ke saman mein itna aam hai.

qe: Which mineral is known as 'Mineral Silk'?
qh: किस खनिज को 'खनिज रेशम' (Mineral Silk) के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Asbestos (ek prakar ka silikat mineral) ko 'mineral silk' kehte hain, kyunki iske resh (fibres) resham jaisi baareek, lachakdar tatha misrya ho jaate hain; ise bunka ja sakta hai tatha kai padarthon mein milaya ja sakta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iske resh ushma-tatha-aag ko rokne wale (refractory) hote hain, isliye purane zamane mein ushe ushma-rokav (insulation), aspataal ke pardey tatha chhat ke bhaar ke liye istemal karte the - par ab isse cancer ka khatra maankar iska upyog bahut seemit ho gaya hai. Iske ulat mica paratdar par bhi chamakdar hoti hai, par uske resh resham jaisi sugdhta nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 'mineral silk' ka naam asbestos mineral ka hai, kyunki uske resh resham jaisi sugdhta wale hote hain - par isse cancer ka khatra hone se aaj ye seemit hai.

qe: What is the primary use of 'Pyrolusite' ore?
qh: 'पाइरोलुसाइट' (Pyrolusite) अयस्क का प्राथमिक उपयोग क्या है?
e: Pyrolusite (MnO2) manganese ka pramukh ayask hota hai, isliye isse manganese dhaatu nikaali jaati hai; manganese steel ke banane ke liye zaroori hai, kyunki ye loha ko kathor tatha ghisav-sahishnu banata hai (jaise patari ke jod tatha helmet). Iska karan yahi hai ki manganese dhaatu ke saath-saath is ayask ka istemal dry cell tatha kaanch ko rang-hin (decolourise) karne mein bhi hota hai, kyunki usmein oxygen ka asar rang par padta hai. Iske ulat ye tamba, loha ya aluminium ka ayask nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pyrolusite ayask se manganese dhaatu nikaali jaati hai - yahi steel tatha dry cell ke liye zaroori dhaatu hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Surgical Staples' because it is highly resistant to body fluids and non-magnetic?
qh: सर्जिकल स्टेपल में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह शरीर के तरल पदार्थों के प्रति अत्यधिक प्रतिरोधी और गैर-चुंबकीय है?
e: Tantalum ek aisi dhaatu hai jo sharir ki taral (body fluids) se kriya nahi karti tatha chumbakiya (non-magnetic) bhi hoti hai, isliye ise shaly-chikitsa (surgery) ke staples, haddi ke plate tatha chhote implant mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye dhaatu MRI jaisi chumbakiya chhabi ke samay kheenchav ya garam nahi hoti tatha sharir mein jang nahi lagti, isliye rogi ke liye ye surakshit hoti hai; iske ulat loha tatha nikal chumbakiya hote hain. Iske ulat titanium bhi bio-compatible hai, par staples ke liye tantalum ka non-magnetic hona zyada zaroori hota hai. Exam point: surgical staples tatha implant mein tantalum ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye sharir ki taral se kriya nahi karta tatha non-magnetic hota hai.

qe: Which form of 'Coal' is considered the highest grade with the most Carbon content?
qh: कोयले का कौन सा रूप सबसे उच्च श्रेणी का माना जाता है जिसमें कार्बन की मात्रा सबसे अधिक होती है?
e: Anthracite koyle ka sarvochch (highest) koti wala roop hai, ismein carbon ki matara 86-97 pratishat tak hoti hai tatha usmein nami tatha vaaspasheel padarth bahut kam hote hain; isi karan ye sabse achha tatha sabse saaf jalne wala koyla maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki adhik carbon tatha kam ashuddhi hone se iski ushma (calorific value) sabse adhik hoti hai tatha dhuan bhi kam nikalta hai, isliye ise ghar tatha bhatti mein istemal karte hain; iske ulat peat tatha lignite mein carbon kam hota hai. Iske ulat bituminous koyla beech darje ka hota hai, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: koyle ka sarvochch koti wala roop anthracite hai, jismein carbon ki matara sabse adhik (86-97%) hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Pitchblende' an ore of?
qh: 'पिचब्लेंड' (Pitchblende) किसका अयस्क है?
e: Pitchblende (uraninite) uranium ka pramukh ayask hai; isi se uranium dhaatu nikaali jaati hai, jise nabhik (nuclear) reactor ke indhan tatha hetu (weapon) ke liye istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein uranium oxide (U3O8) ke saath radium bhi mili hoti hai, isliye Marie Curie ne radium tatha polonium ki khoj isi ayask se ki thi; isi karan yahi ayask itihaas mein bahut mahatvapurn maana jaata hai. Iske ulat ye loha, tamba ya thorium ka ayask nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pitchblende ayask uranium ka hota hai - ismein radium bhi milta hai tatha yahi nabhik indhan ka mukhya srot hai.

qe: Which element is used to make 'Yellow' color in fireworks?
qh: आतिशबाजी में 'पीला' रंग बनाने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aag-baaji (fireworks) mein peela rang dene ke liye sodium ke lavan (jaise sodium nitrate) istemal hote hain, kyunki sodium garam hokar haldi-peeli roshni chhodta hai; yahi karan hai ki sodium wale bulb tatha street lamp ka rang peela dikhta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki har dhaatu apna khaas rang deti hai (spectrum), isliye rang chunne ke liye alag-alag lavan milaaye jaate hain - sodium se peela, barium se hara, tatha strontium se laal. Iske ulat tamba tatha calcium alag rang dete hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: aag-baaji mein peela rang sodium dhaatu ke lavan se aata hai - kyunki ye jalte samay haldi-peeli roshni deta hai.

qe: Which mineral is famous for its 'Perfect Cleavage' and sheets?
qh: कौन सा खनिज अपने 'उत्कृष्ट विदलन' (Perfect Cleavage) और परतों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Mica ek aisa mineral hai jismein paratein (sheets) bahut patli tatha aapas mein aasaani se alag hone layak hoti hain; isi gun ko 'perfect cleavage' kehte hain tatha isi karan iske patle-chaure tukde (sheets) aasaani se milte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki mica vidyut tatha ushma ka kharab chaalak (insulator) hota hai tatha lamba tapman sahta hai, isliye ise bijli ke taaron ke insulation, bhatti ki khidki tatha purane itihaas ke khade tasveer-tantra mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat quartz tatha asbestos mein aise alag hone wali paratein nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: apni perfect cleavage (patli paratein) ke liye mica mineral puraane zamane se jaana jaata hai - isi karan ise vidyut tatha ushma ke isolator mein istemal karte hain.

qe: Which heavy metal poisoning leads to 'Blue lines' on the gums (Burton's lines)?
qh: किस भारी धातु की विषाक्तता से मसूड़ों पर नीली रेखाएं (बर्टन्स लाइन्स) बन जाती हैं?
e: Sisa (lead) ke lambe samay tak sampark mein rehne par muh ke masoodon (gums) par neeli-safed lakeerein dikhti hain, jinhe Burton's lines kehte hain; yahi safed sisa sulfie (lead sulfide) ka jamaav hoti hai tatha sisa-zehira (plumbism) ka pehla sanket hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sisa khoon mein jama hokar kamzori, pet dard, anaemia tatha mastishk ki samasya paida karta hai; isi karan paint, purani battery tatha mishrit sisa wale aadmi ki jaanch zaroori hoti hai. Iske ulat paara tatha cadmium alag bimariyan (Minamata tatha Itai-Itai) dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Burton's lines (gums par neeli-rekha) sisa (lead) ke zehira ka lakshan hoti hai - yahi plumbism ki pehchaan hai.

qe: What is 'Rutile' an ore of?
qh: 'रूटाइल' (Rutile) किसका अयस्क है?
e: Rutile (TiO2) titanium ka pramukh ayask hai, isliye isse titanium dhaatu nikaali jaati hai (Kroll vidhi se); titanium halka tatha jang-rahit hota hai, isliye hawai jahaz tatha sharir ke sajish (implant) mein istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki rutile safed rang ka prabal aavaran (opaque) padarth hai, isliye ise paint tatha sunscreen mein safed rang dene ke liye bhi istemal karte hain - isi karan ye ek hi ayask do kaam deta hai. Iske ulat bauxite aluminium ka tatha galena sisa ka ayask hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rutile (TiO2) titanium dhaatu ka ayask hai - isi se titanium nikaala jaata hai tatha safed rang banane mein bhi iska istemal hota hai.

qe: Which element is added to 'Gold' to make it 'Rose Gold'?
qh: 'रोज़ गोल्ड' (Rose Gold) बनाने के लिए सोने में कौन सा तत्व मिलाया जाता है?
e: Rose gold (gulabi sone) mein sone ke saath tamba (copper) milaya jaata hai, kyunki tamba sone ko gulabi-laal rang deta hai; jitna adhik tamba hoga utna gehra gulabi rang milta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sone (asli rang peela) ke saath tamba milane par uske rang ka rang-badal (hue) gulabi ho jaata hai tatha uski kathorata bhi badh jaati hai, isliye gehne tatha anguthiyan isi mishran se banai jaati hain. Iske ulat chandi tatha palladium sone ko safed rang dete hain (white gold), isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: sone ko gulabi rang dene ke liye usmein tamba (copper) milaya jaata hai - isi mishran ko rose gold kehte hain.

qe: Which metal is used for 'Silvering' of mirrors?
qh: दर्पणों के 'सिल्वरिंग' (परावर्तक परत चढ़ाने) के लिए किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Darpan par chandni chadhane (silvering) ke liye purane zamane mein chandi (silver) ka istemal hota tha, kyunki chandi achhi chamakdar parat deti hai; par aajkal aluminium ka istemal zyada hota hai, kyunki wo sasta hota hai tatha hawa mein bhi theek rehta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye dono dhaatuen light ko achhi tarah paravartit karti hain, isliye inhe 'silvering' ke liye upyukt maana jaata hai - isliye is prashn ka sahi jod ye dono (silver tatha aluminium) hain. Iske ulat loha tatha tamba hawa se kriya karke apni chamak kho dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: darpan par chandni chadhane (silvering) ke liye silver tatha aluminium dono ka istemal hota hai - silver purana tatha aluminium aaj ka sasta tareeka hai.

qe: What is the 'Hardest' synthetic material made by man, often used to coat metal drills?
qh: मनुष्य द्वारा बनाया गया सबसे 'कठोर' सिंथेटिक पदार्थ कौन सा है, जिसका उपयोग धातु की ड्रिल पर लेप चढ़ाने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Boron nitride (BN) ek manushya dwara banaya gaya padarth hai jo apni sajaavat tatha kathorata mein heere jaisa hota hai (cubic boron nitride); yahi karan hai ki ise dhaatu ke driller tatha katai ke ojaar (cutting tools) par patli parat ke roop mein chadhate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye uchch tapman par bhi apni kathorata bani rakhta hai tatha loha ke saath kriya nahi karta, isliye tez katai tatha garmi wale kaam mein ye heere se behtar padta hai; sath hi ye vidyut ka kharab chaalak hota hai. Iske ulat silicon carbide bhi kathor hai par tatha ushma mein kam sthir hota hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ka uttar nahi. Exam point: manushya dwara banaya gaya sabase kathor padarth boron nitride hai - ise drills tatha katai ke ojaar par parat ke roop mein chadhate hain.

qe: Which non-metal is used in 'Vulcanization' but also as a 'Fungicide' in agriculture?
qh: किस अधातु का उपयोग 'वल्कनीकरण' में होता है और कृषि में 'कवकनाशी' के रूप में भी किया जाता है?
e: Sulfur wo non-metal hai jo rabar ke vulcanization mein istemal hota hai tatha kheti mein fungus (phaphoond) ko maarne wali dawa (fungicide) ke roop mein bhi kaam aata hai; yahi karan hai ki angur tatha anya falon ke bagh mein ise bhaap (vapour) ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sulfur hawa mein halka hokar fungus ke liye zehirila asar deta hai tatha fasal ko sadne se bachaata hai - isi karan ise 'organic' kheti mein bhi istemal karte hain, kyunki ye jald hi toot jaata hai. Iske ulat phosphorus tatha nitrogen aise aam fungus-nashak nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vulcanization tatha fungus-nashak (fungicide) dono kaam ke liye sulfur ka istemal hota hai - kheti mein yahi aam sulfur wali dawa hai.

qe: Which metal is known as 'Quick Silver'?
qh: किस धातु को 'क्विक सिल्वर' कहा जाता है?
e: Paara (mercury) ko 'quick silver' kehte hain, kyunki ye kamre ke tapman par drav roop mein rehta hai tatha bahut tezi se badalta hai (chandni jaisi chamak ke saath); isi karan purane thermometer tatha barometer mein paara bhara jaata tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki paara sadharan tapman par drav hone se tapman ke saath failta-sikudta hai, isliye tapman ka naap aasaan ho jaata hai; par iski bhaap zehirila hone ke karan aaj iska upyog kam ho raha hai. Iske ulat loha tatha tamba kamre ke tapman par thos rehte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 'quick silver' ka naam paara (mercury) ka hai - yahi dhaatu kamre ke tapman par drav rehti hai tatha thermometer mein kaam aati hai.

qe: What is the composition of 'Gun Metal', traditionally used for making cannons and gears?
qh: 'गन मेटल' (Gun Metal) की संरचना क्या है, जिसका उपयोग पारंपरिक रूप से तोप और गियर बनाने के लिए किया जाता था?
e: Gun metal ek mishradhatu hai jismein tamba (copper) mukhya hota hai tatha uske saath tin (tin) tatha zinc mila hote hain; ise purane zamane mein taup (cannon) banane tatha gears tatha bearings banane ke liye istemal karte the. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mishran kathor, ghisav-sahishnu tatha dhamake ka jhatka sahne wali hoti hai, isliye ushe toop ke pipe tatha aise hisson ke liye upyukt maana jaata tha; iske ulat shudh tamba narm hota hai tatha jhatke mein mud jaata hai. Iske ulat ismein loha ya chromium mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: gun metal ki rachna mein tamba, tin tatha zinc mukhya hote hain - isi karan ye kathor tatha jhatka-sahishnu mishradhatu hoti hai.

qe: Which alloy is used to make 'Church Bells' due to its high sonority (ringing sound)?
qh: ध्वन्यात्मकता (गूंजने वाली ध्वनि) के कारण 'घंटियां' बनाने के लिए किस मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bell metal ek mishradhatu hai jismein tamba (copper) tatha tin (tin) mila hote hain; iski khaas baat yahi hai ki ghumne (strike) par ye bahut lamba tatha saaf naad (sonority) deti hai, isliye isse mandir ki ghantiyan tatha ghanti (church bells) banti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki tin ki matara tamba ke saath sahi anupat mein hone par dhaatu ki sajaavat aisi banti hai ki aawaz lambi der tak kaanpti rehti hai; iske ulat sadharan tamba tatha loha aawaz der tak nahi rakhte. Iske ulat ismein aluminium tatha nikal mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ghanti (church bells) banane ke liye tamba-tin wali bell metal istemal hoti hai, kyunki uski naad-kshamata (sonority) bahut adhik hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Anodic' reaction during the rusting of Iron?
qh: लोहे में जंग लगने के दौरान 'एनोडिक' प्रतिक्रिया क्या होती है?
e: Loha (iron) mein jang lagne ki shuruaat anodic kriya se hoti hai; yahan loha apne do electron chhodkar Fe2+ aayan ban jaata hai - yani kriya Fe se Fe2+ + 2e- hoti hai. Iske baad ye aayan paani tatha oxygen se milkar hydrated iron oxide (jang) banata hai, isliye ye abhikriya jang ka pehla tatha asli kadam hoti hai; uske ulat cathode par oxygen ka reduction hota hai (O2 + 2H2O + 4e- se 4OH-). Iske ulat isi karan loha ki satah se electron nikalne par hi aage ki kriya chal paati hai, isliye anodic kriya ka sahi roop yahi hai. Exam point: loha mein jang lagne ki anodic kriya Fe se Fe2+ + 2e- hoti hai - yahi loha ka oxid hokar aayan banna hai.

qe: Which Noble gas is used in 'MRI Scanners' to keep the superconducting magnets cool?
qh: सुपरकंडक्टिंग मैग्नेट को ठंडा रखने के लिए 'एमआरआई स्कैनर' में किस उत्कृष्ट गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: MRI scanner ke superconducting chumbak ko bahut thanda (lagbhag -269 degree C) rakhna padta hai, isliye usmein drav helium ka istemal hota hai; helium sadharan padarthon mein sabse kam tapman par drav hota hai tatha rasanik roop se nishkriya hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki helium bina jame drav bana reh sakta hai tatha bijli ke taaron ko thanda rakhkar unki pratirodhakta shunya karta hai, isliye chumbak ka asar sthir bana rehta hai; iske ulat nitrogen tatha argon itne kam tapman par drav nahi hote. Iske ulat isi karan helium ko 'shitalak' (coolant) ke roop mein rocket tatha particle-physics ke prayogon mein bhi istemal karte hain, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: MRI scanner ke superconducting chumbak ko thanda rakhne ke liye drav helium (noble gas) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye sabse kam tapman par drav hota hai.

qe: Which 'Rare Earth' element is used in the manufacturing of 'Glass Polishing' compounds?
qh: 'ग्लास पॉलिशिंग' यौगिकों के निर्माण में किस 'दुर्लभ मृदा' तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Cerium (ceria) ko kaanch ki polish (chamkane) tatha lense ki safai ke liye istemal karte hain, kyunki cerium oxide (CeO2) ek bahut baareek tatha kathor choora hai jo satah ko kharoch ke bina chamka deta hai; yahi karan hai ki ise 'jeweller's rouge' (laal polish) bhi kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki cerium rare earth hone ke saath-saath aasaani se oxide banata hai tatha loha ki tulna mein jaldi kharab nahi hota, isliye modern tv screen tatha mirror ki polish mein bhi iska istemal hota hai; iske ulat lanthanum tatha neodymium is kaam ke liye itne upyukt nahi hote. Iske ulat isi karan cerium ko catalyst tatha self-cleaning oven mein bhi istemal karte hain, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: kaanch tatha lens ki polish (polishing compound) ke liye cerium (ceria) rare earth ka istemal hota hai - ise jeweller's rouge bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is 'Constantan' (Eureka) alloy used for in physics labs?
qh: भौतिकी प्रयोगशालाओं में 'कॉन्स्टेंटन' (युरेका) मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Constantan (Eureka) ek mishradhatu hai jismein tamba (copper) tatha nikal (nikel) mila hota hai; iski sabse badi khaas baat yahi hai ki tapman badhne par uski vidyut-pratirodhakta (resistance) bahut kam badalti hai. Isi karan ise physics lab mein thermocouple ke taar tatha resistance box mein istemal karte hain, kyunki naap ka aankda tapman se kharab nahi hota; iske ulat manganin tatha nichrome ke gun alag hote hain. Iske ulat isi gun ke karan ye ushma-tapman ke bade antar par bhi vishwasniya rehta hai, isliye yahi is prashn ka sahi jod hai. Exam point: Constantan (Eureka) mishradhatu ka istemal thermocouple tatha resistance wires mein hota hai, kyunki iski pratirodhakta tapman ke saath lagbhag nahi badalti.

qe: Which metal is used as a 'Scavenger' in metallurgy to remove traces of Oxygen and Nitrogen from molten steel?
qh: पिघले हुए स्टील से ऑक्सीजन और नाइट्रोजन को हटाने के लिए धातुकर्म में किस धातु का उपयोग 'अपमार्जक' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Titanium ek prabal 'scavenger' (safai karne wala) dhaatu hai, isliye pighle steel mein se oxygen tatha nitrogen ke chhote hisse hatane ke liye iska istemal hota hai; ye dhaatu unke saath milkar gaadha (slag) bana deti hai tatha steel ko saaf kar deti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki titanium ki oxygen tatha nitrogen ke saath lagav bahut adhik hoti hai (yani uske oxide tatha nitride sthir hote hain), isliye woh unhe steel se kheench leta hai; iske ulat sasta aluminium tatha silicon bhi yahi kaam karte hain, par titanium zyada prabhavi maana jaata hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha loha khud hi ashuddhi hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pighle steel se oxygen tatha nitrogen ki ashuddhi hatane ke liye titanium ka 'scavenger' ke roop mein istemal hota hai - kyunki ye unke saath milkar gaadha banata hai.

qe: Which 'Non-metal' is used in 'Laser' technology (specifically in CO2 lasers)?
qh: 'लेजर' तकनीक में किस 'अधातु' का उपयोग किया जाता है (विशेष रूप से CO2 लेजर में)?
e: CO2 laser (carbon dioxide laser) mein carbon gas ka istemal hota hai, kyunki uske anuon (CO2) ki kampan (vibration) urja ko roshni ke roop mein badalna aasaan hota hai; yahi karan hai ki ye laser katai, welding tatha sharir-chikitsa (skin) mein bahut prachlit hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki CO2 ke anu ke paas teen atom hone se kai kampan-vidha (modes) hoti hain, isliye ye prabal tatha sasti infrared kirnein paida kar sakta hai; iske ulat helium tatha nitrogen iske saath gayak (helper) gas ke roop mein hote hain. Iske ulat neon tatha argon alag laser ke liye hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: CO2 laser mein carbon (CO2 ke roop mein) ka istemal hota hai - isi karan ye katai tatha chikitsa ki mahatvapurn laser hai.

qe: What is the primary constituent of 'Monel Metal'?
qh: 'मोनेल मेटल' (Monel Metal) का प्राथमिक घटक क्या है?
e: Monel metal ek mishradhatu hai jismein nikal (nikel) tatha tamba (copper) mukhya hote hain tatha thoda loha, manganese tatha silicon bhi mila hote hain; iska mukhya tatva nikal hi hai. Iski khaas baat yahi hai ki ye samudri paani, khaTTe padarthon tatha kai rasayano ke saath kriya nahi karta, isliye ise paani ke pump, chhote propeller tatha rasayanik bartan (vessels) mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat peetal tatha kansa mein nikal nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Monel metal ka mukhya tatva nikal tatha tamba hote hain - isi karan ye samudri paani tatha rasayano mein bhi tikta hai.

qe: Which metal is 'Passivated' by concentrated Nitric Acid ($HNO_3$)?
qh: सांद्र नाइट्रिक एसिड ($HNO_3$) द्वारा कौन सी धातु 'निष्क्रिय' (Passivated) हो जाती है?
e: Aluminium tatha loha dono ko saandrit (concentrated) nitric acid mein doobaya jaaye to uski satah par oxide ki patli tatha sthir parat ban jaati hai, jise 'passivation' kehte hain; iske baad acid unke bheetar tak nahi pahunchta tatha dhaatu aage kharab nahi hoti. Iska karan yahi hai ki HNO3 ek prabal oxid hai, isliye wo dhaatu ke saath turant rakshak parat bana deta hai - isi gun ki wajah se aluminium ke (sankh) tatha loha ke dibbe saandrit acid ke liye istemal hote hain. Iske ulat patla (dilute) acid mein ye parat nahi banti tatha dhaatu ghul jaati hai, isliye vahaan ye gun nahi dikhta. Exam point: saandrit nitric acid se aluminium tatha loha 'passive' ho jaate hain - yani unki satah par oxide ki rakshak parat ban jaati hai.

qe: Which element is used to provide 'Red' color in emergency flares and fireworks?
qh: आपातकालीन फ्लेयर्स और आतिशबाजी में 'लाल' रंग प्रदान करने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Emergency flares tatha fireworks mein laal rang dene ke liye strontium ke lavan (jaise strontium nitrate) istemal hote hain, kyunki strontium jalte samay gehra laal rang deta hai; isi karan aag-baaji mein laal rang ke liye yahi tatva chuna jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki har dhaatu ki roshni ka apna rang hota hai tatha ye rang sirf lavan ke jalne par hi milta hai, isliye rang vishesh ke liye vishesh lavan milaaye jaate hain - jaise sodium se peela tatha barium se hara. Iske ulat calcium tatha lithium anya rang dete hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke uttar nahi hain. Exam point: emergency flares tatha aag-baaji mein laal rang ke liye strontium ka istemal hota hai - yahi jalte samay gehra laal rang paida karta hai.

qe: What is 'Magnalium' composed of?
qh: 'मैग्नेलियम' (Magnalium) किससे बना होता है?
e: Magnalium ek halki mishradhatu hai jismein aluminium ke saath magnesium mila hota hai; magnesium ki matara se ye aluminium se adhik majboot ho jaati hai par bhaar kam hi rehta hai. Isi gun ke karan ise hawai jahaz ke dhaanche, range (balance beam) tatha halke saancho (moulds) mein istemal karte hain, kyunki jahaan halkapan chahiye wahan ye upyukt baithti hai; shudh aluminium narm pad jaata hai. Duralumin mein tamba tatha manganese bhi milaaye jaate hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: magnalium mein aluminium tatha magnesium milte hain - isi karan ye halki tatha majboot mishradhatu hai.

qe: Which non-metal is known as the 'Basis of Life' on Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी पर किस अधातु को 'जीवन का आधार' माना जाता है?
e: Carbon ko prithvi par jeevan ka 'aadhar' (basis of life) kaha jaata hai, kyunki sabhi jeevit shariron ke mukhya tatva - protein, fat, carbohydrate tatha DNA - carbon ke hi bane hote hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki carbon ki catenation (lambi shrankhla banana), tetravalency (chaar bandhan) tatha double-tripe bandhan banana ki kshamata hone se uske lakhon compound bante hain; isi karan rasayan-vigyan (organic chemistry) carbon ki hi rasiya hai. Iske ulat oxygen tatha nitrogen jeevan ke liye zaroori hain, par unke itne vividh tatha sthir compounds nahi bante, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: carbon ko jeevan ka aadhar kaha jaata hai, kyunki protein, fat, carbohydrate tatha DNA sabhi carbon ke bane hote hain.

qe: What is 'Type Metal' used in printing presses composed of?
qh: प्रिंटिंग प्रेस में प्रयुक्त 'टाइप मेटल' किससे बना होता है?
e: Type metal wo mishradhatu hai jismein sisa (lead), tin (tin) tatha antimony mila hota hai; ise printing press ke aksharon (type) banane ke liye istemal karte the, kyunki ye aasaani se pighalta hai tatha saancha likar apna aakaar sahi rakhta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tin tatha antimony sisa ke saath milkar ushe thoda kathor bana dete hain, isse akshar jaldi ghiste nahi tatha press ki bar-bar jhatka sahte hain; iske ulat shudh sisa bahut narm hota hai tatha jaldi ghista hai. Iske ulat ismein tamba ya chromium mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: printing ke type metal mein lead, tin tatha antimony hote hain - isi karan ye jaldi pighalta hai tatha akshar jaldi ghise nahi jaate.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Galvanic Cells' as the negative electrode (Anode)?
qh: 'गैल्वेनिक सेल' में नकारात्मक इलेक्ट्रोड (एनोड) के रूप में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Galvanic cell (vidyut-rasayanik cell) mein rin chhor (anode) ke roop mein zinc ka istemal hota hai, kyunki zinc loha se adhik kriya-sheel hota hai tatha aasaani se khud oxid hokar electron chhodta hai - yahi metal ka oxygen-kanghi (reducing) kaam karta hai. Isi karan ise loha par lep (galvanizing) ke roop mein bhi istemal karte hain, kyunki yahan zinc khud pehle kharab hota hai tatha loha ko bachaata hai (is kriya ko cathodic protection kehte hain). Iske ulat tamba tatha chandi kam kriya-sheel hote hain tatha cathode banate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: galvanic cell tatha galvanizing mein zinc isliye istemal hota hai kyunki ye kriya-sheel (reducing) hota hai tatha khud pehle kharab hokar loha ko bachaata hai.

qe: What is 'Dutch Metal'?
qh: 'डच मेटल' (Dutch Metal) क्या है?
o: A form of Brass used as imitation gold leaf
e: Dutch metal ek mishradhatu hai jo mishra (brass) ka ek khaas roop hai, jismein tamba (copper) ke saath zyada matara mein zinc hota hai; ise patli-chhoti paraton (beaten sheets) ke roop mein banaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iski paratein sone jaisi chamak wali hoti hain tatha aasaani se jaTTey (leaf) ki tarah lagai ja sakti hain, isliye ise 'imitation gold leaf' ke roop mein mandir ke mehrab, khilona tatha saji (decoration) ke kaam mein istemal karte hain - asli sone se ye sasta padta hai. Iske ulat peetal tatha kansa alag anupat wale mishran hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Dutch metal mishra (brass) ka ek roop hai jise sone jaisi chamak wali paraton ke liye imitation gold leaf ke roop mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which element is used as an 'Antiseptic' in the form of Tincture?
qh: टिंचर के रूप में किस तत्व का उपयोग 'एंटीसेप्टिक' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Iodine ko 'tincture' ke roop mein jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) ke liye istemal karte hain, kyunki ye jivanuon ke protein ko nasht kar deta hai tatha chot tatha katne par kaam aata hai; ise ethanol tatha paani ke mishran mein ghulaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iodine ki tez sugandh tatha chamakdar rang ushe aasaani se pehchaanne mein madad karta hai, isliye ghar tatha aspataal mein rakha jaata hai; par ye jale hue sthal par nahi lagaya jaata. Iske ulat chlorine tatha bromine ke aise aam gharliu antiseptic nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: tincture ke roop mein antiseptic ke liye iodine ka istemal hota hai - yahi ghay par lagane wala aam jivanu-nashak hai.

qe: Which metal was historically called 'Wolfram'?
qh: ऐतिहासिक रूप से किस धातु को 'वोल्फ्राम' (Wolfram) कहा जाता था?
e: Thorium ke ayask ko purane zamane mein 'wolfram' kaha jaata tha, kyunki usse tin nikaalte samay jhaag (scum) banti thi; baad mein yahi naam tungsten dhaatu ke liye chal pada, kyunki tungsten bhi tin ke saath milta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tungsten ka rasayanik chinh W (Wolfram) bhi isi naam se aaya hai, isliye aaj bhi rasayanik niyam mein tungsten ko W likha jaata hai - jabki uski asli khaas baat uski uchch galaank (3422 degree C) hai, jo ushe bulb ke filament tatha katai ke ojaar ke liye upyukt banati hai. Iske ulat molybdenum tatha titanium ke chinh tatha naam isse alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 'Wolfram' naam tungsten dhaatu ka purana naam hai - isi karan uska rasayanik chinh W hai tatha ye uchch galaank wali dhaatu hai.

qe: What is 'Stellite' used for?
qh: 'स्टेलाइट' (Stellite) का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Stellite ek mishradhatu hai jismein cobalt, chromium tatha tungsten milaaye jaate hain; yahi teen dhaatuen milkar ushe uchch tapman tatha ghisav (wear) ke liye tikau banati hain. Isi karan ise katai ke ojaar (cutting tools) tatha machine ke ghise hue hisson par hard-facing ke roop mein istemal karte hain, kyunki yahan loha jaldi narm pad jaata hai; chromium jang se bachaata hai. Ismein loha tatha nikal mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo jod yahan uttar nahi honge. Exam point: stellite mishradhatu (cobalt, chromium tatha tungsten) ka istemal katai ke ojaar tatha hard-facing mein hota hai - kyunki ye uchch tapman tatha ghisav sahti hai.

qe: Which metalloid is the most abundant in the Earth's crust and is the primary component of 'Sand'?
qh: पृथ्वी की पपड़ी में कौन सा उपधातु सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में है और 'रेत' का प्राथमिक घटक है?
e: Silicon ek up-dhaatu (metalloid) hai tatha prithvi ki chhalk (crust) mein oxygen ke baad sabse adhik matara mein milta hai; ret (sand) tatha patthar uske oxide (silica) se hi bante hain, isliye ye 'ret ka mukhya tatva' kaha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki silicon tatha oxygen dono mil kar bahut sthir bandhan (SiO2) banate hain, isliye prithvi ki bhoomi (soil), kaanch tatha cement mein unki hi matara sabse adhik hoti hai; iske ulat carbon jeev-jagat mein mukhya hai par bhoomi-patal mein silicon se kam hai. Iske ulat isi karan silicon electronik chip ka bhi aadhaar hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sabse adhik matara mein milne wala metalloid silicon hai - yahi ret (sand) tatha patthar ka mukhya tatva hai.

qe: What is the 'Color' of Hydrated Copper(II) ions in an aqueous solution?
qh: जलीय घोल में हाइड्रेटेड कॉपर(II) आयनों का 'रंग' क्या होता है?
e: Paani mein ghule hydrated copper(II) aayan (Cu2+ ke saath paani ke anu) nila rang dikhate hain; isi karan tamba sulfate (blue vitriol) tatha anya tamba lavan ka ghol nila hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki copper ke d-orbitals ke beech electron ke uchhalne se laal-pilali roshni sokhi jaati hai tatha baaki rangein milkar nila rang banti hain; isi karan tamba ki chhoti matara se bhi paani ka rang saaf badal jaata hai. Iske ulat anhydrous (bina paani wala) copper sulfate safed hota hai, isliye vahaan ye rang nahi dikhta - yahi farq paani ki upasthiti se banta hai. Exam point: paani mein ghole hue copper(II) aayan nila rang dete hain - isi karan copper sulfate ke ghole ka rang nila hota hai.

qe: Which element is used to 'Dope' Germanium to make it an n-type semiconductor?
qh: एन-प्रकार का अर्धचालक बनाने के लिए जर्मेनियम में किस तत्व की 'डोपिंग' की जाती है?
e: Germanium ko n-type ardh-chaalak banane ke liye usmein arsenic (ya phosphorus, antimony\) jaisa paanch-electron wala tatva milaya jaata hai; kyunki germanium mein chaar electron hote hain, isliye extra electron mukta reh jaata hai tatha vidyut ka bahav badh jaata hai. Isi karan n-type (negative) ardh-chaalak banane ke liye paanch-electron wale tatva tatha p-type ke liye teen-electron wale (boron, aluminium) tatva istemal hote hain; isi jodi se diode tatha transistor bante hain. Iske ulat boron tatha indium p-type banate hain, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: germanium ko n-type ardh-chaalak banane ke liye arsenic jaisa paanch-electron wala dopant milaya jaata hai - isse ek mukta electron badh jaata hai.

qe: What is the characteristic color of 'Potassium Permanganate' ($KMnO_4$) crystals?
qh: 'पोटैशियम परमैंगनेट' ($KMnO_4$) क्रिस्टल का विशिष्ट रंग क्या है?
e: Potassium permanganate (KMnO4) ke krystal gehra bainguni (dark purple) rang ke hote hain; paani mein ghulne par bhi iska rang bainguni ho jaata hai tatha patle ghol mein ye gulabi dikhta hai. Yahi karan hai ki iska istemal jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) tatha paani ko shudh karne mein hota hai, kyunki ismein manganese ki uchch oxidation avastha (+7) hone se ye prabal oxid hai tatha jivanuon tatha kachre ko nasht kar deta hai. Iske ulat iska rang kaala ya safed nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi; par iska rang ghulne ki matara par nirbhar karta hai. Exam point: potassium permanganate (KMnO4) ke krystal gehra bainguni rang ke hote hain - isi karan iska patla ghol gulabi dikhta hai tatha ye jivanu-nashak ka kaam karta hai.

qe: Which metalloid is highly 'Toxic' and was historically used as a poison (often called 'Inheritance Powder')?
qh: कौन सा उपधातु अत्यधिक 'विषाक्त' है और ऐतिहासिक रूप से जहर के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जाता था?
e: Arsenic ek up-dhaatu (metalloid) hai jo bahut zehirila hota hai; purane zamane mein ise 'inheritance powder' (virasat ka churna) kaha jaata tha, kyunki ise aasaani se khaane mein mila kar diya ja sakta tha tatha iske lakshan bimari jaise dikhte the. Iska karan yahi hai ki arsenic sharir mein ghul kar kai enzyme rok deta hai tatha dhire-dhire jaan le leta hai, isliye iski zehira jadi-bootiyon tatha chuhon ki dawaon mein bhi milti hai; par aaj ise samanya roop se chuhon tatha keedon ko marne ke liye bhi istemal karte hain. Iske ulat antimony tatha bismuth us se kam zehirile hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 'inheritance powder' arsenic up-dhaatu ka naam hai - yahi bahut zehirila metalloid hai jo enzyme rok kar jaan le leta hai.

qe: What color do 'Ferrous' ($Fe^{2+}$) salts usually exhibit in solid or solution form?
qh: 'फेरस' ($Fe^{2+}$) लवण आमतौर पर ठोस या घोल रूप में क्या रंग प्रदर्शित करते हैं?
e: Ferrous (Fe2+) lavan thos roop tatha ghol dono mein halke hare (pale green) rang dikhate hain; isi karan ferrous sulfate (green vitriol) hara hota hai tatha uske ghole ka rang hara-bhura lagta hai. Fe2+ mein d-orbital ke electron uchhal kar kuchh tarangdairdhya sokh lete hain, isliye bacha hua rang hara dikhta hai; hawa ke sampark mein aate hi ye oxid hokar Fe3+ ban jaata hai tatha rang peela-bhura ho jaata hai - isliye bina hawa (airtight) rakha jaata hai. Ferric (Fe3+) lavan peele-bhure rang ke hote hain, isliye wo jod is prashn ka uttar nahi. Exam point: ferrous (Fe2+) lavan halke hare rang ke hote hain - hawa se oxid hone par ye peele-bhure ferric lavan mein badal jaate hain.

qe: Which 'Transition Metal' is the only one that is a liquid at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर तरल रहने वाली एकमात्र 'संक्रमण धातु' कौन सी है?
e: Sanchar anudhaatuon (transition metals) mein ekmatr paara (mercury) hi hai jo aam kamre ke tapman par drav bana rehta hai, kyunki uske atomon ke beech bandhan kamjor (d-band ka hissa kam) hota hai; isi liye ye purane thermometer tatha barometer mein bharta tha. Jab ye garm hota hai to failta hai tatha thanda hone par sikudta hai, isliye taps (switch) tatha kuchh bulb mein bhi iska istemal hua; par iski bhaap zehirili hoti hai. Bromine bhi drav hai, par wo dhaatu nahi (non-metal) hai, isliye wo is prashn ka uttar nahi. Exam point: saadharan tapman par drav rehne wali ekmatr transition metal paara (mercury) hai - isi karan ye thermometer tatha barometer mein kaam aata hai.

qe: What is 'Boric Acid' used for in households?
qh: घरों में 'बोरिक एसिड' का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Boric acid (H3BO3) ek halka aml hai jise ghar mein do kaam ke liye istemal karte hain - chhote-chhote ghav tatha aankh dhoone ke liye jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) ke roop mein tatha keedon (cockroach, ants) ko maane ke liye powder ke roop mein. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye kamzor aml hone ke karan jild tatha aankh ki narm parat ko chubhta nahi tatha keedon ke liye ye zehirila asar deta hai, isliye ise carrom board ke powder mein bhi milaate hain tatha nammi-rok (preservative) ke roop mein bhi. Iske ulat sulfur tatha DDT ke upyog alag hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: boric acid ghar mein jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) tatha keedon ko maarne wale (insecticide) ke roop mein istemal hota hai - isi liye ye carrom powder tatha aankh dhoone mein aata hai.

qe: Which element provides the 'Green' color to fireworks?
qh: आतिशबाजी में 'हरा' रंग कौन सा तत्व प्रदान करता है?
e: Fireworks tatha aag-baaji mein hara rang dene ke liye barium ke lavan (jaise barium nitrate) istemal hote hain, kyunki barium jalte samay safed-hara rang paida karta hai; iske saath aluminium tatha magnesium ke choore se chamak badhai jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki har tatva ka apna rang hota hai tatha barium ka hara rang bahut sthir hota hai, isliye ye bahut prachlit hai; iske ulat copper ke lavan bhi hara rang dete hain, par wo adhik bhaari tatha mehange hote hain. Strontium tatha sodium ke rang isse alag hain (laal tatha peela), isliye wo is prashn ke uttar nahi honge. Exam point: aag-baaji tatha fireworks mein hara rang barium ka lavan deta hai - yahi safed-hara chamakdar rang paida karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of the oxide of Antimony ($Sb_2O_3$)?
qh: एंटीमनी के ऑक्साइड ($Sb_2O_3$) की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Antimony trioxide (Sb2O3) ko ubhay-bhaavi (amphoteric) oxide kehte hain, kyunki wo amliya (HCl) ke saath antimony chloride tatha kshaariya (NaOH) ke saath antimony salt bana leta hai - yani dono or ka byavhaar dikhata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki antimony ke gun dhaatu tatha up-dhaatu ke beech ke hote hain, isliye uska oxide ubhay-bhaavi ban jaata hai; isi karan ise reta-rok (flame retardant) tatha glaze banane mein istemal karte hain. Keval kshaariya ya keval amliya hona galat hoga, kyunki wo dono taraf kriya karta hai. Exam point: antimony ka oxide (Sb2O3) amphoteric (ubhay-bhaavi) hai - ye HCl tatha NaOH dono ke saath lavan banata hai.

qe: Which transition metal ion is 'Colorless' in aqueous solution?
qh: जलीय घोल में कौन सा संक्रमण धातु आयन 'रंगहीन' होता है?
e: Zinc aayan (Zn2+) paani ke ghole mein rang-hin (colorless) hota hai, kyunki zinc ka d-orbitals poora bhara hua hota hai tatha usmein electron uchhalne ki koi jagah nahi bachti - isliye ye dikhne wali roshni sokhta hi nahi. Isi karan zinc sulfate tatha zinc chloride ke ghole safed-dikhne wale (rang-hin) hote hain tatha rasayanik parikshaon mein zinc ki pehchaan rang se nahi hoti; iske ulat copper tatha tamba aayan nile, loha ke hara tatha chromium ke bainge hote hain. Iske ulat isi karan kaanch ko rang-hin (decolourise) karne ke liye bhi zinc ka istemal nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: paani ke ghole mein zinc aayan (Zn2+) rang-hin hota hai, kyunki uska d-krka poora bhara hone se roshni sokhi hi nahi jaati.

qe: What is 'Pyrex' glass made of to make it heat-resistant?
qh: 'पायरेक्स' कांच को ऊष्मा-प्रतिरोधी बनाने के लिए उसमें क्या मिलाया जाता है?
e: Pyrex (borosilicate glass) mein boron trioxide (B2O3) ki matara adhik milai jaati hai, isi karan ye ushma ko sahta hai tatha achanak tapman badalne par tootta nahi; yahi kaaran hai ki ise vigyan-prayog ke bina tatha rasayanik bartanon (beakers, flasks) mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki boron trioxide kaanch ke prasaar gunank (expansion) ko ghatata hai, isse garam tatha thanda hone par kaanch mein kam stress paida hota hai; iske ulat sadharan soda-lime glass achanak tapman badalne par phat jaata hai. Iske ulat isi karan Pyrex ko microwave tatha oven ke bartan mein bhi istemal karte hain, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Pyrex (heat-resistant) glass mein boron trioxide (borosilicate) milaya jaata hai - isi karan ye achanak tapman badalne par tootta nahi.

qe: Which element is used to make 'Blue' colored glass?
qh: 'नीले' रंग का कांच बनाने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Kaanch ko nila rang dene ke liye usmein cobalt ke oxide (CoO) ki thodi matara milai jaati hai; isse 'cobalt blue' naam ka gehra nila rang milta hai, jo purane zamaane ke neelam jaisa hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki cobalt ke lavan kaanch mein ghul kar sthir nila rang dete hain tatha dhoop se unka rang nahi badalta; isi karan cobalt ko rang-karak (colourant) ke roop mein bhi istemal karte hain. Chromium se hara, manganese se bainguni tatha copper se nila-hara rang milta hai, isliye wo jod is prashn ke uttar nahi hain. Exam point: kaanch ko nila rang dene ke liye cobalt ka istemal hota hai - isi karan is rang ko cobalt blue kehte hain.

qe: What is 'Yellow Phosphorus' chemically identical to?
qh: 'पीला फास्फोरस' रासायनिक रूप से किसके समान है?
e: Yellow phosphorus ek purana vyavharik naam hai, par rasayanik roop se ye white phosphorus hi hota hai; yani dono ek hi padarth ke naam hain (P4 anu). Iska karan yahi hai ki yahi phosphorus ka sabse kam krystal roop safed-peela hota hai, isliye ise dono naam se pukaara jaata hai; ye hawa mein aasaani se jal jaata hai tatha ise paani mein rakhna padta hai. Iske ulat red phosphorus ke rang tatha gun bilkul alag hote hain (wo match banane mein istemal hota hai), isliye wo is prashn ka sahi jod nahi. Exam point: yellow phosphorus rasayanik roop se white phosphorus hi hota hai - dono ek hi padarth (P4) ke naam hain tatha hawa mein jal jaate hain.

qe: Which transition metal is essential for 'Vitamin B12'?
qh: 'विटामिन बी12' के लिए कौन सी संक्रमण धातु आवश्यक है?
e: Cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12) ke anu ke beech mein cobalt dhaatu baithi hoti hai tatha wo corrin chakra se ghiri hoti hai; yahi dhaatu is vitamin ka mukhya tatva hai. Iski kami se khaas prakar ki anaemia (megaloblastic) tatha nerve ki takleef ho jaati hai, isliye mansahari aahar wale logon ko ye aasaani se mil jaata hai jabki shakahari logon ko ise alag se lena padta hai. Loha tatha tamba anya zaroori dhaatuen hain, par B12 ka khaas dhaatu cobalt hi hai, isliye wo do dhaatuen yahan uttar nahi hongi. Exam point: vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin) ke liye zaroori transition metal cobalt hai - isi liye corrin chakra wale ekmatr vitamin ka rang gulaabi-laal dikhta hai.

qe: What is the 'Oxidation State' of Iron in the Brown Ring complex used to test for Nitrates?
qh: नाइट्रेट्स के परीक्षण के लिए प्रयुक्त ब्राउन रिंग कॉम्प्लेक्स में आयरन की 'ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था' क्या है?
e: Brown ring (bhura chakra) pariksha nitrate (NO3-) ki pehchaan ke liye hoti hai; ismein ferrous sulfate (FeSO4) tatha saandrit sulfuric acid ke saath ek bhure rang ka chakra banta hai jismein loha ki oxidation avastha +1 hoti hai (Fe+1 wala nitroso complex). Iska karan yahi hai ki ye complex ek khaas sajaavat wala padarth hota hai jismein NO tatha Fe ke beech bandhan banta hai; isi karan is pariksha se nitrate tatha nitrite mein bhi antar kiya ja sakta hai. Iske ulat is chakra mein loha +2 ya +3 avastha mein nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: brown ring complex mein loha ki oxidation avastha +1 hoti hai - yahi nitrate ki pehchaan wali khaas pariksha hai.

qe: Which metalloid is used in 'Photocopiers' and 'Solar Cells' because it is a photoconductor?
qh: फोटोकॉपियर और सोलर सेल में किस उपधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह एक फोटोकंडक्टर है?
e: Selenium ek up-dhaatu (metalloid) hai jiski khaas baat yahi hai ki ye roshni padne par apni vidyut-chaalakta badha deta hai - isi gun ko photoconductivity kehte hain. Isi karan purane photocopier ki drum par selenium ki parat chadhai jaati hai, kyunki jahan roshni padti hai wahan aavesh bah jaata hai tatha chhabi ke gehere bhaag bach jaate hain; isi gun se selenium solar cell tatha light-meter mein bhi kaam aata hai. Iske ulat silicon tatha germanium photoconductor ke roop mein itne sanvedansheel nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: photocopier tatha solar cell mein photoconductor selenium ka istemal hota hai, kyunki roshni padne par iski chaalakta badh jaati hai.

qe: What color is 'Potassium Dichromate' ($K_2Cr_2O_7$) in acidic solution?
qh: अम्लीय घोल में 'पोटैशियम डाइक्रोमेट' ($K_2Cr_2O_7$) का रंग क्या होता है?
e: Potassium dichromate (K2Cr2O7) ka ghol acidic (amliya) mahaul mein narangi (orange) rang dikhata hai, jabki kshaariya (basic) mahaul mein ye peela ho jaata hai; yahi farq chromium ki oxidation avastha badalne ke karan hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki acidic mahaul mein Cr2O7^2- (dichromate) aayan sthir rehta hai jo narangi hota hai, par kshaar milane par wo CrO4^2- (chromate) ban jaata hai jo peela hota hai - isi karan ise laboratory mein aml tatha kshaar pehchaanne ke liye bhi istemal karte hain. Iske ulat hara tatha bainguni rang chromium ke alag aayanon (+3 tatha +6 ke alag roop) ke hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: acidic ghol mein potassium dichromate narangi rang ka hota hai - kshaar milane par ye peela chromate ban jaata hai.

qe: Which element is used to 'Galvanize' steel but also used in 'Dry Cell' batteries?
qh: स्टील को 'गैल्वनाइज' करने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है और ड्राई सेल बैटरी में भी इसका उपयोग होता है?
e: Loha par zinc ki patli parat chadhai jaati hai (galvanizing), kyunki hawa tatha nami se pehle hamesha zinc hi kharab (oxid) hota hai tatha loha salamat bach jaata hai; isi kaaran zinc dry cell ka rin chhor (anode) bhi banta hai, jahan uski oxidation se bijli paida hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki zinc sasta tatha kriya-sheel dhaatu hai jo apni satah par sthir oxide tatha carbonate ki parat bana leti hai, isliye use jal tatha hawa se bachav tatha sasta bijli-srot dono ke liye upyukt kaha jaata hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha loha kam kriya-sheel hote hain tatha dry cell ke liye upyukt nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: loha ko galvanize karne tatha dry cell ke anode ke liye zinc dhaatu ka istemal hota hai - yahi sasta tatha kriya-sheel dhaatu hai.

qe: Which of the following transition metal ions is 'Paramagnetic' due to the presence of unpaired electrons?
qh: अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों की उपस्थिति के कारण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संक्रमण धातु आयन 'अनुचुंबकीय' (Paramagnetic) है?
e: Fe3+ (ferric) aayan mein paanch d-electron hote hain jo paanch alag d-orbitals mein akela-akela pade rehte hain, isliye usmein paanch akela (unpaired) electron hote hain - yahi ushe paramagnetic banate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki akela electron chumbakiya kshetra (magnetic field) ki or kheenchte hain, isliye aise padarth chumbak se chipak jaate hain tatha unka magnetic moment sabse adhik nikalta hai; iske ulat Zn2+ jaisi pooree bhare d-orbital wali ion diamagnetic hoti hai. Iske ulat Fe2+ mein chaar akela electron hote hain, isliye wo paramagnetic to hai par Fe3+ se kam, isliye yahan Fe3+ sahi jod hai. Exam point: Fe3+ aayan paramagnetic hota hai, kyunki usmein paanch akela d-electron hote hain (d5 avastha) - isi liye uska magnetic moment adhiktam hota hai.

qe: What is 'White Vitriol' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'सफेद थोथा' (White Vitriol) क्या है?
e: White vitriol ka rasayanik naam zinc sulfate heptahydrate (ZnSO4.7H2O) hota hai, jismein saat anu krystal-paani (water of crystallization) judte hain; isi karan ye safed tatha chamakdar krystal banata hai. Iska istemal kheti mein zinc ki kami door karne (micronutrient), chikitsa mein eye-drop tatha gauze (dressing) ke liye hota hai, kyunki zinc aayan jivanuon ke liye zaroori hone ke saath-saath aankh ki narm parat par kam asar karta hai. Iske ulat green vitriol (FeSO4) tatha blue vitriol (CuSO4) alag rang wale hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: white vitriol ka rasayanik naam ZnSO4.7H2O hota hai - ye safed krystal banata hai tatha kheti tatha aushadhi mein kaam aata hai.

qe: Which alloy is used to make 'Precision Weights' and 'Standard Meters' because it doesn't expand with heat?
qh: सटीक वजन और मानक मीटर बनाने के लिए किस मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह गर्मी से नहीं फैलती है?
e: Invar ki khaas pehchaan yahi hai ki garm karne par uski lambai lagbhag nahi badhti, kyunki loha tatha nikal ke sahi anupat se uska prasaar gunank shunya ho jaata hai. Isi karan ise 'precise' naap wale kaam ke liye istemal karte hain - jaise precision weights, standard metre (napiya paimana) tatha metre scale; iske ulat sadharan steel tatha tamba tapman badalne par failte hain tatha naap galat dete hain. Isi gun se pendulum wali ghadiyan tatha metre-scale bhi sahi chalti hain. Exam point: precision weights tatha standard metre banane ke liye Invar istemal hoti hai, kyunki iska prasaar gunank shunya ke lagbhag hota hai.

qe: What is 'Philosopher's Wool'?
qh: 'दार्शनिक की ऊन' (Philosopher's Wool) क्या है?
e: Philosopher's wool (darshanikon ki oon) zinc oxide (ZnO) ka naam hai; ye safed tatha roohai (fluffy) choora hota hai, isliye yahi 'wool' jaisa naam pada. Iska istemal jild ke marham (ointment), sunscreen tatha paint mein hota hai, kyunki ye jivanuon ko rokta hai tatha dhoop ki kirnon ko paravartit karta hai; purane zamane ke rasayanik (alchemist) ise lab ki bhaap (flame) se udne wale choore ke roop mein paate the. Iske ulat zinc sulfate tatha zinc chloride alag safed padarth hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: philosopher's wool zinc oxide (ZnO) ka naam hai - yahi safed roohai choora hote hue jild tatha paint mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Type Metal' along with Lead and Tin to make the alloy expand on cooling?
qh: ठंडा होने पर मिश्र धातु को फैलाने के लिए लेड और टिन के साथ 'टाइप मेटल' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Type metal mein lead tatha tin ke saath antimony isliye milaya jaata hai ki ye mishran thanda hote samay thoda failta (expand) hai; isse ye ghon badkar bilkul akshar ke saancho mein bhar jaata hai tatha akshar ke kinare saaf ban jaate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki agar mishran sikudta to akshar ke kinare dab jaate tatha chhapai dhundhli hoti; isi karan antimony ka chhota hissa printing ke type metal mein zaroori maana jaata hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha chromium is kaam ke liye nahi milaaye jaate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: type metal mein lead tatha tin ke saath antimony hota hai - isi karan ye mishran thanda hote samay thoda failta hai tatha akshar saaf bante hain.

qe: What is 'Lithopone', used as a white pigment in paints?
qh: पेंट में सफेद रंगद्रव्य के रूप में प्रयुक्त 'लिथोपोन' क्या है?
e: Lithopone ek safed rang (pigment) hai jismein barium sulfate (BaSO4) tatha zinc sulfide (ZnS) ka mila-jula roop hota hai; dono padarth safed hain tatha ek doosre ki kami poore karte hain, isliye yahi paint mein safed rang ke liye banaya gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye zinc sulfide ke karan achhi chhadan (covering) deta hai tatha barium sulfate ushe sasta tatha sthir banata hai; par bismuth ke aa jaane se ye padarth kaala ho jaata hai, isliye iske mix mein savdhani rakhni padti hai. Iske ulat zinc oxide tatha white lead alag safed rang hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lithopone safed rang barium sulfate tatha zinc sulfide ka mishran hota hai - yahi paint mein safed rang ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Which 'Lead' compound is known as 'Red Lead' or 'Sindoor'?
qh: किस 'लेड' यौगिक को 'रेड लेड' या 'सिंदूर' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Red lead (sidoor) ka rasayanik naam Pb3O4 (triplumbic tetroxide) hota hai; ismein lead ki do alag oxidation avastha (+2 tatha +4) hoti hain, isliye ye ek mishrit oxide kehlata hai. Iska istemal laal rang (sindoor), loha tatha steel ke kure (rivets) par jang-rok parat tatha battery ke plet banane mein hota hai; iske ulat PbO (litharge) peela hota hai tatha PbO2 (lead dioxide) bhura-kaala hota hai. Iske ulat PbS tatha PbSO4 alag safed ya kaale padarth hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: red lead (sindoor) ka rasayanik naam Pb3O4 hai - ismein lead do oxidation avasthaon mein hota hai, isliye ye mishrit oxide kehlata hai.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of Zinc Oxide ($ZnO$)?
qh: जिंक ऑक्साइड ($ZnO$) की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Zinc oxide (ZnO) ko ubhay-bhaavi (amphoteric) oxide kaha jaata hai, kyunki wo amliya (HCl) se milkar zinc chloride tatha kshaariya (NaOH) se milkar sodium zincate banata hai - yani dono tarah ka lavan deta hai. Zinc ek aisi dhaatu hai jiske oxide ka byavhaar dono or hota hai, isliye ise jild ke marham tatha safed rang mein bhi kaam mein laate hain. Calcium oxide keval kshaariya tatha CO2 keval amliya oxide hota hai, isliye wo do naam yahan sahi nahi baithte. Exam point: zinc oxide (ZnO) ko ubhay-bhaavi kaha jaata hai, kyunki ye khatte (HCl) tatha kshaariya (NaOH) dono gholon mein ghulkar lavan deta hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Solder' to join pipes or wires, having the lowest melting point among common alloys?
qh: पाइपों या तारों को जोड़ने के लिए 'सोल्डर' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है, जिसका गलनांक सामान्य मिश्र धातुओं में सबसे कम होता है?
e: Solder wo mishradhatu hai jise pipe tatha wire jodne (join) ke liye istemal karte hain, kyunki ismein tin tatha lead mila hote hain tatha iska pighalne ka tapman mishranon mein sabse kam (lagbhag 180-190 degree C) rehta hai. Isi karan ye bijli ke taar ke jod tatha pipe ki jodai mein kaam aata hai - heat karte hi pighal kar jod bhar deta hai; par ismein sisa hone ke karan khane-pine ke bartan ki jodai ke liye iska upyog rok diya gaya hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha loha ke mishran ka galaank itna kam nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: solder mein lead tatha tin hote hain - unka galaank sabse kam hone ke karan yahi jodne (welding) ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Sugar of Lead'?
qh: 'शुगर ऑफ लेड' (Sugar of Lead) क्या है?
e: Sugar of lead (sise ki shakkar) wo purana vyavharik naam hai jo lead acetate (Pb(CH3COO)2) ke liye istemal hota tha; iska swaad mitha hone ke karan yahi sugar kaha jaata tha tatha purane zamane mein ise wine ko mitha karne ke liye mila dete the. Iska natija bahut bhayanak hua, kyunki isse lakhon logon ko lead-zehira (plumbism) hua - pet dard, kamzori tatha mastishk ki samasyaen faili; isi karan aaj sisa ke upyog par khane-pine mein sakhti se rok hai. Iske ulat lead carbonate tatha lead oxide mitha nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sugar of lead ka rasayanik naam lead acetate hota hai - yahi mitha hone ke karan purane wine mein milaya jaata tha tatha zehira failaata tha.

qe: Which element is used to 'Desilverize' Lead in the Parkes Process?
qh: पार्क्स प्रक्रिया में लेड से चांदी को अलग करने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Parkes vidhi mein pighle sisa (lead) se chandi (silver) nikaalne ke liye usmein zinc milaya jaata hai; zinc chandi ke saath milkar ek avilep (insoluble) mishran banata hai jo halka hokar upar tair aata hai tatha alag ho jaata hai. Zinc chandi ke saath mazboot bandhan banata hai par sisa ke saath nahi, isliye dono dhaatuen aasaani se alag ho jaati hain - yahi Parkes vidhi ka mool siddhant hai. Tamba tatha loha aise alagav mein nahi aate, isliye wo do naam yahan galat honge. Exam point: Parkes vidhi mein sisa se chandi alag karne ke liye zinc ka istemal hota hai, kyunki zinc chandi ke saath milkar halka mishran banata hai tatha upar tair aata hai.

qe: What is the primary use of 'Zinc Phosphide'?
qh: 'जिंक फॉस्फाइड' का प्राथमिक उपयोग क्या है?
e: Zinc phosphide (Zn3P2) chuha (rodent) maarne wali dawa hai; ye pet ke aml ke sampark mein aakar phosphine (PH3) naam ki prabhavi zehirili gas chhodta hai jo chuhe ke liye jaanleva hoti hai. Isi karan ise kheti ke kheton mein tatha anaj (grain) ke bhandaar mein rakha jaata hai, par ise savdhani se rakhna padta hai kyunki insaan tatha paltu jeevon ke liye bhi ye zehirila hota hai. Sodium chloride tatha boric acid jaisi halki dawaen itna prabhavi nahi hoti, isliye wo is prashn ke naam nahi hain. Exam point: zinc phosphide ka mukhya istemal chuha-maar (rodenticide) ke roop mein hota hai - yahi pet ke aml se kriya karke phosphine gas chhodta hai.

qe: Which 'Transition Metal' is found in the center of the Hemoglobin molecule?
qh: हीमोग्लोबिन अणु के केंद्र में कौन सी 'संक्रमण धातु' पाई जाती है?
e: Haemoglobin ke beech mein loha (iron) dhaatu hoti hai, jo oxygen ko bandh karne wali heme samooh ka mukhya hissa hoti hai; yahi karan hai ki khoon laal hota hai tatha oxygen phere se ootak tak pahunchta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki loha oxygen ke saath aasaani se judta tatha chhodta hai (do avasthaon mein badal kar), isliye yahi shvasan ka kendra-bindu hai; iski kami se anaemia ho jaati hai. Iske ulat cobalt vitamin B12 mein tatha magnesium chlorophyll mein hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: haemoglobin ke kendra mein loha (iron) dhaatu hoti hai, jo oxygen ko bandh karke poore sharer mein pahunchati hai.

qe: What color is 'Anhydrous' Ferrous Sulfate?
qh: 'निर्जल' फेरस सल्फेट का रंग क्या होता है?
e: Anhydrous (bina paani wala) ferrous sulfate safed rang ka hota hai, kyunki usmein koi krystal-paani nahi hoti; par hawa ke sampark mein aate hi wo turant oxid hokar peela-bhura ho jaata hai. Isi karan ise hawa-bandi (airtight) bartan mein rakhna padta hai; iske ulat hydrated ferrous sulfate (green vitriol) ka rang hara hota hai, kyunki usmein saat anu paani judte hain. Iske ulat ferric sulfate ka rang peela hota hai, isliye wo is prashn ka sahi jod nahi. Exam point: anhydrous ferrous sulfate safed rang ka hota hai - hawa mein rakhne par ye oxid hokar peela-bhura ho jaata hai, isliye ise band kar rakhna padta hai.

qe: Which metal is used for 'Silvering' of high-quality laboratory mirrors?
qh: उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले प्रयोगशाला दर्पणों के 'सिल्वरिंग' के लिए किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: High quality laboratory mirrors (tatha telescope) par chandni chadhane ke liye chandi (silver) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye roshni ka sabse achha paravartan karti hai tatha iski parat barabar banti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki chandi ke paravartan gunank (reflectivity) bahut adhik hote hain, isliye patla-sa parat lagane par bhi aasman ki halki roshni saaf dikhti hai; par ye hawa se kriya kar sakti hai, isliye upar se rakshak parat chadhai jaati hai. Iske ulat aluminium bhi paravartak hai, par high-quality mirrors mein silver ko tarjeeh di jaati hai, isliye wo vikalp yahan sahi nahi. Exam point: laboratory tatha telescope ke achhe darpan par silver ki parat chadhai jaati hai, kyunki ye roshni ka sabse achha paravartan karti hai.

qe: What is 'White Lead' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'व्हाइट लेड' क्या है?
e: White lead (safed sisa) ka rasayanik naam basic lead carbonate (PbCO3.Pb(OH)2) hota hai; purane zamane mein yahi safed paint tatha make-up (chhalke par lagane wala) mein istemal hota tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki iska rang safed tatha chhadak (covering) achhi hoti hai, par ismein sisa hone ke karan ye zehirila tha tatha iske upyog se bachchon mein mastishk ki samasyaen hui - isi karan aaj ise rok diya gaya hai. Iske ulat zinc oxide tatha titanium dioxide aaj safed rang ke liye istemal hote hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: white lead chemically basic lead carbonate (PbCO3.Pb(OH)2) hota hai - purane paint tatha make-up mein istemal hone ke karan isse sisa-zehira faila.

qe: Which gas is used in 'Neon' tubes to produce a Blue-Green light?
qh: नीली-हरी रोशनी पैदा करने के लिए 'नियॉन' ट्यूबों में किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Neon tube se nila-hara (blue-green) roshni paida karne ke liye tube mein paara ki bhaap tatha argon gas bhara jaata hai; yahi mishran bahut saaf nila-hara rang deta hai tatha neon ka gehra laal rang isse alag hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paara ki bhaap se par-abainjan (UV) roshni banti hai tatha tube ke andar ki parat ushe nila-hara roshni mein badal deti hai, isliye isi mishran ko 'mercury vapour lamp' bhi kehte hain. Iske ulat krypton tatha xenon anya rang dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: neon tube se nila-hara rang paane ke liye paara ki bhaap tatha argon ka mishran istemal hota hai - yahi mishran safed-nila rang deta hai.

qe: What is 'Litharge'?
qh: 'लिथार्ज' (Litharge) क्या है?
e: Litharge lead monoxide (PbO) ka vyavharik naam hai; ise pighle sisa ko hawa mein garam karne par paaya jaata hai tatha iska rang peela hota hai. Iska upyog kaanch tatha glaze mein, battery ke plet banane mein tatha rang (red lead) banane mein hota hai, kyunki ye lead ke aage ke padarthon ka aadhaar hai; iske ulat PbO2 (lead dioxide) tatha Pb3O4 (red lead) isse alag hote hain. Iske ulat ye lead ka sulfide ya sulfate nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: litharge lead monoxide (PbO) ka naam hai - ye peela oxide hai jo kaanch tatha battery mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which transition metal is used as a 'Catalyst' in the Haber Process for the synthesis of Ammonia?
qh: अमोनिया के संश्लेषण के लिए हैबर प्रक्रम में किस संक्रमण धातु का उपयोग उत्प्रेरक के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Haber vidhi mein nitrogen tatha hydrogen se ammonia banane ke liye loha (iron) utprek ka kaam karta hai, tatha molybdenum jaisi tatva uske saath promoter bankar asar badhata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki loha gasen ko apni satah par chipka kar abhikriya ka raasta aasaan kar deta hai, isliye kam tapman par bhi ammonia banti hai tatha utpadan sasta padta hai; iske ulat platinum tatha V2O5 anya kriyaon ke utprek hain. Iske ulat yahi utprek ammonia (khaad) ke bade paimane par banane ka aadhaar bana, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Haber vidhi mein ammonia banane ke liye loha (molybdenum ke saath) utprek ka kaam karta hai - isi karan ye audyogik vidhi sabse zyada prachlit hai.

qe: What is the 'Catalyst' used in the Contact Process to convert $SO_2$ to $SO_3$?
qh: संपर्क प्रक्रम में $SO_2$ को $SO_3$ में बदलने के लिए किस उत्प्रेरक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Contact vidhi mein SO2 ko SO3 mein badalne ke liye V2O5 (vanadium pentoxide) ya platinized asbestos utprek ke roop mein istemal hota hai; in dono ki satah gasen chipak kar abhikriya tez ho jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye utprek garam aml tatha ashuddhiyon ko sahta hai tatha 400-450 degree C par bhi kaam karta hai, isliye audyogik utpadan mein yahi pasand kiya jaata hai; iske ulat platinum bhi achha utprek hai par mehanga tatha zehiron se kharab ho jaata hai. Iske ulat is utprek ke bina abhikriya bahut dheemi chalegi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Contact vidhi mein SO2 se SO3 banane ke liye V2O5 (ya platinized asbestos) utprek istemal hota hai - yahi sulfuric acid banane ki vidhi ka dil hai.

qe: Which Noble gas is used in 'Deep Sea Diving' mixed with Oxygen to prevent 'the bends' (Decompression sickness)?
qh: गहरे समुद्र में गोताखोरी में 'द बेंड्स' (डीकंप्रेशन सिकनेस) को रोकने के लिए ऑक्सीजन के साथ किस उत्कृष्ट गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Deep sea diving mein tank ki hawa ka dabav bahut adhik hota hai; isliye nitrogen gas sharir mein adhik matara mein ghul jaati hai tatha upar aate samay bulble banakar joint dard tatha 'bends' (decompression sickness) paida karti hai. Isi karan nitrogen ko hatakar uski jagah helium milaya jaata hai, kyunki helium sharir ke tel-tatha-chiknaai mein ghulta hi nahi tatha sharer se aasaani se bahar nikal jaata hai - isi karan gases ka ye mishran banaaya jaata hai. Iske ulat argon tatha krypton bhaari hone ke karan is kaam ke liye upyukt nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: deep sea diving mein tank ki hawa mein nitrogen ki jagah helium milaya jaata hai, taaki 'bends' (decompression sickness) na ho.

qe: The 'Ostwald Process' for manufacturing Nitric Acid uses which metal as a catalyst?
qh: नाइट्रिक एसिड के निर्माण के लिए 'ओस्टवाल्ड प्रक्रम' में किस धातु का उपयोग उत्प्रेरक के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Ostwald vidhi mein ammonia ko hawa ki oxygen ke saath jalakar nitric acid banaane ke liye platinum-rhodium ki baarik jali (gauze) utprek ke roop mein istemal hoti hai; yahi utprek ammonia ko nitric oxide (NO) mein badalne mein madad karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki platinum-rhodium uchch tapman par bhi apna asar banaae rakhta hai, isi liye ye audyogik utpadan ke liye upyukt maana jaata hai; loha yahan bhaap tatha ammonia ke kaaran theek nahi chal paata. Iske ulat nitric acid khaad tatha visphotak (explosive) ke liye zaroori hota hai, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Ostwald vidhi mein nitric acid banane ke liye platinum-rhodium gauze utprek istemal hoti hai - yahi ammonia ko oxid karke NO banata hai.

qe: Which Noble gas is 'Radioactive' and used in the treatment of Cancer (Radiotherapy)?
qh: कौन सी उत्कृष्ट गैस 'रेडियोधर्मी' है और कैंसर के उपचार (रेडियोथेरेपी) में उपयोग की जाती है?
e: Radon ek radio-active noble gas hai jo uranium ayaskon ke khanan se nikalta hai; isi karan iska istemal bahut seemit hai par cancer ke ilaaj (radiotherapy) mein iske beej (seed) ko tumor ke andar rakha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki radon se nikalne wali alfa kirnein paas wali koshikaon ko nasht kar deti hain, isliye purane zamane mein iska istemal cancer ke ilaaj mein hota tha; baad mein radium tatha cesium ne yahi kaam sambhal liya. Iske ulat helium tatha neon radio-active nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cancer ki radiotherapy mein istemal hone wali radio-active noble gas radon hai - yahi uranium ayaskon se nikalta hai.

qe: What is the first 'Noble Gas Compound' ever synthesized?
qh: संश्लेषित होने वाला पहला 'उत्कृष्ट गैस यौगिक' कौन सा है?
e: Xenon tatha platinum hexafluoride (XePtF6) duniya ka pehla noble gas compound maana jaata hai, jise 1962 mein Neil Bartlett ne banaaya tha; isse pehle maana jaata tha ki noble gases koi compound nahi banaate. Iska karan yahi hai ki xenon ka aayanban urja (ionization enthalpy) kuchh gasen ke saath milne par compound banane ki jagah deta hai, isliye aage XeF2, XeF4 jaisi compounds tatha XeO3 bhi bani; isse noble gas ki 'nishkriya' (inert) mannayta badal gayi. Iske ulat argon tatha helium ke aise asaan compound nahi bante, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pehla noble gas compound XePtF6 tha - isi karan xenon ko anya noble gases se zyada kriya-sheel maana jaata hai.

qe: Which transition metal is used in 'Vegetable Ghee' production from oils?
qh: तेलों से 'वनस्पति घी' बनाने में किस संक्रमण धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Vanaspati ghee banane ke liye drav tel mein hydrogen jodna hota hai tatha yahi kriya nikal (nickel) utprek ki upasthiti mein hoti hai; yahi tel ko ghan (thos) banata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki nickel hydrogen ke anuon ko apni satah par chipka kar double bandhan tak pahuncha deta hai, isliye kriya tez tatha saaf chalti hai; isi karan nikal sasta tatha prabhavi utprek hota hai. Iske ulat platinum tatha palladium mehange hote hain, isliye audyogik utpadan mein unka istemal kam hota hai. Exam point: vanaspati ghee banane ke liye tel mein hydrogen jodne ki kriya mein nikal (nickel) utprek ke roop mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Ziegler-Natta' catalyst used for?
qh: 'जिगलर-नाट्टा' उत्प्रेरक का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Ziegler-Natta utprek (titanium tetrachloride tatha triethylaluminium ka mishran) ethene ke anuon ko ek seedhi shrankhla (linear chain) mein jod kar polythene banata hai; yahi kriya bahut kam dabav tatha tapman par hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye utprek anuon ko sahi jodd mein lagata hai, isse high-density polythene milta hai jo zyada mazboot tatha kathor hota hai - isi se plastic ki balti tatha pipe banti hai. Iske ulat ise PVC ya nylon ke utpadan ka utprek nahi kaha ja sakta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Ziegler-Natta utprek ethene ke polymerization (polythene banane) ke liye istemal hota hai - isi se mazboot HDPE milta hai.

qe: Which Noble gas provides a 'Golden Yellow' light in discharge tubes?
qh: डिस्चार्ज ट्यूब में कौन सी उत्कृष्ट गैस 'सुनहरी पीली' रोशनी प्रदान करती है?
e: Helium gas discharge tube mein roshni ka rang halka gulaabi tatha hamare suraj ka peela (golden yellow) dikhta hai; isi karan helium ko sun spectrum mein sabse pehle khoja gaya tha balki kisi doosre tatva se pehle. Iska karan yahi hai ki helium ke electron uchhal kar apne khaas roop ki roshni chhodte hain, isliye iski tarangdairdhya (wavelength) ek hi jaisi rehti hai; isi se helium ka naam (helios = suraj) pada. Iske ulat neon laal tatha argon nila-bainguni roshni dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: discharge tube mein golden yellow roshni helium deta hai - isi karan iska naam sun (helios) ke aadhaar par pada.

qe: What is the 'Geometry' of Xenon Tetrafluoride ($XeF_4$)?
qh: जीनॉन टेट्राफ्लोराइड ($XeF_4$) की 'ज्यामिति' कैसी होती है?
e: XeF4 (xenon tetrafluoride) mein xenon ke chaaron or chaar fluorine atom aur do akele (lone pair) electron hote hain; aise chhah samvedak (electron pairs) ke saath samvedak aakaar (electron geometry) aathak (octahedral) hota hai, par do lone pair vipreet (trans) hone se aakaar 'square planar' (chatushk samtal) ban jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki VSEPR ke anusar lone pair pichhe hat kar bandhan wale atomon ko ek samtal (plane) mein rakhte hain, isliye ye sajaavat milti hai; isi tarah XeF2 linear tatha XeOF4 square pyramidal hote hain. Iske ulat tetrahedral ya octahedral sajaavat anya compounds ke liye hoti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: xenon tetrafluoride (XeF4) ki sajaavat square planar hoti hai - do lone pair vipreet hone ke karan ye aakaar banta hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Catalytic Converters' of cars to reduce toxic exhaust emissions?
qh: वाहनों से निकलने वाले जहरीले धुएं को कम करने के लिए 'कैटेलिटिक कन्वर्टर्स' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Catalytic converter (gaadi ka dhuaan-saafak) mein platinum, palladium tatha rhodium dhaatuen utprek ke roop mein lagai jaati hain; yahi teen khatarnak gases - carbon monoxide, unburnt hydrocarbon tatha nitrogen oxide - ko kam haanikarak CO2, paani tatha nitrogen mein badal dete hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye dhaatuen uchch tapman par bhi sthir tatha prabal utprek hote hain tatha gases ko safal taur par oxid tatha rudhaan (reduce) kar dete hain; isi karan vehicalon mein ye anivarya kar diya gaya. Iske ulat sasta loha tatha tamba ye kaam itni safalta se nahi karte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: car ke catalytic converter mein platinum, palladium tatha rhodium utprek ke roop mein lagte hain - yahi dhuaan ke zehirile gases ko saaf karte hain.

qe: Which element is added to 'Argon' in light bulbs to increase the life of the filament?
qh: फिलामेंट का जीवनकाल बढ़ाने के लिए बिजली के बल्बों में 'आर्गन' के साथ कौन सा तत्व मिलाया जाता है?
e: Bulb ke andar argon ke saath nitrogen ki chhoti matara milai jaati hai, taaki bulb ka filament (tantu) lamba chale; kyunki nitrogen ushma ko sahi taur par le jaata hai tatha tungsten ke vaasp (evaporation) ko rokta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mishran bulb ko zyada garam chalne deta hai tatha filament ke tootne ka khatra kam karta hai, isliye ye mishran aaj aam bulb mein istemal hoti hai; iske ulat shudh argon ke saath filament jaldi jal jaata hai. Iske ulat helium tatha neon is kaam ke liye upyukt nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: light bulb mein argon ke saath nitrogen milane se filament (tantu) ki umar badh jaati hai - kyunki ye ushma le jaata tatha tungsten ke vaasp ko rokta hai.

qe: What is the oxidation state of 'Xenon' in $XeO_3$?
qh: $XeO_3$ में 'जीनॉन' की ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था क्या है?
e: XeO3 (xenon trioxide) mein xenon ki oxidation avastha +6 hoti hai, kyunki teen oxygen atom milkar chhah rin aavesh laate hain; isliye xenon ka dhan aavesh +6 ho jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki xenon apne bahari kosh ke electron chhodkar oxygen ke saath bandhan banata hai tatha uchch oxidation avastha dikhata hai, isliye XeO3 ek prabal oxid tatha visphotak (explosive) padarth hota hai; isi tarah XeOF4 mein +6 tatha XeO4 mein +8 milta hai. Iske ulat +2 tatha +4 avasthaayein XeF2 tatha XeF4 ki hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi.
