Exam point: XeO3 mein xenon ki oxidation avastha +6 hoti hai - isi karan xenon uchch oxidation avastha wale compound banata hai.

qe: Which transition metal ion gives 'Amethyst' its characteristic purple color?
qh: किस संक्रमण धातु आयन के कारण 'नीलम' (Amethyst) को उसका विशिष्ट बैंगनी रंग मिलता है?
e: Amethyst (bainguni quartz) ka rang usmein mile loha (iron) ke chhote-chhote kanon ke karan hota hai; ye kan bainguni-lal kirnein chhodte hain tatha baaki roshni sokh lete hain, isliye pathar bainguni dikhta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki loha ke alag-alag aayan (Fe2+ tatha Fe3+) tatha unke aas-paas ka vaataavran mil kar rang paida karte hain, isi karan ushe garam karne par rang peela tatha kuchh sthitiyon mein hara bhi ho jaata hai. Iske ulat cobalt nila rang deta hai (cobalt blue glass), par amethyst ka rang loha se aata hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: amethyst (bainguni quartz) ka rang usmein loha (iron) ki ashuddhi ke karan hota hai - isi liye garam karne par ushe rang badal jaata hai.

qe: Which gas is used in 'Arc Welding' to provide an inert atmosphere?
qh: 'आर्क वेल्डिंग' में अक्रिय वातावरण प्रदान करने के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Arc welding (vidyut-tapka) mein pighle loha ko hawa ki oxygen tatha nitrogen se bachane ke liye argon gas ka istemal hota hai, kyunki argon nishkriya (noble) gas hai tatha pighle lohe se milkar koi compound nahi banata. Isi karan welding ke samay gas ka bavandar (shield) bana diya jaata hai tatha weld jod mazboot banta hai; iske ulat oxygen tatha nitrogen kriya karke jod ko kamzor bana dete hain (porosity paida karte hain). Iske ulat helium bhi inert hai par mehanga padta hai, isliye audyogik welding mein argon zyada istemal hota hai. Exam point: arc welding mein inert vaataavran dene ke liye argon gas ka istemal hota hai - yahi pighle loha ko hawa se bachaata hai.

qe: What is a 'Clathrate' compound?
qh: 'क्लैथरेट' (Clathrate) यौगिक क्या है?
o: A cage-like structure where one molecule traps another
e: Clathrate (pinjar-yogik) compound wo hote hain jismein ek anu (guest) doosre anuon ke 'pinjar' (cage) ke andar phans jaata hai - yahan koi rasayanik bandhan nahi banta, keval jagah ke hisaab se atak jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki pinjar wale anu khali jagah banate hain tatha chhote anu usmein fit ho jaate hain; isi karan ise 'cage compound' bhi kehte hain, jaise methane hydrate (barf ke pinjar mein methane ki gas). Iske ulat ye koi mishradhatu ya ionik compound nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: clathrate compound wo hota hai jismein ek anu doosre anuon ke pinjar (cage) ke andar phans jaata hai - yahan keval jagah ka pakad hota hai, rasayanik bandhan nahi.

qe: Which metal is used as a 'Catalyst' in the 'Decomposition of Potassium Chlorate' to produce Oxygen?
qh: ऑक्सीजन बनाने के लिए पोटैशियम क्लोरेट के अपघटन में किस धातु ऑक्साइड का उपयोग उत्प्रेरक के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Potassium chlorate ko garam karke oxygen banane ki kriya mein manganese dioxide (MnO2) utprek ke roop mein milaya jaata hai; isse oxygen kam tapman par hi tezi se nikalta hai tatha abhikriya ka raasta aasaan ho jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki MnO2 khud kharab nahi hota par doosron ki kriya ki urja ghatata hai, isliye laboratory mein oxygen banane ka yahi aam tareeka hai; iske ulat isse 'utprek' kaha jaata hai, kharab karne wala nahi. Iske ulat loha tatha tamba is kriya mein utne prabhavi nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: potassium chlorate se oxygen banane ki kriya mein MnO2 (manganese dioxide) utprek ka kaam karta hai - yahi oxygen tezi se nikalta hai.

qe: Which Noble gas is found in the highest concentration in the 'Earth's Atmosphere'?
qh: 'पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल' में कौन सी उत्कृष्ट गैस सर्वाधिक सांद्रता में पाई जाती है?
e: Vayumandal (atmosphere) mein sabse adhik matara mein milne wala noble gas argon hai (lagbhag 0.93 pratishat), isliye ise hawa se hi aasaani se alag kiya ja sakta hai; helium tatha neon bahut kam matara mein hote hain. Isi karan argon sasta tatha aam hone ke karan bulb, welding tatha anya jagahon par inert vaataavran ke liye istemal hota hai; par uski molekul aur bhaari hone ke karan hawa mein niche ki taraf rehta hai tatha kabhi-kabhi bandh kamre mein bhar jaata hai. Iske ulat helium tatha neon ke bhandaar (reserves) kam hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vayumandal mein sabse adhik matara mein milne wala noble gas argon hai (lagbhag 0.93%) - isi karan ye sasta tatha upyogi maana jaata hai.

qe: What is the primary cause of 'Lanthanoid Contraction' in the f-block elements?
qh: एफ-ब्लॉक तत्वों में 'लैंथेनाइड संकुचन' (Lanthanoid Contraction) का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
e: Lanthanoid contraction ka mukhya karan yahi hai ki f-orbital ke electron bahar wale (nucleus se dhan aavesh) ko theek se rok nahi paate - ise 'kamjor paridalan (shielding)' kehte hain; isliye har atom ka aakaar thoda-thoda ghata jaata hai. Iska parinaam yahi hai ki bhaari lanthanoid ka aakaar chhota hone se unke gun lagbhag ek jaise ho jaate hain tatha unhe alag karna mushkil ho jaata hai (isliye durlabh mitti kehlaate hain); iske ulat isi karan zirconium tatha hafnium ke aakaar bhi lagbhag saman rehte hain. Iske ulat ye kamzor paridalan 4f electron ki den hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lanthanoid contraction ka karan 4f electron ka kamjor paridalan (poor shielding) hai - isi se in tatvon ke aakaar tatha gun ek jaise ho jaate hain.

qe: Which of the following ions will have the highest 'Magnetic Moment'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस आयन का 'चुंबकीय आघूर्ण' उच्चतम होगा?
e: Sabse adhik spin-akela magnetic moment wo aayan deta hai jismein akela (unpaired) electron ki sankhya sabse zyada ho; Fe3+ ki d5 avastha mein paanch akela electron hote hain, isliye iska magnetic moment sabse adhik (lagbhag 5.92 BM) nikalta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paanch alag d-orbits mein paanch akela electron hote hain tatha koi jod pura nahi hota, isliye har akela electron apna chumbakiya hissa jod deta hai; iske ulat Fe2+ (d6) mein sirf chaar akela electron hote hain. Iske ulat Cu2+ (d9) tatha Ni2+ (d8) ke moments isse kam hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: in aayanon mein sabse adhik magnetic moment Fe3+ hai (d5), kyunki usmein paanch akela electron hote hain - isi karan uska moment lagbhag 5.92 BM milta hai.

qe: What is the 'Main Ore' of Tin (Sn)?
qh: टिन (Sn) का 'मुख्य अयस्क' क्या है?
e: Tin (Sn) ka mukhya ayask cassiterite (SnO2, tinstone) hota hai; ismein tin oksid ke roop mein hota hai tatha ise nikaalne ke liye ayask ko koyle tatha choone ke saath garam kiya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki cassiterite ka rang bhura tatha chamakdar hota hai tatha usmein tin ki matara zyada hoti hai, isliye purane zamane se yahi ayask istemal hota aaya hai - tin ko kansa (bronze) banane tatha tin-plate (khane ke dibbe) ke liye istemal karte hain. Iske ulat galena sisa (lead) ka tatha sphalerite zinc ka ayask hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: tin (Sn) ka mukhya ayask cassiterite (SnO2) hai - isi se kanse tatha tin-plate ke liye tin nikaali jaati hai.

qe: Which metal is extracted from the ore 'Wolframite'?
qh: 'वोल्फ्रामाइट' (Wolframite) अयस्क से कौन सी धातु निकाली जाती है?
e: Wolframite ayask se tungsten (W) dhaatu nikaali jaati hai; ismein tungsten loha tatha manganese ke saath milkar tungstate banata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tungsten ka galaank dhaatuon mein sabse adhik (3422 degree C) hota hai tatha wo uchch tapman par bhi mazboot rehta hai, isliye isse bulb ke filament tatha katai ke ojaar (tungsten steel) bante hain; isi karan Rasayanik chinh W (Wolfram) bhi yahi se aaya. Iske ulat chalcopyrite tamba ka tatha bauxite aluminium ka ayask hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: wolframite ayask se tungsten (W) nikaali jaati hai - yahi uchch galaank wali dhaatu bulb tatha cutting tools ke liye istemal hoti hai.

qe: Which Lanthanoid element is widely used in making 'Laser' crystals (like Nd:YAG)?
qh: लेजर क्रिस्टल (जैसे Nd:YAG) बनाने में किस लैंथेनाइड तत्व का व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nd:YAG laser mein neodymium (Nd) ka istemal hota hai, jo yttrium aluminium garnet (YAG) ke krystal mein milakar ek prabal laser banata hai; yahi laser chikitsa (cataract, skin) tatha udyog tatha sainik range-finder mein istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki neodymium rare earth apni khaas roshni (1064 nm) chhodta hai jo urja ko bahut achhe se badhata hai, isi karan ye solid-state laser aam hai. Iske ulat cerium tatha lanthanum alag kaam ke liye istemal hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Nd:YAG jaisi laser crystal banane ke liye neodymium lanthanoid ka istemal hota hai - isi karan ye solid-state laser chikitsa tatha udyog mein istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Oxidation State' shown by Cerium (Ce) that makes it a powerful oxidizing agent?
qh: सीरियम (Ce) द्वारा प्रदर्शित कौन सी 'ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था' इसे एक शक्तिशाली ऑक्सीकारक बनाती है?
e: Cerium apni +4 oxidation avastha mein ek prabal oxid (oxidizing agent) ban jaata hai, kyunki +3 se +4 mein jaane ke baavjud wo electron kheench leta hai; isi karan ceric sulfate tatha ceric ammonium nitrate jaisi dawa laboratory mein oxid ke roop mein istemal hoti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki cerium ka +4 aayan aasaani se +3 mein badal jaata hai tatha doosre padarth se electron le leta hai, isliye ise volumetric analysis (titration) tatha organic synthesis mein kaam mein laate hain. Iske ulat lanthanum tatha neodymium ki yahi +4 avastha sthir nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cerium (Ce) ki +4 oxidation avastha ushe prabal oxid banati hai - isi karan ceric lavan laboratory mein oxid ke roop mein istemal hote hain.

qe: Which process is used to separate 'Tin' from 'Iron Tungstate' (Wolframite) impurities?
qh: 'टिन' को 'आयरन टंगस्टेट' (वोल्फ्रामाइट) की अशुद्धियों से अलग करने के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Wolframite mein tin (cassiterite) ki ashuddhi ke saath loha ke saath juda tungsten hota hai; in dono ko alag karne ke liye ayask ka magnetic separation (chaumbakiya alagav) kiya jaata hai, kyunki wolframite mein loha chumbakiya (magnetic) hota hai jabki tin ka ayask nahi. Isi karan ayask ko chaumbak (magnet) ke paas le jaate hain tatha loha wala hissa khinch jaata hai, isse tin shudh milta hai; iske ulat froth floatation tatha liquation yahan utne sahi nahi baithte. Iske ulat isi tarah tin ko aage pighla kar bhi shudh kiya ja sakta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: wolframite se tin ki ashuddhi hatane ke liye magnetic separation vidhi istemal hoti hai - kyunki wolframite mein loha chumbakiya hota hai.

qe: What is 'Misch Metal' used for in the defense and automotive industry?
qh: रक्षा और ऑटोमोटिव उद्योग में 'मिश धातु' का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Misch metal mein lanthanid (rare earth) dhaatuen tatha loha mila hota hai; ise 'chingari wali dhaatu' (pyrophoric alloy) ke roop mein lighter (chakmak) tatha tracer bullet mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki lanthanid dhaatuen hawa se ragadne par aasaani se oxid hoti hain tatha chingari paida karti hain, isliye lighter ki chakmak tatha rakchha (defence) ke tracer bullet mein unka istemal hota hai - jisse raat mein goli ka raasta dikhta hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha peetal aise chingari nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: misch metal ka istemal lighter tatha tracer bullets mein hota hai, kyunki lanthanid dhaatuen ragadne par aasaani se chingari paida karti hain.

qe: The 'Spin-only' magnetic moment of $Zn^{2+}$ ion is:
qh: $Zn^{2+}$ आयन का 'स्पिन-ओनली' चुंबकीय आघूर्ण कितना होता है?
e: Zinc aayan (Zn2+) ke d-orbital (3d10) poore bhare hue hote hain tatha usmein koi akela electron nahi rehta, isliye uska spin-only magnetic moment shunya hota hai - yani ye diamagnetic hai. Isi karan zinc ke lavan chumbak ki or nahi kheenchte tatha unka magnetic aankda naap mein shunya aata hai; iske ulat Fe3+ tatha Cu2+ mein akela electron hote hain isliye unka moment shunya nahi hota. Iske ulat yahi karan hai ki zinc ke ghole rang-hin bhi hote hain, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: zinc aayan (Zn2+, d10) ka spin-only magnetic moment shunya hota hai - kyunki uske saare d-electron jode mein hote hain tatha koi akela electron nahi hota.

qe: Which 'Heavy Metal' is found in the ore 'Stibnite'?
qh: 'स्टिब्नाइट' (Stibnite) अयस्क में कौन सी भारी धातु पाई जाती है?
e: Stibnite (Sb2S3) antimony (Sb) dhaatu ka pramukh ayask hai; isse antimony nikaali jaati hai, jo sisa ke saath milakar battery ke plet tatha type metal ko kathor banane mein kaam aati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki antimony up-dhaatu (metalloid) hai tatha iske mishran ghisav ko sahte hain, isliye purane printing tatha battery udyog mein yahi dhaatu bhaari maatra mein istemal hoti hai; par iske dhool (dust) zehirili hoti hai. Iske ulat galena sisa ka tatha pyrolusite manganese ka ayask hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: stibnite (Sb2S3) ayask antimony (Sb) ka hota hai - yahi sisa ko kathor banane tatha type metal mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which element is used to 'Harden' Lead for making bullets and batteries?
qh: गोलियां और बैटरी बनाने के लिए लेड को 'कठोर' करने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sisa (lead) narm tatha bhaari hota hai, isliye ushe goli (bullet) tatha battery ke plet ke liye kathor banane ke liye antimony milaaya jaata hai - yahi sisa-antimony mishran 'hard lead' kehlati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki antimony ghisav tatha dabav sahta hai par sisa ka bhaar adhik hi rehta hai, isi karan goli dor (range) tatha energy ko theek rakhti hai tatha battery ke plet baar-baar charge-discharge sahte hain; iske ulat shudh sisa ghisav tatha dabav ko theek se nahi sahta. Iske ulat zinc tatha tamba is kaam ke liye sisa ke saath milaaye nahi jaate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: goli tatha battery ke liye sisa ko kathor banane ke liye antimony milaaya jaata hai - isi mishran ko hard lead kehte hain.

qe: What is the 'Self-reduction' reaction for the extraction of Lead (Pb)?
qh: लेड (Pb) के निष्कर्षण के लिए 'स्व-अपचयन' प्रतिक्रिया कौन सी है?
e: Sisa (lead) ke nishkarshan mein self-reduction (sw-avkaran) kriya chalti hai - PbO (lead oxide) tatha PbS (lead sulfide) aapas mein kriya karke 2PbO + PbS se 3Pb + SO2 dete hain; yani ayask ka hi sulfide bacha hua oxide ko dhaatu mein badal deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sulfur khud kanghi (reducing agent) ka kaam karta hai tatha bahari carbon ya kisi anya dhaatu ki zaroorat nahi padti, isi karan is vidhi ko 'self-reduction' kehte hain; isi tarah tamba (copper) ke nishkarshan mein bhi yahi kriya kaam aati hai. Iske ulat loha tatha aluminium ke liye vidyut apghatan (electrolysis) chahiye, isliye wahan ye kriya nahi chalti. Exam point: lead ke nishkarshan mein self-reduction ki kriya 2PbO + PbS se 3Pb + SO2 hoti hai - ismein ayask ka khud ka sulfide oxide ko reduce karta hai.

qe: Which Lanthanoid is used as a 'Neutron Absorber' in nuclear reactors?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टरों में 'न्यूट्रॉन अवशोषक' के रूप में किस लैंथेनाइड का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nabhik (nuclear) reactor mein neutron ki gati ko niyantrit karne ke liye europium tatha gadolinium jaisi lanthanoid dhaatuen 'neutron absorber' ke roop mein utprek (control rod) mein istemal hoti hain, kyunki ye neutron ko bahut prabhavi taur par sokh leti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki inke bade nabhik (nuclei) tatha unke khaas gun neutron ke saath aasaani se kriya karte hain, isliye inhe control rod mein daal kar abhikriya tez ya dheemi ki ja sakti hai - yahi reactor ki suraksha ka aadhaar hai. Lanthanum tatha cerium mein neutron sokhne ka itna asar nahi hota, isliye wo naam yahan lagu nahi hote. Exam point: nabhik reactor ki control rod mein neutron sokhne ke liye europium tatha gadolinium lanthanoid ka istemal hota hai.

qe: The 'Density' of transition metals generally increases across a period. Which transition metal is the 'Lightest'?
qh: संक्रमण धातुओं का घनत्व आम तौर पर एक आवर्त में बढ़ता है। कौन सी संक्रमण धातु सबसे 'हल्की' है?
e: Sanchar dhaatuon (transition metals) ka ghanatva ek hi aavart (period) mein aage badhne par badhta jaata hai, kyunki aakar chhota tatha bhaar adhik hota jaata hai; isliye scandium sabse halka transition metal maana jaata hai (ghanatva lagbhag 3 g/cm3). Isi karan scandium ke mishran halke tatha mazboot saman banate hain, jaise sports gear tatha hawai jahaz ke chhote hisse; iske ulat loha tatha tamba usse bhaari hote hain. Iske ulat ye ek durlabh dhaatu hai, isliye iska istemal aam nahi hai - tabhi bhi sabse halka transition metal scandium hi hai. Exam point: transition metals mein sabse halka (lightest) scandium hota hai, kyunki aavart mein aage badhne par ghanatva badhta jaata hai.

qe: Which metal is used to make the 'Target' in an X-ray tube?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब में 'लक्ष्य' (Target) बनाने के लिए किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: X-ray tube ka target (dhaatu plet) tungsten ka banta hai, kyunki wo uchch tapman (galaank 3422 degree C) par bhi thos rehkar electronon ki takkar ko sahta hai tatha X-ray paida karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tungstenit bhaari tatha uchch galaank wala hone se electron ke takkarne par bahut prabal X-ray nikalta hai, isliye camera tatha aspataal ke X-ray yantron mein yahi istemal hota hai; iske ulat tamba pighal jaata hai tatha aluminium X-ray ko rok nahi paata. Iske ulat tungsten ka rasayanik chinh W (wolfram) hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: X-ray tube ke target ke liye tungsten ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye uchch galaank wala bhaari dhaatu tatha prabal X-ray paida karta hai.

qe: What is 'White Tin' and 'Grey Tin' an example of?
qh: 'सफेद टिन' और 'ग्रे टिन' किसका उदाहरण हैं?
e: White tin tatha grey tin ek hi dhaatu (tin) ke do alag roop hain, isliye ye 'allotropes' kehlate hain; white tin (beta) saadharan tapman par sthir tatha chamakdar hota hai, jabki grey tin (alpha) thande tapman mein banta hai tatha usmein tin choora-chooora ho jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki tin ke atom alag-alag sajaavat mein judkar alag ghanatva tatha rang wale roop bana lete hain, isliye ye 'tin pest' jaisi samasya dete hain; iske ulat ye koi mishradhatu ya ayask nahi hai. Iske ulat isi karan tin ke aadmi (organ pipe) tatha shita-wahan (freezer) mein unka roop badalne ka khatra rehta hai, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: white tin tatha grey tin ek hi dhaatu tin ke do allotropes hain - yahi do roop thande tapman mein badal jaate hain.

qe: Which element is responsible for 'Tin Pest' (crumbling of tin objects in cold climates)?
qh: ठंडे मौसम में टिन की वस्तुओं के चूर्णित होने ('टिन पेस्ट') के लिए क्या जिम्मेदार है?
o: The conversion of White Tin to Grey Tin
e: Tin Pest wo samasya hai jismein thande mausam mein white tin (beta) dheere-dheere badal kar grey tin (alpha) ban jaata hai; isse tin ke saman par dhabbe (pits) badhte hain tatha wo choora-chooora hokar girne lagta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki kam tapman par grey roop zyada sthir hota hai tatha usmein aayatan badh jaata hai, isliye dhaatu mein chot (cracks) pad jaate hain - isi karan tin ke pipe tatha orgon (organ pipe) thande sthalon mein kharab hote hain. Iske ulat ye kriya tin ke oxid hone se nahi balki uske allotrope badalne se hoti hai, isliye yahi karan sahi hai. Exam point: tin pest white tin ka grey tin mein badalne ke karan hoti hai - isi se thande mausam mein tin ke saman choora-choora ho jaate hain.

qe: Which 'Rare Earth' element is used in the screens of Color Televisions and Monitors to produce the 'Red' phosphor?
qh: रंगीन टेलीविजन और मॉनिटर की स्क्रीन में 'लाल' फॉस्फोर का उत्पादन करने के लिए किस 'दुर्लभ मृदा' तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Colour television tatha monitor ki screen par laal phosphor paida karne ke liye europium ka istemal hota hai, kyunki uske khaas ion (Eu3+) electron ke takraav se laal roshni chhodte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki europium ke energy levels aise hote hain ki wo laal tarangdairdhya ki roshni dete hain tatha mishran mein gehri safai deta hai, isliye TV tatha monitor ke screen par yahi laal rang banata hai; iske ulat neodymium tatha cerium anya rangon tatha anya kaam ke liye hote hain. Iske ulat laal phosphor ke liye yahi khaas tatva hota hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rangin TV tatha monitor ke screen ka laal phosphor europium se banta hai - isi karan europium ka istemal display ke udyog mein hota hai.

qe: What is the result of 'Lanthanoid Contraction' on the 4d and 5d series elements?
qh: 4d और 5d श्रृंखला के तत्वों पर 'लैंथेनाइड संकुचन' का क्या परिणाम होता है?
o: Zirconium (4d) and Hafnium (5d) have almost identical radii
e: Lanthanoid contraction ke karan 4d tatha 5d shrankhla ke tatvon ke aakaar lagbhag barabar ho jaate hain; isi liye zirconium (4d) tatha hafnium (5d) ki aayanik trijya lagbhag ek jaisi hoti hai. Iska seedha parinaam yahi hai ki ye do tatva ek saath ayaskon mein milte hain tatha unhe alag karna bahut mushkil hota hai, tatha unke rasayanik gun bhi ek jaise hote hain - isi karan Zirconium ka nabhik upyog tatha hafnium ka upyog alag-alag rakha jaata hai. Iske ulat titanium tatha vanadium ke aakaar mein itni samanta nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lanthanoid contraction ke karan zirconium (4d) tatha hafnium (5d) ke aakaar lagbhag ek jaise ho jaate hain - isi karan unhe alag karna mushkil hota hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used to 'Degas' or remove impurities from molten steel in the Bessemer process?
qh: बेसेमर प्रक्रिया में पिघले हुए स्टील से अशुद्धियों या गैसों को निकालने के लिए किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bessemer vidhi mein pighle steel se ashuddhi (oxygen) hatane ke liye silicon tatha manganese milaye jaate hain; ye dono oxygen tatha nitrogen ko pakad kar gaadha (slag) bana dete hain jo mishran ke upari hisse mein aa jaata hai tatha hata diya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki silicon tatha manganese oxygen ke saath lagav zyada rakhte hain, isliye wo steel ki ashuddhi ko apne saath baandh lete hain - is kriya ko 'degassing' bhi kehte hain; Sulfur tatha phosphorus ki chhoti matara bhi hatayi jaati hai, par oxygen tatha gasen hatane ka mukhya kaam silicon-manganese ka hi hota hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha zinc is kaam ke liye steel mein nahi milaaye jaate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: molted steel se oxygen ki ashuddhi hatane (degas karne) ke liye silicon tatha manganese milaye jaate hain - yahi gaadha banakar steel saaf karte hain.

qe: What type of 'Bonding' is present in Metal Carbonyls like $Ni(CO)_4$?
qh: $Ni(CO)_4$ जैसे धातु कार्बोनिल में किस प्रकार का 'बंधन' मौजूद होता है?
e: Metal carbonyl (jaise Ni(CO)4) mein dhaatu tatha carbon ke beech do tarah ke bandhan hote hain - ek sigma bandhan (seedhe electron jodi ka sharing) tatha doosra pi-bandhan jismein dhaatu ke bhare hue d-orbital se CO ke khali pi-star (antibonding) orbital mein electron ka back-donation hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki carbon monoxide ek 'pi-acceptor' ligand hai jo dhaatu ke electron apni or kheench kar bandhan ko sthir bana deta hai, isi karan dhaatu tatha CO ka jod itna mazboot tatha vaaspasheel hota hai (Mond vidhi isi gun par chalti hai). Iske ulat kevel ionik ya kevel hydrogen bandhan wala jod yahan sahi nahi, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: metal carbonyls (jaise Ni(CO)4) mein sigma tatha pi back-bonding dono hote hain - isi liye ye compound sthir tatha vaaspasheel hote hain.

qe: What is the primary constituent of 'Monel Metal', used in marine engineering?
qh: समुद्री इंजीनियरिंग में प्रयुक्त 'मोनेल मेटल' का प्राथमिक घटक क्या है?
e: Samudri (marine) injiniyari mein istemal hone wali Monel metal mein nikal tatha tamba mukhya dhaatuen hain, kyunki ye paani ke khaarepan (salt) tatha khatte padarthon se kriya nahi karti. Iska karan yahi hai ki nikal tatha tamba milkar ek aisa mishran dete hain jo samudri paani mein jang nahi pakadta tatha pump, propeller shaft tatha rasayanik tank mein saal-ha-saal chalta hai; iske ulat sasta loha samudri paani mein jaldi kharab ho jaata hai. Iske ulat ismein chromium tatha aluminium mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: samudri injiniyari wali Monel metal mein nikal tatha tamba mukhya hote hain - isi karan ye khaare paani mein bhi tikti hai.

qe: Which alloy is used in 'Jet Engines' because it maintains strength at extremely high temperatures?
qh: 'जेट इंजन' में किस मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह अत्यधिक उच्च तापमान पर ताकत बनाए रखती है?
e: Inconel ek 'superalloy' hai jismein nikal mukhya hota hai tatha uske saath chromium, loha tatha molybdenum jaisi dhaatuen milai jaati hain; yahi mishran bahut uchch tapman (lagbhag 1000 degree C) par bhi apni majbooti banaae rakhta hai. Isi karan ise jet engine ke bhaag, turbo-charger tatha bhaap turbine mein istemal karte hain, jahan tapman tatha dabav dono bahut adhik hote hain; iske ulat sadharan steel tatha aluminium aise taap mein narm pad jaate hain. Iske ulat ismein tamba tatha sisa mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: jet engine mein istemal hone wali mishradhatu Inconel hai - kyunki ismein nikal hone se ye uchch tapman par bhi majboot rehti hai.

qe: In an 'Ellingham Diagram', what does a lower position for a metal oxide line indicate?
qh: 'एलिंगम आरेख' में धातु ऑक्साइड रेखा की निचली स्थिति क्या दर्शाती है?
o: Higher stability and ease of reduction
e: Ellingham diagram mein kisi oxide ki line jitni neeche (niche) hoti hai utni hi us dhaatu ka oxide adhik sthir hota hai - yani ushe tod kar dhaatu banana mushkil hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki graphic ka nichla hissa kam Gibbs urja (higher stability) batata hai, isliye uske upar wali line (jaise carbon ya aluminium) us oxide se oxygen kheench leti hai tatha reduction aasaani se hota hai; isi karan diagram se yahi pata chalta hai ki kis tapman par kaun reduce karega. Iske ulat upar wali line zyada sthirta batati hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Ellingham diagram mein neeche wali line adhik sthirta tatha reduction ki aasaani batati hai - isi se dhaatu nikaalne ke liye sahara milta hai.

qe: Which metal is refined using the 'Mond Process' by forming a volatile carbonyl complex?
qh: वाष्पशील कार्बोनिल कॉम्प्लेक्स बनाकर किस धातु को 'मॉन्ड प्रक्रम' द्वारा परिष्कृत किया जाता है?
e: Mond vidhi mein nikal (nickel) ki ashuddh dhaatu ko carbon monoxide ke saath garam karne par nikal carbonyl (Ni(CO)4) banata hai, jo vaaspasheel (volatile) hota hai; ushe alag kamre mein garam karke todne par atyant shudh nikal milta hai; nikal carbonyl banana tatha tootna dono aasaani se ho jaate hain tatha anya ashuddhiyein piiche reh jaati hain, isliye yahi vidhi sasta tatha saaf nikal dene ke liye istemal hoti hai; tamba tatha loha aise vaaspasheel carbonyl nahi banate. Isi vidhi ko bhaap-avastha shuddhikaran (vapour phase refining) kehte hain, isliye ye naam galat hain. Exam point: Mond vidhi se nikal dhaatu vaaspasheel carbonyl bana kar shudh ki jaati hai - kyunki Ni(CO)4 aasaani se banta tatha toot jaata hai.

qe: What is 'German Silver' composed of?
qh: 'जर्मन सिल्वर' किससे बना होता है?
e: German silver (nikal silver) ek mishradhatu hai jismein nikal, tamba tatha zinc mukhya hote hain; ismein chandi (silver) bilkul nahi hoti, keval uska safed chamakdar roop hota hai, isliye yahi naam bhrm paida karta hai. Iska upyog bartan, bijli ke contact tatha gehno ke nakal banane mein hota hai, kyunki ye sasta hota hai tatha jaldi jang nahi pakadta; iske ulat peetal mein nikal nahi hota, isliye wo alag hai. Iske ulat ismein sone ya platinum ka koi hissa nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: German silver mein nikal, tamba tatha zinc hote hain tatha chandi nahi - isi karan ye safed dikhta hai par sasta padta hai.

qe: Which substance is used to 'Inhibit' the corrosion of iron in car radiators?
qh: कार के रेडिएटरों में लोहे के संक्षारण को रोकने के लिए किस पदार्थ का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Car ke radiator tatha cooling system mein loha jagah-jagah jang pakadta hai, isliye ushe rokne ke liye sodium chromate jaisi jang-rok (corrosion inhibitor) tatha antifreeze ke roop mein ethylene glycol milaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sodium chromate loha ki satah par oxide ki rakshak parat banata hai tatha ethylene glycol paani ka jamav bindu girata hai, isliye engine thande mausam mein bhi surakshit rehta hai; iske ulat ye dono kaam alag-alag samasyaon ke hain, isliye yahan dono ko jod diya jaata hai. Iske ulat sirf paani daalne se dang (rust) tatha barf dono ki samasya aati hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: car radiator mein loha ko jang se bachane tatha jamav rokne ke liye sodium chromate tatha ethylene glycol ka istemal hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Effective Atomic Number' (EAN) of Nickel in $Ni(CO)_4$?
qh: $Ni(CO)_4$ में निकेल की 'प्रभावी परमाणु संख्या' (EAN) क्या है?
e: Effective Atomic Number (EAN) niyam ke anusar Ni(CO)4 mein nikal ke paas apne valence electron tatha charon CO ligand se milne wale electronon ki kul ginti 36 ho jaati hai, jo krypton ki electron sankhya ke barabar hai; isi karan ye compound atyant sthir hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki 36 sankhya (18-electron niyam ke saath) poore bharne wali 'jaadu sankhya' maani jaati hai, isliye nikal carbonyl asaadharan roop se vaaspasheel tatha sthir ban jaata hai - isi gun par Mond vidhi chalti hai. Iske ulat 28 ya 30 jaisi sankhyaayein apoorne bharne wale aayanon ki hoti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Ni(CO)4 mein nikal ka Effective Atomic Number (EAN) 36 hota hai - isi karan ye compound sthir tatha vaaspasheel hota hai.

qe: Which metal is used to coat the 'Internal Surface' of food cans to prevent food poisoning?
qh: खाद्य विषाक्तता को रोकने के लिए खाद्य डिब्बे की 'आंतरिक सतह' पर किस धातु का लेप लगाया जाता है?
e: Khane ke dibbe (food cans) ki antari satah par tin (Sn) ki patli parat chadhai jaati hai, kyunki tin saadharan khane ke aml (sirkeh, namkeen) se kriya nahi karta tatha usmein koi zehirila lavan nahi banata. Iska karan yahi hai ki tin sthir tatha surakshit dhaatu hai tatha wahi dibbe ke loha ko bhi aml se bachaata hai; iske ulat tamba tatha zinc khane ke aml se kriya karke zehirila lavan bana sakte hain, isi karan wo vikalp sahi nahi. Iske ulat isi karan tin ko 'tin-plate' ke roop mein alag se pehchaan jaata hai. Exam point: khane ke dibbon ki antari satah par tin ki parat chadhai jaati hai - yahi parat khane ko loha ki kriya tatha zehirile lavan se bachaati hai.

qe: What is 'Amalgamation' primarily used for in small-scale mining?
qh: छोटे पैमाने के खनन में मुख्य रूप से 'अमलगमेशन' का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Amalgamation (paara-mishran) ka istemal chhote paimane ke khanan mein sone (gold) ko ayask se nikaalne ke liye hota hai; sone ki dhool paara ke saath milkar amalgam bana leti hai tatha baaki mitti-paani dhul jaate hain. Iske karan yahi hai ki paara sone ko aasaani se ghula leta hai tatha baad mein garam karne par paara udh jaata hai tatha shudh sona bach jaata hai; iske ulat tamba tatha loha paara ke saath aise aasan mishran nahi banate. Iske ulat is vidhi se paara zehira failaata hai, isliye aaj iska istemal savdhani ya pratibandh ke saath hota hai. Exam point: amaalga-man (amalgamation) vidhi se chhote khanan mein sone (gold) ko ayask se nikaala jaata hai - kyunki paara sone ko ghulakar alag kar deta hai.

qe: Which element is added to 'Steel' to make it 'Self-lubricating'?
qh: स्टील को 'स्वयं-स्नेहक' (Self-lubricating) बनाने के लिए उसमें कौन सा तत्व मिलाया जाता है?
e: Steel ko 'self-lubricating' banane ke liye usmein sulfur ya lead milaya jaata hai, kyunki ye dhaatu ghisne wale hisson (bearing, gear) ki satah par patli chikni parat banate hain tatha machine ko baar-baar tel dene ki zaroorat kam ho jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sulfur tatha lead narm hote hain tatha ghisav ke samay 'solid lubricant' ki tarah sarak jaate hain, isliye ye aise steel cnc machine tatha automatic parts mein kaam aati hai; iske ulat chromium tatha tungsten kathor hone ke karan ye kaam nahi karte. Iske ulat silicon tatha manganese ka upyog alag hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: steel ko self-lubricating banane ke liye usmein sulfur ya lead milaya jaata hai - yahi ghisav ke samay chikni parat banate hain.

qe: What is 'White Gold' usually made of?
qh: 'व्हाइट गोल्ड' आमतौर पर किससे बना होता है?
e: White gold mein sone (gold) ke saath platinum ya nikal jaisi safed dhaatu milai jaati hai; isse sone ka peela rang safed ho jaata hai tatha gehne ko mazbooti milti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mishran sone se sasta tatha safed dikhta hai, isliye anguthiyan tatha chain isi se banti hain; iske ulat tamba milane se gulabi rang banta hai (rose gold), isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Iske ulat ismein loha ya aluminium nahi milaaye jaate, kyunki wo rang tatha gun kharab kar dete hain. Exam point: white gold sone tatha platinum ya nikal ki mishradhatu hoti hai - isi karan ye safed rang mein milti hai tatha gehne ke liye upyukt hoti hai.

qe: The 'Vapor Phase Refining' method includes which two famous processes?
qh: 'वाष्प प्रावस्था शोधन' (Vapor Phase Refining) विधि में कौन सी दो प्रसिद्ध प्रक्रियाएं शामिल हैं?
e: Bhaap-avastha shuddhikaran (vapour phase refining) ki do mashhoor vidhiyan Mond (nikal ke liye) tatha Van Arkel (zirconium tatha titanium ke liye) hain; dono mein dhaatu ko pehle vaaspasheel compound mein badala jaata hai tatha phir ushe todkar shudh dhaatu nikaali jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise compound banana tatha tootna aasaani se hota hai tatha ashuddhiyaan piiche reh jaati hain, isliye in vidhiyon se atyant shudh dhaatu milti hai (99.9% se adhik). Iske ulat liquation tatha zone refining anya tarah ki vidhiyan hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bhaap-avastha shuddhikaran ki do mashhoor vidhiyan Mond tatha Van Arkel hain - Mond nikal ke liye tatha Van Arkel zirconium-titanium ke liye istemal hoti hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'High-pressure Sodium Lamps' (street lights)?
qh: 'हाई-प्रेशर सोडियम लैंप' (स्ट्रीट लाइट) में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: High-pressure sodium lamp (street light) mein sodium ki bhaap ke saath paara tatha xenon milaaya jaata hai; ye lamp bahut prabal peela tatha safed roshni deta hai tatha bijli bachata hai, isliye shehron ki sadkon par yahi lampe lagte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sodium ke atom uchch dabav par uttejit hokar peeli roshni chhodte hain, isse range (visibility) badhti hai tatha ushma kam paida hoti hai; iske ulat neon tatha helium ki roshni kam prabal tatha mehangi padti hai. Iske ulat isi karan aaj-kal LED lamp a rahe hain, phir bhi sodium lamp abhi bhi prachlit hain. Exam point: sadak ki high-pressure sodium lamp mein sodium dhaatu ka istemal hota hai - yahi prabal peeli roshni deti hai.

qe: What is the 'Flux' used in the extraction of Aluminum?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम के निष्कर्षण में किस 'गालक' (Flux) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aluminium nikalne ki vidhi (Hall-Heroult) mein alumina ke saath cryolite (Na3AlF6) tatha fluorspar (CaF2) milaaye jaate hain; cryolite pighle mishran ka galaank kam karta hai tatha fluorspar ushe tez bahne wala (fluid) banata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki inke bina alumina bahut uchch tapman (2045 degree C) maangta hai tatha electrolysis mushkil ho jaati hai, isliye in dono ko 'flux' ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat silica tatha limestone anya dhaatuon ke nishkarshan ke flux hote hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: aluminium nikalne mein cryolite tatha fluorspar flux ke roop mein milaaye jaate hain - cryolite galaank ghatata hai tatha fluorspar mishran ko patla banata hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in the 'Lead Pencil'?
qh: 'लेड पेंसिल' में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lead pencil (pencil) ke andar kabhi sisa (lead) nahi hota, balki graphite ki patti lagti hai; isi karan usse kaagaz par kaali nishani banati hai tatha woh aasaani se ghis jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki graphite ke parat narm hote hain jo kaagaz par rukte hue patli parat chhod dete hain, isliye 'lead pencil' naam sirf purane bhrm ki den hai; sath hi graphite aag bhi nahi pakadta. Iske ulat heera bahut kathor hote hue kaagaz ko cheer deta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: pencil mein sisa nahi balki graphite (non-metal) hota hai - isi karan pencil se likha jaata hai tatha pencil ka naam 'lead' sirf bhrm se pada.

qe: What is 'Cupellation' used for?
qh: 'कुपेलन' (Cupellation) का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
o: Refining Silver/Gold to remove base metals like Lead
e: Cupellation vidhi se chandi tatha sone ko alag kiya jaata hai; ismein mitti ki banayi hue 'cupel' mein sone-chandi wala mishran jalaaya jaata hai tatha bacha hua sisa (tatha anya base dhaatuen) cupel ke bheetar sokh (absorb) ho jaate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sisa tatha uske oxide cupel ki rakhni (porous) deewar mein ghul jaate hain, jabki sone-chandi bach jaate hain; isi karan purane zamane se yahi vidhi ratna-parikshan (assaying) mein istemal hoti hai. Iske ulat distillation tatha zone refining is kaam ke liye nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cupellation vidhi se chandi-sone ko sisa jaisi base dhaatuon se alag kiya jaata hai - sisa mitti ke cupel mein sokh jaata hai tatha shudh dhaatu bach jaati hai.

qe: Which metal is used as 'Radiation Shielding' in nuclear power plants?
qh: परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्रों में 'विकिरण परिरक्षण' के रूप में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nabhik bijli-ghar mein radiation (kirnon) se bachav ke liye sisa (lead) ke bhaari takhte (shield) tatha apron istemal hote hain, kyunki lead ka bhaari nabhik gamma kirnein rok leta hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki lead ka ghanatva bahut adhik (11.34 g/cm3) hota hai tatha wo sasti bhi hai, isliye reactor ki deewaron tatha khali bartan (storage cask) mein ise lagaya jaata hai; iske ulat aluminium tatha tamba itni parinamkari rok nahi dete. Iske ulat paara tatha tungsten bhi rok dete hain, par sasta tatha aasaani se dhaalu hone ke karan lead hi zyada istemal hota hai. Exam point: nabhik kilon tatha X-ray se bachav ke liye sisa (lead) shield ka kaam karta hai - iska bhaari ghanatva gamma kirnon ko rok deta hai.

qe: Which element is found in 'Mithila paintings' (Madhubani art) as a traditional black pigment?
qh: मिथिला पेंटिंग (मधुबनी कला) में पारंपरिक काले रंगद्रव्य के रूप में कौन सा तत्व पाया जाता है?
e: Madhubani (Mithila) chitrakala mein kaale rang ko banane ke liye kabhi-kabhi kaala-kajal (lampblack) tatha soy the (soot) istemal hota hai, jo carbon ka hi ek roop hai; yahi karan hai ki rang gehra kaala tatha sthir hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki carbon ke sookshm kan pighli hue rang ke aadhaar (jaisa gond) mein aasaani se fail jaate hain tatha sookhne ke baad nishan nahi hatti, isliye paramparik chitrakala mein yahi kaala rang chalta aaya hai; iske ulat loha tatha tamba jaise padarth aise halke kaale rang nahi dete. Iske ulat aniline yellow jaisa rasayanik rang naya hai tatha paramparik nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Mithila chitrakala mein kaala rang carbon (kaala-kajal/soot) se banta hai - kyunki soot pighle rang mein fail kar gehra kaala nishan deta hai.

qe: Which silver salt is known as 'Lunar Caustic' and is used as an indelible ink during elections in India?
qh: किस चांदी के लवण को 'लूनर कास्टिक' कहा जाता है और भारत में चुनावों के दौरान अमिट स्याही के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lunar caustic silver nitrate (AgNO3) ka naam hai; ise 'indelible ink' (jo mit nahi sakti) ke roop mein chunav ke samay ungli par lagaya jaata hai, kyunki ye jild par chandni (silver) ke kan jama kar deta hai tatha paani se nahi hatta. Iska karan yahi hai ki AgNO3 jild ke protein tatha namak ke saath kriya karke kaala/chandni nishan bana deta hai jo kai dinon tak rehta hai, isliye yahi chunav ke tareeke ka aadhaar bana hai. Iske ulat silver chloride tatha silver iodide light se asar lete hain par aise nishan nahi banate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 'lunar caustic' silver nitrate (AgNO3) ko kehte hain - isi karan ye chunav ke samay ungli par kaali nishani (ink) banane ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Calomel' chemically, and what is its primary use in old medicine?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'कैलोमेल' (Calomel) क्या है?
e: Calomel mercurous chloride (Hg2Cl2) hota hai tatha purane zamane mein ise 'purgative' (pet saaf karne wali dawa) ke roop mein istemal karte the; iske saath hi ye bijli-rasayanik pariksha mein 'calomel electrode' ke roop mein bhi kaam aata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye paani mein lagbhag nahi ghulta tatha kam zehirila rehta hai (halanki paara hona ke karan iska upyog savdhani se hota tha), isliye ise laboratory tatha dawa dono mein istemal karte the; iske ulat mercuric chloride (corrosive sublimate) zyada zehirila hota hai. Iske ulat ye safed choora hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: calomel mercurous chloride (Hg2Cl2) hota hai - purane zamane mein yahi pet saaf karne (purgative) ki dawa ke roop mein istemal hota tha.

qe: Which silver compound is used for 'Artificial Rain' (Cloud Seeding)?
qh: 'कृत्रिम वर्षा' (क्लाउड सीडिंग) के लिए किस चांदी के यौगिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Artificial rain (cloud seeding) ke liye silver iodide (AgI) ka istemal hota hai; ise hawa-soo (aircraft) ya jameen se baadalon mein chhidka jaata hai tatha ye baadal ki bhaap ko bindu (nuclei) par jama kar deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki AgI ki sajaavat barf ke krystal (ice) jaisi hoti hai, isliye baadal ki paani ki boondein ushe seedhakar barf tatha aage barish ke roop mein baras jaati hain; iske ulat sodium chloride tatha anya lavan itne prabhavi nahi hote. Iske ulat isi karan ise barish karane ke liye upyukt maana jaata hai. Exam point: cloud seeding (artificial rain) ke liye silver iodide (AgI) istemal hota hai - kyunki yahi baadal ki bhaap ko seedha karke barish ka aadhaar banta hai.

qe: The 'Parkes Process' is used to remove which precious metal from Lead?
qh: 'पार्क्स प्रक्रम' (Parkes Process) का उपयोग लेड से किस कीमती धातु को निकालने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Parkes vidhi sisa (lead) se chandi jaisi keemti dhaatu nikaalne ke liye istemal hoti hai; ismein pighle sisa mein zinc daala jaata hai tatha zinc chandi ko apne saath lekar upar tair aata hai. Zinc chandi ke saath mazboot bandhan banaata hai tatha sisa ko chhod deta hai, isliye chandi ka bada hissa aasaani se alag ho jaata hai tatha ushe aage shudh kar liya jaata hai; isi karan ye vidhi sone-chandi ke khanan mein bahut mahatvapurn hai. Tamba is kriya mein hissa nahi leta, isliye wo naam yahan sahi nahi baithta. Exam point: Parkes vidhi se sisa se chandi alag ki jaati hai - ismein zinc chandi ko apne saath lekar halka mishran banata hai.

qe: What is 'Corrosive Sublimate'?
qh: 'कोरोसिव सब्लिमेट' (Corrosive Sublimate) क्या है?
e: Corrosive sublimate mercuric chloride (HgCl2) ka naam hai; ye safed krystal wala padarth hai jo paani mein thoda ghulta hai tatha atyant zehirila hota hai, isliye ise jivanu-nashak (antiseptic) tatha chaabhi (prezerativ) roop mein bahut savdhani se istemal karte the. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye paara ka prabal lavan hone ke karan jivanuon ke protein ka dhaancha tod deta hai, isi karan yahi badi zehira se juda hai; iske ulat calomel (Hg2Cl2) isse kam zehirila hota hai. Ise khane-pine ke padarthon mein milana bahut khatarnaak hai, isliye aisa karna kabhi theek nahi hota. Exam point: 'corrosive sublimate' mercuric chloride (HgCl2) hota hai - ye safed tatha atyant zehirila paara lavan hai, isliye iska upyog savdhani se hota hai.

qe: Which process is used to extract 'Gold' by dissolving it in a solution of Sodium Cyanide?
qh: सोडियम साइनाइड के घोल में घोलकर 'सोना' निकालने के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: MacArthur-Forrest vidhi se sone (gold) ko uske ayask se nikaala jaata hai; ismein ayask ko sodium cyanide (NaCN) ke patle ghol mein rakh kar hawa guzari jaati hai, jisse sone ka aayan ghul jaata hai tatha ushe aage zinc ya bijli se avsheshit kar liya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki gold cyanide ke saath ek sthir gholeel samooh banata hai, isliye ek hi ghol se bahut kam kharch mein sona nikaala ja sakta hai - yahi vidhi aaj bhi sone ki khanon mein prachlit hai. Iske ulat froth floatation tatha liquation is prashn ke uttar nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sodium cyanide ke ghol se sone nikalne wali vidhi MacArthur-Forrest vidhi kehlati hai - ismein sona ghul kar aayan ban jaata hai tatha aage nikaala jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Horn Silver'?
qh: 'हॉर्न सिल्वर' (Horn Silver) क्या है?
e: Horn silver (sing jaisa safed chandi) silver chloride (AgCl) ka naam hai; ise yahi naam isliye mila ki ye sone ki khanon ke upari hisse mein baal (horn) jaisa safed-chandi dikhta hai tatha roshni mein dheere-dheere kaala ho jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki AgCl suraj ki roshni se vibechit hokar chandi tatha chlorine deta hai, isi gun ke karan photographic plate tatha purane kaagaz chhabi (photo) mein iska istemal hota tha; iske ulat AgNO3 paani mein aasaani se ghulta hai, isliye wo yahan nahi hai. Iske ulat AgBr bhi photo ke liye istemal hota hai par 'horn silver' ka naam AgCl ka hi hai. Exam point: horn silver silver chloride (AgCl) hota hai - ye sone ki khan mein baal jaisa safed padarth hota hai jo roshni mein kaala ho jaata hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Amalgams' for dental fillings?
qh: दांतों को भरने के लिए 'अमलगम' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Dant bharne (dental filling) mein istemal hone wala amalgam paara (mercury), chandi, tin tatha tamba ke mila-jule mishran se banta hai; yahi mishran narm hone par dant ke gaadhe mein baith jaata hai tatha sakht ho jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paara anya dhaatuon ke saath aasaani se ghulkar ganha mishran banata hai tatha der tak tikta hai, isliye purane taur par zyada matara mein yahi filling istemal hoti thi; aaj kai sthalon par safed (composite) filling ka istemal badh raha hai. Sona tatha platinum mehange hone ke karan filling ke liye upyukt nahi maane jaate, isliye wo naam galat hain. Exam point: dant ke amalgam filling mein mukhya roop se paara (mercury) ka istemal hota hai - yahi anya dhaatuon ke saath milkar sakht mishran banata hai.

qe: What happens to 'Silver' jewelry when it turns black in the air (Tarnishing)?
qh: चांदी के गहने हवा में काले क्यों पड़ जाते हैं (Tarnishing)?
o: It reacts with H2S to form Silver Sulfide (Ag2S)
e: Chandi (silver) ke gehne hawa mein kaale ho jaate hain, kyunki wo hawa mein maujood hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas se kriya karke chandi sulfie (Ag2S) ki patli kaali parat bana lete hain; yahi kriya 'tarnishing' kehlati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki silver sulfide ka rang kaala hota hai tatha ye parat chandi ke chamak ko dhak deti hai; par ye parat hatayi ja sakti hai (polish ya safai se), isliye ye poori tarah kharab hona nahi hai. Iske ulat sirf oxygen yaa paani se ye kaala rang nahi aata, kyunki silver oxide utna kaala nahi hota - isliye sulfur ki bhoomika zaroori hai. Exam point: chandi ke gehne hawa mein kaale hote hain, kyunki ye H2S gas se kriya karke kaala silver sulfide (Ag2S) banate hain (tarnishing).

qe: Which reagent is used in the laboratory to test for the presence of 'Aldehydes' by forming a Silver Mirror?
qh: सिल्वर मिरर बनाकर 'एल्डिहाइड' की उपस्थिति का परीक्षण करने के लिए प्रयोगशाला में किस अभिकर्मक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Aldehyd ki pehchaan ke liye Tollen's abhikarmak (ammoniacal silver nitrate) istemal hota hai; ismein ghol mein aldehyd daalne par chaandi ki patli parat (silver mirror) tube ki deewar par banti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aldehyd khud oxid hokar silver aayan ko dhaatu (Ag) mein badal deta hai, isliye chandni chamakdar parat jaisi jama hoti hai; ketone yahi asar nahi deta, isliye yahi pariksha un dono mein antar batati hai. Iske ulat Fehling tatha Benedict abhikarmak tamba wale hain tatha unka laal avilep banta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: laboratory mein aldehyd ki pehchaan Tollen's abhikarmak se hoti hai - isi se silver mirror (chandi ka daana) banta hai.

qe: What is the 'Purity' of Sterling Silver?
qh: 'स्टर्लिंग सिल्वर' (Sterling Silver) की शुद्धता क्या होती है?
e: Sterling silver ki shuddhta 92.5 pratishat hoti hai tatha baaki 7.5 pratishat hissa tamba (copper) hota hai; tamba milaane se shudh chandi ko majbooti milti hai, kyunki bilkul shudh chandi bahut narm hoti hai tatha ghis jaati hai. Isi karan chandi ke bartan, gehne tatha sikke isi anupat mein bante hain tatha un par '925' ki mohar lagti hai; iske ulat 100% chandi ko 'fine silver' kehte hain jo gehne ke liye zyada narm hoti hai. Iske ulat ismein sone ya platinum nahi milaaya jaata, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Sterling silver mein 92.5% chandi tatha 7.5% tamba hota hai - isi mishran se chandi majboot tatha gehne ke liye upyukt ban jaati hai.

qe: Which metal is used as a 'Liquid Mirror' in large telescopes due to its high reflectivity and fluidity?
qh: उच्च परावर्तन और तरलता के कारण बड़े दूरबीनों में 'लिक्विड मिरर' के रूप में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bade telescope ka aaina banane ke liye paara (mercury) ko 'liquid mirror' ke roop mein istemal kiya jaata hai, kyunki ye drav hone ke saath 95% se adhik roshni paravartit karta hai tatha ghoomne par apne aap ek sahi parabolak aakaar le leta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki bhaari hone ke karan paara ki satah ekdum samtal rehti hai tatha thodi ghumai se bilkul sahi aakaar banta hai, isse mehange thos aaine ki zaroorat kam ho jaati hai; iske ulat thos aaine banane mein kai saal lagte hain. Iske ulat ise bade 'liquid mirror telescope' mein istemal karte hain, isliye yahi sahi jod hai. Exam point: bade telescope mein liquid mirror ke liye paara (mercury) ka istemal hota hai - kyunki ye achha paravartak tatha drav hone ke karan ghoomne par sahi aakaar leta hai.

qe: What is 'Vermilion' (Sindoor) chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'सिंदूर' (Vermilion) क्या है?
e: Vermilion (sindoor) ka rasayanik naam mercuric sulfide (HgS) hota hai; iska rang laal-narangi hota hai tatha purane zamane se yahi rang (pigment) tatha dharmik sindoor ke roop mein istemal hota aaya hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki HgS ka rang bahut gehra tatha sthir hota hai, isliye chitrkari tatha anya rangon mein ise istemal karte the; par ismein paara hone ke karan ye zehirila hota hai, isliye iske upyog par savdhani rakhi jaati hai. Iske ulat lead oxide (red lead) bhi laal hota hai par rasayanik roop se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vermilion (sindoor) ka rasayanik naam mercuric sulfide (HgS) hota hai - yahi laal rang wala paara-mishran hai jo paramparik roop se istemal hota aaya hai.

qe: Which 'Halide' is used for taking the actual image in black and white photography?
qh: ब्लैक एंड व्हाइट फोटोग्राफी में वास्तविक छवि लेने के लिए किस 'हैलाइड' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Kaale-safed (black and white) photo ki asli chhabi (image) banane ke liye silver bromide (AgBr) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye roshni ke sampark mein aane par toot kar dhaatu chandi ke kaale kan chhodta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki jitni jagah par adhik roshni padti hai wahan utna hi kaala hissa banta hai, isi se gehra tatha halka antar (contrast) wali chhabi banti hai; iske ulat AgCl tatha AgI bhi light-sensitive hain par photographic film mein mukhya roop se AgBr istemal hota hai. Iske ulat sodium chloride light par asar nahi deta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: photo ki asli chhabi banane ke liye silver bromide (AgBr) ka istemal hota hai - yahi roshni padne par kaala ho jaata hai tatha chhabi banata hai.

qe: What is 'Fulminating Gold'?
qh: 'फुल्मिनेटिंग गोल्ड' क्या है?
o: An explosive compound made from Gold and Ammonia
e: Fulminating gold ek visphotak (explosive) padarth hai jo sone ke mishran ko ammonia ke saath milane par banta hai; ismein gold aur ammonia ka jod hone se ek aisa padarth banata hai jo ghisav tatha garam hone par phat jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein nitrogen tatha sone ka aise bandhan banate hain jo bhautik dhakke (shock) se toot kar bahut ushma chhodte hain, isliye purane rasayanik isse bahut savdhani se rakhte the; iske ulat shudh sona ya ammonia alag-alag visphotak nahi hote. Iske ulat iske aise gun ke karan ye rasayanik itihaas mein jaana jaata hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: fulminating gold sona tatha ammonia se bane visphotak padarth ka naam hai - ye ghisav tatha ushma se achanak phat jaata hai.

qe: Which element is used to 'Fix' the image in photography by dissolving unreacted AgBr?
qh: फोटोग्राफी में अप्रयुक्त AgBr को घोलकर छवि को 'फिक्स' करने के लिए किस यौगिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Photo fix karne (chhabi ko sthir karne) ke liye sodium thiosulfate (jise hypo bhi kehte hain) istemal hota hai; yahi wo abhikarmak hai jo chhabi par bache hue anabhikrita (unreacted) silver bromide ko ghula kar hata deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yadi ye AgBr na hataya jaaye to roshni padne par wo aage kaala hota jaata tatha chhabi kharab ho jaati; isi karan 'fixing' photo banane ki kriya ka anivarya kadam hai. Iske ulat sodium chloride tatha anya lavan is kaam ke liye upyukt nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: photo ko fix karne ke liye sodium thiosulfate (hypo) istemal hota hai - yahi bache hue silver bromide ko ghula kar chhabi ko sthir kar deta hai.

qe: What is the 'Density' of Mercury?
qh: पारे (Mercury) का 'घनत्व' कितना होता है?
e: Paara (mercury) ka ghanatva lagbhag 13.6 gram per cubic centimetre hota hai, isliye yahi dhaatuon mein sabse bhaari drav maani jaati hai; isi karan paara bharne ke liye bahut mazboot tatha ghana bartan chahiye. Iska karan yahi hai ki paara ke atom bhaari hote hain tatha unke beech aakarshan bal unhe paas rakhta hai, isi karan ek chhota-sa bhar bhi bahut bhaar ka hota hai - isi gun se barometer tatha blood pressure naapne wale yantra mein sahi aankde milte hain. Iske ulat paani ka ghanatva 1 tatha tamba ka lagbhag 8.9 hota hai, isliye wo aise bhaari naap ke liye upyukt nahi. Exam point: paara (mercury) ka ghanatva 13.6 g/cm3 hota hai - isi karan ye bhaari hone ke saath-saath barometer tatha pressure yantron mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal is 'Most Ductile', capable of being drawn into a wire miles long from just one gram?
qh: कौन सी धातु सबसे 'तन्य' (Ductile) है, जिसे केवल एक ग्राम से मीलों लंबा तार खींचा जा सकता है?
e: Sone (gold) ko sabse adhik taar-kheenchav (ductile) wali dhaatu kehte hain, kyunki uske ek gram se kai kilometre lamba taar kheecha ja sakta hai tatha uski patli-chhoti parat bhi banaayi ja sakti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki gold ke atom ek seedhi sajaavat (face-centred cubic) mein baithe hote hain tatha unke beech ka bandhan lachakdar hota hai, isliye dhaatu bina toote khinchti chali jaati hai; iske ulat heera tatha tungsten toot jaate hain. Isi karan sona gehno tatha zari (embroidery) mein kaam aata hai. Exam point: sabse adhik taar-kheenchav (most ductile) wali dhaatu sona (gold) hai - uske ek gram se kai kilometre lamba taar banaya ja sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Baryte' an ore of?
qh: 'बेराइट' (Baryte) किसका अयस्क है?
e: Baryte (BaSO4) barium (Ba) dhaatu ka pramukh ayask hota hai; isse barium ke lavan tatha uske mishran banaaye jaate hain, jise kuanon (drilling) mein tatha X-ray parikshan ke liye 'barium meal' ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki barium ka sulfate paani mein lagbhag nahi ghulta tatha zehirila nahi hota, isliye ise doctor aant (intestine) ki X-ray ke liye pilate hain (jo X-ray ko rok kar safed chhabi banata hai); iske ulat lithopone mein bhi yahi ayask istemal hota hai. Galena ayask sisa (lead) ka hota hai, isliye wo is prashn ka uttar nahi hoga. Exam point: baryte ayask barium (Ba) ka hota hai - yahi X-ray ke liye barium meal tatha drilling mud mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal is the central atom in the 'Chlorophyll' molecule, making it essential for photosynthesis?
qh: 'क्लोरोफिल' अणु में कौन सी धातु केंद्रीय परमाणु है, जो इसे प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए आवश्यक बनाती है?
e: Chlorophyll ke beech mein magnesium (Mg) dhaatu hoti hai, jo uske porphyrin chakra ke kendra mein baithti hai; yahi dhaatu sooraj ki roshni ko sokh kar carbon dioxide tatha paani se khaana (glucose) banane ki kriya (photosynthesis) ko sambhav banati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki magnesium ke aayan roshni ki urja ko aage badhane mein madad karte hain, isliye iski kami se paudhe peele pad jaate hain; iske ulat loha hemoglobin mein tatha cobalt vitamin B12 mein hota hai. Iske ulat magnesium hi paudhon ke harit rang (green) ka kendra-bindu hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: chlorophyll ke kendra mein magnesium (Mg) dhaatu hoti hai - isi karan yahi paudhon mein photosynthesis ke liye anivarya hai.

qe: What is the primary mineral component of 'Human Bones' and teeth?
qh: 'मानव हड्डियों' और दांतों का प्राथमिक खनिज घटक क्या है?
e: Manushya ki haddiyon tatha daanton ka mukhya khanij tatva calcium phosphate (Ca3(PO4)2) hota hai, jise 'hydroxyapatite' ke roop mein jana jaata hai; yahi haddiyon ko kathorata tatha daanton ko mazbooti deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki calcium tatha phosphate milkar ek sthir lavan banate hain jo sharir mein lambe samay tak tikta hai, isliye bachchon ke aahar mein calcium tatha vitamin D ka hona zaroori hai; iske ulat sodium chloride tatha iron oxide haddiyon mein mukhya nahi hote. Iske ulat isi karan doodh tatha anya calcium-wale padarth haddiyon ke liye faydemand maane jaate hain, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: manushya ki haddiyon tatha daanton ka mukhya khanij calcium phosphate (Ca3(PO4)2) hota hai - yahi unhe kathor tatha mazboot banata hai.

qe: Which compound is known as 'Quicklime'?
qh: किस यौगिक को 'बिना बुझा चूना' (Quicklime) कहा जाता है?
e: 'Quicklime' (tez chuna) calcium oxide (CaO) ka naam hai; ise choone ke patthar (limestone, CaCO3) ko uchch tapman par jalane (calcination) se banaaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye paani ke saath prabal taur par kriya karta hai (isi liye 'quick' kaha jaata hai) tatha bahut ushma chhodta hai, isliye ise cement, mortar tatha loha banane mein tatha kheton ki mitti ko sahi karne mein istemal karte hain; iske ulat Ca(OH)2 (slaked lime) alag padarth hai jo paani ke saath mila kar banta hai. Exam point: quicklime (tez chuna) calcium oxide (CaO) hota hai - yahi choone ke patthar ko jalane se milta hai tatha paani ke saath kriya karke ushma deta hai.

qe: What happens when 'Water' is added to Quicklime (CaO)?
qh: जब बिना बुझे चूने (CaO) में 'पानी' मिलाया जाता है तो क्या होता है?
o: It absorbs heat and cools down
e: Quicklime (CaO) par paani daalne par kriya bahut tez hoti hai tatha ushma bahar nikalati hai - yani ye ek ushma-bahari (exothermic) kriya hai; isse slaked lime (Ca(OH)2) banta hai tatha bhaap bhi uthti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki CaO tatha paani ke banne wale bandhan mein purani urja se adhik urja nikalati hai, isliye bahut ushma paida hoti hai (is karan ishe 'quicklime' kehte hain, 'quick' = tez). Iske ulat CaCO3 ya CaCl2 paani ke saath aisi tez ushma nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: quicklime (CaO) par paani daalne par kriya tez hoti hai tatha ushma nikalati hai - yani ye ek exothermic (ushma-bahari) kriya hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Flashbulbs' of old cameras because it burns with a dazzling white light?
qh: पुराने कैमरों के 'फ्लैशबल्ब' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता था क्योंकि यह चकाचौंध करने वाली सफेद रोशनी के साथ जलती है?
e: Purane camera ke flash bulb mein magnesium ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye jalne par chamakdar safed (dazzling white) roshni deta hai tatha ushi pal mein poori ushma nikal deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki magnesium ki oxygen ke saath kriya bahut tez hoti hai tatha uske oxide ka rang safed hone se roshni safed dikhti hai, isi karan photo ke liye yahi dhaatu chuni gayi thi; iske ulat tamba tatha loha peela ya halka laal rang dete hain. Iske ulat magnesium ab aag-baaji tatha signal flare mein bhi istemal hota hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: flash bulb mein magnesium ka istemal hota hai - yahi jalne par chamakdar safed roshni deta hai tatha photo ke liye upyukt tha.

qe: What is 'Milk of Magnesia' used for in medicine?
qh: चिकित्सा में 'मिल्क ऑफ मैग्नेशिया' का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Milk of Magnesia magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)2) ka doodh jaisa safed mishran hota hai; ise aushadhi mein antacid (pet ki jalan kam karne wali dawa) tatha halke rechak (laxative) ke roop mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki Mg(OH)2 pet ke zyada aml (HCl) ko shaant karta hai tatha aant (intestine) mein paani kheenchkar saaf hone mein madad karta hai, isliye kabhi-kabhi jalan tatha kabhi-kabhi gad-bad (constipation) dono mein yahi diya jaata hai; par bahut adhik matara se dang (diarrhoea) ho sakta hai. Iske ulat paracetamol dard-nashak hai tatha antibiotic jivanuon ke liye, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: milk of magnesia (Mg(OH)2) ko antacid tatha halke laxative ke roop mein istemal karte hain - yahi pet ke aml ko shaant karta hai.

qe: Which gas is evolved when Magnesium reacts with 'Boiling Water'?
qh: जब मैग्नीशियम 'उबलते पानी' के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करता है तो कौन सी गैस निकलती है?
e: Magnesium ubalti hui (boiling) paani ke saath kriya karke magnesium hydroxide tatha hydrogen gas banata hai; yahan bhaap magnesium ke saath kriya karti hai tatha ushe oxid kar deti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki magnesium paani se adhik kriya-sheel dhaatu hai tatha uchch tapman par (bhaap ke saath) wo tez kriya karta hai; iske ulat thanda paani mein magnesium ki satah par bani oxide parat hone se kriya dheemi rehti hai. Iske ulat oxygen ya CO2 is kriya mein nahi nikalte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: magnesium tatha ubhalti hui paani ki kriya se hydrogen gas nikalta hai - kyunki magnesium bhaap dwara oxid hota hai tatha hydrogen chhod deta hai.

qe: What is the chemical name of 'Gypsum'?
qh: 'जिप्सम' (Gypsum) का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Gypsum ka rasayanik naam calcium sulfate dihydrate (CaSO4.2H2O) hota hai, yani uske saath paani ke do anu krystal ke roop mein jude rehte hain. Isise garam karne par paani ke kuchh hisse nikal jaate hain tatha plaster of Paris (CaSO4.1/2H2O) banta hai, isliye gypsum cement, plaster tatha board banane ke udyog ka aadhaar hai; iske ulat dead burnt plaster (anhydrous CaSO4) us se alag hota hai jismein poori krystal-paani nahi hoti. Iske ulat gypsum ka rang safed hota hai tatha yahi khaas khanij kaam aata hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: gypsum ka rasayanik naam calcium sulfate dihydrate (CaSO4.2H2O) hota hai - isi se garam karke plaster of Paris banta hai.

qe: Which of the following is the 'Softest' metal in the Reactivity Series?
qh: सक्रियता श्रेणी में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी धातु सबसे 'नरम' है?
e: Kriya-sheelta shrankhla (reactivity series) mein sodium us dhaatuon mein sabse upar aata hai jo paani se bhi prabal kriya karte hain; sodium ki khaas baat yahi hai ki wo bahut narm (soft) hota hai tatha chaku se kat jaata hai, isliye ise 'sabse narm dhaatu' maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sodium ke atomon ke beech bandhan itna mazboot nahi hota tatha uske valence electron bahut dheele bandhe hote hain (padhne ke liye isliye pighla karke rakha jaata hai). Iske ulat loha tatha tamba kathor hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: reactivity series mein sodium sabse narm (softest) dhaatu hai - ise chaku se bhi kata ja sakta hai tatha yahi paani se tez kriya karta hai.

qe: Which metal can displace 'Copper' from a Copper Sulfate solution?
qh: कौन सी धातु कॉपर सल्फेट के घोल से 'कॉपर' को विस्थापित कर सकती है?
e: Copper sulfate ke ghole mein loha daalne par loha tamba (copper) ko uske lavan se bahar dhakel deta hai (displacement), kyunki loha copper se adhik kriya-sheel (reactive) hai; isse loha ka sulfate banta hai tatha tamba laal rang mein jama ho jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki adhik kriya-sheel dhaatu kam kriya-sheel dhaatu ko uske lavan se hataa deti hai, isliye reaction Fe + CuSO4 se FeSO4 + Cu banta hai; iske ulat sone tatha chandi copper se kam kriya-sheel hain tatha tamba ko nahi hata sakte. Iske ulat is kriya se rang badalna tatha tamba ka jama hona aankhon se dikhta hai, isliye ye sahi jod hai. Exam point: copper sulfate ke ghole se tamba (copper) ko loha (iron) bahar dhakel deta hai, kyunki loha copper se adhik kriya-sheel dhaatu hai.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of Calcium Oxide (CaO)?
qh: कैल्शियम ऑक्साइड (CaO) की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Calcium oxide (CaO) ek kshaariya (basic) oxide hai; jab ye paani ke saath milta hai to calcium hydroxide banata hai tatha jab ye amal ke saath kriya karta hai to lavan tatha paani deta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki calcium ek prabal dhaatu hai tatha uske oxide ka byavhaar kshaar jaisa hota hai, isliye ise lagaye hue litmus ka rang nila ho jaata hai; isi karan choona (lime) mitti ki khattas ko bhi kam karta hai. Iske ulat CO2 tatha SO2 jaisi non-metal ke oxide amliya hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: calcium oxide (CaO) ek kshaariya (basic) oxide hai - yahi paani tatha aml ke saath kriya karke lavan banata hai.

qe: Which 'Calcium' salt is used for removing moisture from gases (Desiccant)?
qh: गैसों से नमी को हटाने के लिए किस 'कैल्शियम' लवण का उपयोग सुखाने वाले एजेंट (Desiccant) के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Gases se nami (moisture) hatane ke liye anhydrous calcium chloride (CaCl2) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye paani ke anuon ko apne bheetar kheench (absorb) leta hai tatha padarth ko sookha rakhta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki CaCl2 jab paani ko leta hai to wo apni sajaavat badal kar hydrate bana leta hai tatha battery ke ghar mein bhi nami kheenchta hai, isliye ise desiccant (sookha karne wala) kehte hain; iske ulat CaCO3 tatha CaSO4 itne prabhavi absorber nahi hain. Iske ulat ye dikhne mein safed dana (granules) hota hai, isliye pehchaan aasaan hoti hai. Exam point: gases se nami hatane (desiccant) ke liye anhydrous calcium chloride (CaCl2) ka istemal hota hai - yahi paani ke anuon ko sokh leta hai.

qe: The 'Lustre' of metals is due to:
qh: धातुओं की 'धात्विक चमक' (Lustre) किसके कारण होती है?
o: Reflection of light by free electrons
e: Dhaatuon ki chamak (lustre) ka karan yahi hai ki unke andar mukta (free) electron hote hain; jab roshni dhaatu ki satah par padti hai to ye electron uttejit hokar ushi urja ko paravartit (reflect) kar dete hain, isse satah chamakdar dikhti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki dhaatu ke electron kisi ek atom se bandhe nahi rehte, balki poore tatha 'electron samudra' ki tarah chalte hain, isi karan dhaatu bijli tatha ushma ke bhi achhe chaalak hote hain; iske ulat lakdi tatha plastik ke electron bandhe hone se wo chamakdar nahi hote. Iske ulat yahi gun dhaatuon ki pehchaan (lustre) deta hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dhaatuon ki chamak (lustre) mukta electron dwara roshni ke paravartan se hoti hai - isi karan dhaatu bijli tatha ushma ke chaalak bhi hote hain.

qe: Which metal is found in the 'Earth's Crust' in the highest percentage among all metals?
qh: सभी धातुओं में पृथ्वी की पपड़ी में सर्वाधिक प्रतिशत में कौन सी धातु पाई जाती है?
e: Prithvi ke bhoopatal (crust) mein sabse adhik matara mein milne wali dhaatu aluminium hai (lagbhag 8 pratishat), kyunki bauxite tatha mitti ke khanijon mein yahi badi matara mein paaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aluminium oxygen ke saath bahut sthir bandhan banata hai tatha mitti tatha patthar ki sajaavat mein yahi bhaari bhaag hai, isliye ise khann se nikaalna mehanga padta hai (vidyut ki adhik khapat); iske ulat loha (lagbhag 5%) tatha tamba bahut kam matara mein hote hain. Iske ulat isi karan sasta hone par bhi aluminium purane loha se mehanga padta hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: prithvi ki chhalk mein dhaatuon mein sabse adhik matara aluminium ki hai - isi karan ye bhoomi, mitti tatha patthar ka mukhya tatva hai.

qe: What is 'Epsom Salt' used for in traditional farming and medicine?
qh: पारंपरिक खेती और चिकित्सा में 'एप्सम सॉल्ट' का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
o: As a fertilizer and for muscle pain
e: Epsom salt (magnesium sulfate, MgSO4.7H2O) ka istemal do tarah se hota hai - kheton mein magnesium ki kami door karne ke liye (khaad) tatha medicine mein garm paani se nahi, balki paani mein mila kar nas-peshiyon ke dard tatha sujan ke liye (Epsom salt bath). Iska karan yahi hai ki magnesium paudhon ki hari patti (chlorophyll) ke liye zaroori hai tatha jild par lagane se aaram pahunchata hai, isliye ghar tatha aspataal dono mein yahi upyog aata hai. Iske ulat sodium tatha calcium ke lavan is khaas do-upyog ke liye aam nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Epsom salt (MgSO4.7H2O) ka istemal khaad tatha nas-peshiyon ke dard (muscle pain) ke liye hota hai - yahi magnesium ka prachlit lavan hai.

qe: Which metal 'Floats' on water because the Hydrogen gas bubbles stick to its surface?
qh: कौन सी धातु पानी पर तैरने लगती है क्योंकि हाइड्रोजन गैस के बुलबुले उसकी सतह पर चिपक जाते हैं?
e: Calcium dhaatu paani par tairti dikhti hai, kyunki uski satah par hydrogen gas ke bulble chipak jaate hain; is karan dhaatu ka bhaar gas ke saath kam ho jaata hai tatha wo paani par tairti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki calcium paani se kriya karke hydrogen chhodta hai tatha ye gas dhaatu ki satah par chipki rehti hai, isi karan calcium paani mein doobne ke bajaye tairti hai (yahi gun ushe khusus banata hai); iske ulat sodium pehle ushma ke saath tez kriya karta hai. Iske ulat isi karan calcium ko savdhani se sambhalna padta hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: calcium dhaatu paani par tairti hai, kyunki uski satah par chipki hydrogen gas ke bulble ushe halka bana dete hain.

qe: What is 'Slaked Lime' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'बुझा हुआ चूना' (Slaked Lime) क्या है?
e: Slaked lime calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) hota hai; ise quicklime (CaO) par paani daal kar banaaya jaata hai tatha yahi paani ke saath mila kar 'lime water' (saaf ghol) deta hai. Iska upyog cement-mortar, plaster tatha paani ki soil acdiT ko sahi karne mein hota hai, kyunki ye kshaariya hota hai tatha mitti ki khattas ko santulit karta hai; iske ulat CaCO3 tatha CaSO4 alag padarth hain jo alag kaam aate hain. Iske ulat isi ko 'builder's lime' bhi kehte hain, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: slaked lime ka rasayanik naam calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) hota hai - yahi quicklime par paani daalne se banta hai tatha nirmaan mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Thermite Welding' to join railway tracks?
qh: रेल की पटरियों को जोड़ने के लिए 'थर्माइट वेल्डिंग' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thermite welding mein aluminium ki dhool tatha loha oxide (Fe2O3) ka mishran jalaaya jaata hai; aluminium oxygen ke liye adhik lagav hone ke karan loha oxide se oxygen kheench leta hai tatha pighla loha (molten iron) bahut uchch tapman par nikalta hai. Isi pighle loha se rel ki patariyon (railway tracks) ki jodai ki jaati hai, kyunki aluminium ke is asar se lagbhag 2500 degree C tak tapman paida hota hai; iske ulat isi kriya se dhaatu ki karigarh tatha kaccher (blast) ka kaam bhi hota hai. Iske ulat tamba tatha zinc jaisi dhaatuen itni ushma paida nahi karti, isliye wo naam yahan sahi nahi baithte. Exam point: rel ki patariyon ki jodai (thermite welding) ke liye aluminium ka istemal hota hai - yahi loha oxide se oxygen kheench kar bahut garam pighla loha deta hai.

qe: What is 'Dolomite' an ore of?
qh: 'डोलोमाइट' (Dolomite) किसका अयस्क है?
e: Dolomite (CaCO3.MgCO3) ek mishrit ayask hai jo calcium tatha magnesium dono ka srot hai; ise jala kar magnesia (MgO) tatha choona banaaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki dolomite dono kshaariya dhaatuon ko ek hi patthar mein rakhta hai, isliye ise loha-banane ki bhatti mein flux ke roop mein tatha magnesium nikaalne mein istemal karte hain; iske ulat limestone (CaCO3) mein magnesium nahi hota. Iske ulat ye magnesite (MgCO3) se alag hai jo keval magnesium ka ayask hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dolomite ayask calcium tatha magnesium dono ka srot hota hai - isi karan yahi flux tatha magnesium nikaalne ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Liquid' metal at 30°C (slightly above room temperature)?
qh: 30°C पर (कमरे के तापमान से थोड़ा ऊपर) निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी धातु 'तरल' अवस्था में होती है?
e: Gallium ki khaas baat yahi hai ki uska galaank lagbhag 30 degree C (kamre ke tapman se thoda adhik) hota hai; isliye ye 30 degree C se upar drav ban jaata hai tatha haath mein rakhne par bhi pighal jaata hai, jabki wo 2400 degree C ki bahut uchch ushma tak drav hi rehta hai. Isi karan ye thermometer tatha semiconductor (LED, transistor) mein kaam aata hai, kyunki ye kam tapman par drav hone par bhi uchch tapman tak drav reh sakta hai; iske ulat paara kamre ke tapman par drav hai par uski ukbalan kam hai. Iske ulat ye bhaari dhaatu nahi hai tatha chipakta nahi hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 30 degree C (kamre ke tapman se thoda adhik) par drav banne wali dhaatu gallium hai - isi karan haath mein rakhne par ye pighal jaati hai.

qe: What is the 'Hardness' of an element compared to on the Mohs scale? Which is 10?
qh: मोह्स पैमाने पर 10 की कठोरता किसकी मानी जाती है?
e: Mohs paimane par sabse kathor padarth diamond hai, jiski kathorata ka aankda 10 hota hai; yani yahi kisi bhi padarth ko kharoch sakta hai par ise koi kharoch nahi sakta (heere ke alaava). Iska karan yahi hai ki heere mein carbon ke atom chaar-chaar mazboot sahayogi (covalent) bandhan se ek thir-aayam (3D) jala banate hain, isliye ise todna ya ghisna sabse mushkil hota hai - isi karan ye katai tatha drill ke sire par istemal hota hai. Iske ulat corundum (9) tatha topaz (8) isse kam kathor hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Mohs paimane par kathorata ka sarvochch aankda 10 diamond ka hota hai - yahi sabse kathor padarth hai tatha sab kuchh ko kharoch sakta hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Lead' pencils?
qh: 'लेड' पेंसिल में किस धातु या अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lead pencil ke andar 'sisa' (lead) nahi balki graphite hota hai; graphite carbon ka narm pratyaroop hai jiski paratein kaagaz par khinchne par ek patli kaali lakeer (line) chhod deti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki graphite paraton ke beech bandhan kamjor hota hai, isliye wo aasaani se ghista hai tatha kaagaz par nishan banata hai; iske ulat heera kathor hone ke karan aisaa nishan nahi banata. Iske ulat 'lead' naam sirf purane bhrm ki den hai, isliye ise theek samajhna zaroori hai. Exam point: pencil ke andar graphite hota hai (sisa nahi) - isi karan pencil se likha jaata hai tatha nishan kaala banta hai.

qe: What is 'Mortar' in construction made of?
qh: निर्माण में प्रयुक्त 'मोर्टार' (गारा) किससे बना होता है?
e: Nirmaan mein istemal hone wala mortar (chuna-masala) mukhya roop se slaked lime (Ca(OH)2), ret (sand) tatha paani ka mishran hota hai; yahi eenthoj ko jodne tatha deewar par lagane kaam aata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye mishran hawa ki carbon dioxide se kriya karke wapas calcium carbonate ban jaata hai tatha sakht ho jaata hai, isi karan diwaar mazboot banti hai; iske ulat cement tatha concrete mein alag padarth tatha matara hoti hai (wahan Ca-silicate hota hai). Iske ulat ismein loha tatha tamba mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: mortar slaked lime, ret tatha paani ka mishran hota hai - yahi hawa ki CO2 se kriya karke sakht ho jaata hai tatha eento ko jodta hai.

qe: Which metal provides 'Strength' to the exoskeleton of sea shells?
qh: समुद्री सीपियों के बाह्यकंकाल को कौन सी धातु 'मजबूती' प्रदान करती है?
e: Samundri shankh (sea shells) tatha anya jeevon ka bahari kavach (exoskeleton) mukhya roop se calcium carbonate se banta hai; isi karan unhe kathorata tatha suraksha milti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki calcium carbonate ek sthir tatha sabse aam khanij hai jo samudri paani se aasaani se ban jaata hai, isliye calcium ko samudri jeevon ki rakchha ka aadhaar kaha jaata hai; iske ulat silica tatha phosphate bhi kuchh jeevon mein hote hain, par shankh mukhya roop se calcium ka hi banta hai. Iske ulat loha tatha magnesium is kaam ke liye mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: samudri shankh (sea shells) ke bahari kavach ko mazbooti dene ke liye calcium ka istemal hota hai - yahi calcium carbonate ke roop mein usmein jama hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Reactivity' of Gold?
qh: सोने की 'सक्रियता' कैसी होती है?
e: Sona (gold) ki kriya-sheelata sabse kam hoti hai, isliye ise 'noble' (saumya) dhaatu kaha jaata hai; ye hawa, paani, aml tatha kshaar se asar nahi leta tatha saal-ha-saal chamakdar bana rehta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sona oxidation ke liye pravrit nahi hota, isliye ushe zameen se shudh tatha bina kisi lep ke milta hai; isi karan sona gehne tatha sikka ke liye sabse pasandida dhaatu raha hai. Loha tatha tamba zameen mein oxide bankar hi milte hain, isi liye wo saumya (noble) nahi hain. Exam point: sona (gold) sabse kam kriya-sheel (least reactive/noble) dhaatu hai - isi karan ye hawa tatha amlon se bhi kharab nahi hota.

qe: Which non-metal is the 'Hardest'?
qh: कौन सी अधातु सबसे 'कठोर' है?
e: Non-metalon mein sabse kathor padarth diamond hai; yahi carbon ka ek pratyaroop hai jismein har atom chaar doosre atoms se mazboot sahayogi bandhan se juda hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki is mazboot thir-aayam (3D) jale ke karan heera kisi bhi padarth ko kharoch sakta hai tatha khud kam nahi hota, isliye ise katai tatha drill ke sire par istemal karte hain; iske ulat graphite (carbon ka doosra roop) tatha sulfur bahut narm hote hain. Iske ulat heera balki sabhi padarthon mein sabse kathor hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: non-metalo mein sabse kathor padarth diamond (heera) hai - isi karan yahi dhaatuon ko bhi kharoch tatha kaat sakta hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Anodizing' to create a thick oxide layer?
qh: मोटी ऑक्साइड परत बनाने के लिए 'एनोडीकरण' (Anodizing) में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Anodizing vidhi mein aluminium ko dhan chhor (anode) bana kar vidyut ke zariye uski satah par moti oxide (Al2O3) ki parat banai jaati hai; isse aluminium ki jang-rok (corrosion resistance) tatha rang taaza rehta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye parat chhidrawali (porous) hoti hai, isliye usme rang bhar kar sundar rang bhi diya jaata hai tatha bartan tatha khidki ke frame par yahi kiya jaata hai; iske ulat tamba tatha loha par aisi parat nahi banti. Iske ulat isi karan anodized aluminium zyada chamakdar tatha tikau hota hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: anodizing vidhi se aluminium par moti oxide ki parat banai jaati hai - isse ye jang se bachta hai tatha isme rang bhi bhara ja sakta hai.

qe: What is the 'Charge' on an Alkaline Earth Metal ion?
qh: क्षारीय मृदा धातु आयन पर क्या 'आवेश' (Charge) होता है?
e: Alkaline earth dhaatuen (Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba) apne bahari kosh ke do electron chhod kar sthir (noble gas) sajaavat paati hain, isliye unke aayan par +2 aavesh aata hai; isi karan unka samanik sutra MX2 hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki do electron chhodne ke baad unka bahari kosh poora ho jaata hai, isliye unki valency 2 hoti hai tatha wo do rin aayan (jaise Cl-) ke saath jud jaate hain (jaise CaCl2); iske ulat alkali dhaatuen (Na, K) ek electron chhodti hain tatha +1 aavesh deti hain. Iske ulat +3 aayan aluminium jaisi dhaatuon ki hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: alkaline earth dhaatuon ke aayan par +2 aavesh hota hai - kyunki we do electron chhod kar noble gas sajaavat paate hain.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Galvanization'?
qh: 'गैल्वनीकरण' (Galvanization) में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Loha ko jang se bachane ki vidhi mein usmein zinc ki patli parat chadhai jaati hai, isi kriya ko galvanization kehte hain; yahan zinc khud pehle oxid hota hai tatha loha salamat rehta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki zinc loha se adhik kriya-sheel (reactive) hone ke karan pehle kharab hota hai, isi liye galvanized pipe, tank tatha chhat ke saman saal-ha-saal chalte hain. Iske ulat tamba ya tin ki parat lagane se ye gun nahi milta, kyunki wo loha se adhik kriya-sheel nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: galvanization mein loha par zinc ki parat chadhai jaati hai - yahi loha se pehle kharab hokar ushe jang se bachaati hai.

qe: What is 'Calamine' lotion used for in skin treatments?
qh: त्वचा के उपचार में उपयोग किया जाने वाला 'कैलामाइन' लोशन क्या है?
e: Calamine lotion mein mukhya roop se zinc oxide tatha zinc carbonate hote hain; ise khujli (itching), daabe (rashes) tatha jale hue sthal par shaant karne ke liye lagaya jaata hai.
