Iska karan yahi hai ki zinc ke ye lavan jild ki sujan ko kam karte hain tatha sookhne mein madad karte hain, isliye ye garmi ke daane tatha machchhar ke kaatne par bhi upyog aata hai; sodium tatha calcium ke lavan jild ki khujli par is tarah asar nahi dete, isliye wo naam galat honge. Exam point: calamine lotion mein zinc carbonate (tatha zinc oxide) hota hai - isi karan ye khujli tatha jild ke soojan ko shaant karta hai.

qe: Which metal reacts with 'Steam' to form an Oxide and Hydrogen?
qh: कौन सी धातु 'भाप' के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करके ऑक्साइड और हाइड्रोजन बनाती है?
e: Loha (iron) uchch tapman ki bhaap (steam) ke saath kriya karke iron oxide (Fe3O4) tatha hydrogen gas deta hai; yahi kriya dikhati hai ki loha paani ki bhaap se bhi oxid ho sakta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki uchch tapman par bhaap ke saath kriya tez ho jaati hai, isliye purane bhaap bhatti (boiler) mein loha kharab hone ka khatra rehta hai; iske ulat thanda paani mein loha jaldi kriya nahi karta. Iske ulat zinc tatha tamba bhi ye kriya dete hain, par prashn ke anusar loha sahi jod hai. Exam point: loha bhaap (steam) ke saath kriya karke oxide tatha hydrogen gas banata hai - yahi uchch tapman par loha kharab hone ka karan hai.

qe: Which metal is the 'Best' conductor of heat?
qh: ऊष्मा की सबसे 'अच्छी' चालक कौन सी धातु है?
e: Ushma tatha vidyut, dono ke chaalakta mein chandni (silver) sabse aage hoti hai - iska matlab yahi hai ki uski pratirodhakta sabse kam hoti hai tatha ushma bahut tezi se guzarti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki silver ke ek bahari kosh mein ek mukta electron hota hai jo bahut aasaani se bahav karta hai, isliye ise uchch shuddhta ki bijli tatha ushma ke kaam mein istemal karte hain; iske ulat tamba sasta hone ke karan aam tar mein istemal hota hai. Iske ulat aluminium bhi achha chaalak hai par silver se kam, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ushma tatha vidyut ka sabse achha chaalak chandni (silver) hai - keval mehanga hone ke karan aam tar mein tamba istemal hota hai.

qe: What is 'Plaster of Paris' used for?
qh: 'प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस' का उपयोग किसमें किया जाता है?
e: Plaster of Paris (CaSO4.1/2H2O) ko paani ke saath milakar paste banaya jaata hai, jo thodi der mein sakht (set) ho jaata hai tatha apna aakaar banaae rakhta hai; isi karan ise haddi tootne par ushe jodne (plaster) tatha saanchi (mould) banane mein istemal karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye sakht hone ke samay halka-sa failta hai isliye ghav ki sajaavat ko theek se bhar deta hai, isliye doctor ise bandage ke saath lagate hain; iske ulat dead burnt plaster der se sakht hota hai tatha aisa kaam nahi deta. Iske ulat iska upyog dant ke doctor (dentist) tatha murti banane mein bhi hota hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: tooti haddi ko jodne (plaster) mein Plaster of Paris (CaSO4.1/2H2O) ka istemal hota hai - yahi paani ke saath sakht hokar aakaar banaae rakhta hai.

qe: Which metal is kept under 'Kerosene'?
qh: किस धातु को 'मिट्टी के तेल' (Kerosene) में रखा जाता है?
e: Potassium (tatha sodium) hawa tatha nami se kriya karke aag pakad sakta hai, isliye ushe ek khaas taral (kerosene tel) ke neeche rakha jaata hai, taki hawa tatha paani usse door rahein. Iska karan yahi hai ki potassium bahut kriya-sheel dhaatu hai tatha hawa ki nami se hi kriya karke jal uthta hai, isliye ise khuli hawa mein rakhna khatarnaak hota hai; iske ulat sona tatha tamba hawa mein surakshit rehte hain. Iske ulat ye ek purani tatha surakshit reeti hai jise laboratory mein aaj bhi apnaya jaata hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: potassium ko kerosene tel ke neeche rakha jaata hai, kyunki ye hawa tatha nami se kriya karke aag pakad sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Lime Water'?
qh: 'चूने का पानी' (Lime Water) क्या है?
e: Lime water (chuna-paani) calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) ka saaf tatha patla ghol hota hai, jise choone ke paani mein ghulane par banaaya jaata hai; yahi ghol carbon dioxide gas ki pehchaan karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki CO2 guzarne par ye dudhiya (milky) ho jaata hai, kyunki calcium carbonate banata hai - isi karan ise laboratory mein CO2 test tatha paani ki shuddhta ki jaanch mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat calcium carbonate khud paani mein nahi ghulta, isliye wo lime water nahi hai. Iske ulat ismein sodium tatha magnesium mukhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lime water calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) ka ghol hota hai - yahi CO2 gas ke guzarne par dudhiya ho jaata hai tatha yahi pehchaan ka tareeka hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Surgical' instruments because it doesn't rust?
qh: 'सर्जिकल' उपकरणों में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि इसमें जंग नहीं लगता है?
e: Shaly-chikitsa (surgery) ke ojaar tatha chhuri isliye 'stainless steel' se bante hain, kyunki ismein chromium hone ke karan ye jang (rust) nahi pakadta tatha garam karke jivanu-mukt (sterile) karne par bhi kharab nahi hota. Iska karan yahi hai ki chromium satah par oxide ki rakshak parat bana deta hai tatha nikal majbooti deta hai, isliye aspataal mein yahi dhaatu sabse zyada istemal hoti hai; iske ulat sadharan loha tatha tamba aspataal ke saman ke liye upyukt nahi hote (wo jang tatha khaney ke aml se kharab jaate hain). Titanium bhi sharir ke andar theek chalta hai par mehanga padta hai, isliye aam chikitsa mein stainless steel hi zyada istemal hota hai. Exam point: shaly-chikitsa ke ojaar stainless steel se bante hain - kyunki ye jang nahi pakadta tatha aasaani se jivanu-mukt kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Malleability'?
qh: 'आघातवर्धनीयता' (Malleability) क्या है?
o: Ability to be drawn into wires
Ability to be beaten into sheets
e: Taar-kheenchav (malleability) dhaatu ka wo gun hai jismein ushe bina todiye hathore (hammer) se peekar patli chaadar (sheet) banaya ja sakta hai; yani dhaatu ka pitkar failne ka gun hi malleability kehlata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki dhaatuon ke atom ek seedhi sajaavat mein baithe hote hain tatha ek parat doosri par sarak jaati hai, isliye sone-chandi ki bahut patli parat banaayi ja sakti hai (sone ki warq); iske ulat kaanch tatha patthar is tarah nahi phailte. Iske ulat 'ductility' isse alag gun hai jismein dhaatu ko taar ke roop mein kheecha jaata hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: malleability dhaatu ke peekar patli chaadar (sheet) banane ke gun ko kehte hain - isi karan sona-chandi ki warq banti hai.

qe: Which metal has the 'Lowest' melting point?
qh: किस धातु का गलनांक सबसे 'कम' होता है?
e: Dhaatuon mein sabse kam galaank (melting point) paara (mercury) ka hota hai (lagbhag -39 degree C), isliye ye saadharan tapman par bhi drav rehta hai; isi karan ise thermometer tatha barometer mein bhara jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paara ke atomon ke beech bandhan kamjor hota hai (uske d-orbitals poore bhare nahi hote tatha paridalan aadi ka asar), isliye thodi hi ushma se ye pighal kar bah jaata hai; iske ulat gallium lagbhag 30 degree C par pighalta hai tatha tungsten sabse ucch galaank wala hai. Iske ulat isi karan paara zehirili bhaap bhi bahut jaldi deta hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dhaatuon mein sabse kam galaank paara (mercury) ka hota hai - isi karan ye saadharan tapman par taral (drav) rehta hai.

qe: Which element is found in 'Enamel' of teeth?
qh: दांतों के 'इनेमल' में कौन सा तत्व पाया जाता है जो सड़न रोकता है?
e: Daanton ke upari safed parat (enamel) mein mukhya roop se fluorine hota hai, jo calcium tatha phosphate ke saath milkar fluorapatite banata hai; isi parat se daant kathor tatha sadne (cavity) se surakshit rehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki fluorine daant ki satah par aml-rodhak parat banata hai tatha kitanuon ke aml ko rokta hai, isliye toothpaste tatha paani mein ise sahi matara mein milaaya jaata hai; par bahut adhik matara se daanton par dhabbe (fluorosis) aa jaate hain. Iske ulat calcium tatha phosphorus bhi enamel mein hote hain, par prashn ke anusar 'khaas' tatva fluorine hai. Exam point: daanton ke enamel (safed parat) mein fluorine tatva paaya jaata hai - yahi daanton ko kathor tatha cavity se surakshit banata hai.

qe: What is 'Magnesite'?
qh: 'मैग्नेसाइट' (Magnesite) क्या है?
e: Magnesite magnesium carbonate (MgCO3) ka naam hai; ise jala kar magnesia (MgO) banaaya jaata hai, jo ushma-rodhak (refractory) padarth hai tatha bhatti ki antari parat mein istemal hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki MgO bahut uchch tapman sahta hai tatha kshaariya hote hue brick ko surakshit rakhta hai, isliye isteel tatha cement udyog mein magnesite ka bada mahatva hai; iske ulat dolomite tatha calcite anya khanij hain jinmein calcium bhi hota hai. Iske ulat magnesium sulfate (Epsom salt) alag padarth hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: magnesite MgCO3 hota hai - ise jala kar magnesia (MgO) banta hai jo bhatti ki ushma-rodhak parat (refractory) ke liye istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal is 'Paramagnetic'?
qh: कौन सी धातु 'अनुचुंबकीय' (Paramagnetic) है?
e: Aluminium ek paramagnetic dhaatu hai, kyunki usmein ek akela (unpaired) electron hota hai tatha wo chumbakiya kshetra (magnetic field) ki or kamjor taur par kheenchta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paramagnetism kamzor hoti hai (loha jaisi prabal nahi), isliye aluminium chumbak se chipakta nahi par halka aakarshan dikhaata hai; iske ulat loha tatha nikal ferromagnetic hone ke karan chumbak se chipak jaate hain. Iske ulat zinc tatha tamba (diamagnetic) chumbak se bilkul nahi kheenchte, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium ek paramagnetic dhaatu hai - ismein akela electron hone ke karan ye chumbakiya kshetra ki or halka kheenchta hai (loha jaisa chipakta nahi).

qe: Which metal is extracted from the ore Bauxite?
qh: किस धातु का निष्कर्षण बॉक्साइट (Bauxite) अयस्क से किया जाता है?
e: Bauxite aluminium ka mukhya ayesk hai, jismein aluminium oxide ki matra mile sabse zyada hoti hai. Isse pehle aluminium ko vidyut ki sahayata se alag kiya jaata hai, isliye aluminium banane me bahut bijli kharch hoti hai. Iron, Copper, Zinc is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Aluminium hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Aluminium - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein. Aise prashnon mein sahi vikalp wahi hota hai jo prashn ke kaal tatha kshetra se poora mel khata hai, baaki vikalp anya ghatnaon se aa jaate hain.

qe: Which metal is 'Ductile' but a poor conductor compared to silver?
qh: कौन सी धातु 'तन्य' है लेकिन चांदी की तुलना में खराब चालक है?
e: Sisa (lead) ek narm dhaatu hone ke saath-saath vidyut tatha ushma ka kamzor chaalak hai, kyunki usmein mukta electron kam hote hain tatha wo bhaari bhi hota hai. Isi karan ise kuchh khaas jagahon par istemal karte hain, jaise battery ke plet, X-ray shield tatha purane pipe, jahan achhi chaalakta se zyada bhaar tatha lachak ki zaroorat hoti hai; iske ulat tamba tatha chandni ke chaalakta bahut adhik hoti hai. Iske ulat isi karan solder mein lead tin ke saath milta hai (kam galaank ke liye), isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: lead dhaatu kheenchne yogya (ductile) par vidyut tatha ushma ka khrabz chaalak hai - isliye iska istemal battery tatha shielding mein hota hai.

qe: What is the color of 'Magnesium Oxide'?
qh: 'मैग्नीशियम ऑक्साइड' का रंग क्या होता है?
e: Magnesium oxide (MgO) ka rang safed hota hai; ise 'magnesia' bhi kehte hain tatha yahi magnesium jalne par safed dhuan/choore ke roop mein banta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki MgO ek safed tatha sthir padarth hai, isliye ise dhoop se bachav (sunscreen), safed rang tatha jild ke powder mein istemal karte hain; iske ulat copper oxide kaala tatha iron oxide laal hota hai. Iske ulat isi safed rang ke karan magnesium ka jalna safed roshni deta hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: magnesium oxide (MgO) ka rang safed hota hai - isi karan magnesium jalne par safed dhuan deta hai tatha yahi magnesia ke roop mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal displacement is used in the 'Thermite' process?
qh: 'थर्माइट' प्रक्रिया में किस धातु का विस्थापन उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Thermite kriya mein aluminium tatha loha oxide ka mishran jalaya jaata hai; aluminium oxygen ke liye zyada lagav hone ke karan loha ko uske oxide se alag kar deta hai, isliye loha (Fe) bahar nikal aata hai. Yahi kriya loha ko aluminium dwara bahar dhakelne (displacement) ka udaharan hai tatha ismein bahut ushma nikalati hai, isliye patariyon ki jodai tatha bhaari dhaatu ke hisse jodne mein iska istemal hota hai; tamba tatha zinc itni ushma nahi dete. Exam point: thermite process mein aluminium loha (Fe) ko uske oxide se bahar dhakel deta hai - isi karan yahi kriya patariyon ki jodai mein istemal hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Quicklime' used to remove from soil?
qh: मिट्टी से क्या हटाने के लिए 'बिना बुझा चूना' (Quicklime) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Quicklime (choone ke patthar ko jalakar banaaya gaya CaO) ka istemal kheton ki mitti ki khattas (acidity) kam karne ke liye hota hai; ise mitti mein milane par ye aml ke saath kriya karke pH tatha calcium ka star sahi karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki khatti (acidic) mitti mein chuna daalne se paudhon ko calcium milta hai tatha mitti phalne-foolne layak ban jaati hai, isliye kisan yahi vidhi apnaate hain; iske ulat sodium chloride (namak) mitti ki khattas ko kam nahi karta. Iske ulat isi karan mitti ki jaanch ke baad hi chuna dala jaata hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: quicklime ka istemal mitti ki khattas (acidity) kam karne ke liye hota hai - yahi aml se kriya karke mitti ka pH sahi karta hai.

qe: Which non-metal is 'Lustrous'?
qh: कौन सी अधातु 'चमकदार' (Lustrous) होती है?
e: Iodine ek non-metal hai tatha uske chamakdar (krystal) roop mein dhantli chamak dikhti hai; yahi karan hai ki iodine ke krystal chandi jaisi chamak dete hain, isliye ise 'lustrous non-metal' kaha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iodine ke krystal mein atom aise sajaavat banaate hain ki roshni paravartit hoti hai tatha iska rang gehra bainguni-kaala hota hai; iske ulat sulfur tatha phosphorus chamakdar nahi hote. Iske ulat iodine ki chamak uske jivanu-nashak tatha dawa ke gun se alag baat hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: chamakdar (lustrous) non-metal iodine hai - iske krystal chandi jaisi chamak dikhate hain (aisa gun aam taur par dhaatuon mein hota hai).

qe: What is 'Limestone' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'चूना पत्थर' (Limestone) क्या है?
e: Limestone ka rasayanik naam calcium carbonate (CaCO3) hota hai; ise jalane (calcination) par quicklime milta hai tatha isi se cement, choona tatha anya nirmaan saman bante hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki limestone patthar, sangmarmar (marble) tatha samudri shankh ka mukhya tatva hai, isliye yahi sabse aam tatha sasta srot hai; sath hi aml ke saath kriya karke CO2 gas deta hai, isi karan ise laboratory tatha udyog dono mein istemal karte hain. Iske ulat gypsum tatha dolomite alag khanij hain jinmein calcium ke saath anya tatva hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: limestone chemically calcium carbonate (CaCO3) hota hai - yahi patthar, marble tatha shankh ka mukhya tatva hai tatha choona-cemant ka aadhaar hai.

qe: Which metal has the 'Highest' density?
qh: किस धातु का 'घनत्व' उच्चतम होता है?
e: Sabse adhik ghanatva (density) wali dhaatu osmium hai (lagbhag 22.6 g/cm3), iske baad iridium aata hai; yahi karan hai ki ye dhaatuen bhaari tatha ghani hoti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki in dhaatuon ke atom bhaari hote hain tatha sajaavat mein kas kar baithe hote hain, isliye ek chhota tukda bhi bahut bhaari lagta hai; inhe 'platinum group' dhaatuon mein rakha jaata hai. Iske ulat lead (11.3) tatha sona (19.3) bhi bhaari hain par osmiumse kam, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sabse adhik ghanatva (highest density) wali dhaatu osmium hoti hai - iske baad iridium aata hai tatha yahi platinum group ki dhaatuen hain.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of Non-metal oxides?
qh: अधातु के ऑक्साइड की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Non-metals ke oxides aam taur par amliya (acidic) hote hain, kyunki ye paani ke saath milkar aml banate hain - jaise CO2 se carbonic acid, SO2 se sulfurous acid tatha NO2 se nitric acid banti hai. Isi karan non-metal ke oxide nile litmus ko laal kar dete hain tatha unhe 'amlkeey oxide' kehte hain; iske ulat dhaatu (metal) ke oxides kshaariya (basic) hote hain jo laal litmus ko nila karte hain. Iske ulat kuchh oxides ubhay-bhaavi (amphoteric) bhi hote hain, isliye keval 'acidic' likhna aam baat hai. Exam point: non-metals ke oxides ka byavhaar amliya (acidic) hota hai - yahi paani ke saath milkar aml banate hain tatha litmus ko laal karte hain.

qe: Which metal is used in the 'Photoelectric Cell' because it emits electrons most easily when exposed to light?
qh: 'फोटोइलेक्ट्रिक सेल' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने पर सबसे आसानी से इलेक्ट्रॉन उत्सर्जित करती है?
e: Roshni padne par electron chhodne ka gun (photoelectric effect) cesium mein sabse adhik hota hai, kyunki uska valence electron nucleus se sabse kam bandha hua hota hai; isi karan photoelectric cell (prakash-vidyut koshika) mein cesium dhaatu lagai jaati hai. Yahi karan hai ki roshni ki thodi matara bhi bijli ka bahav shuru kar deti hai, isliye automatic darwaze, light-meter tatha sensor isi dhaatu se bante hain; dhaatu ki satah par electron chhodne ki ye kshamata hi iska mool gun hai. Sodium tatha potassium ka ye asar kam hota hai, isliye wo naam yahan galat honge. Exam point: photoelectric cell ke liye cesium chuna jaata hai, kyunki uske valence electron bahut aasaani se nikal jaate hain tatha roshni se bijli banti hai.

qe: What is the 'Main Constituent' of the alloy 'Invar'?
qh: मिश्र धातु 'इन्वार' (Invar) का 'मुख्य घटक' क्या है?
e: Invar ka asaadharan gun uske khaas mishran se aata hai, jismein mukhya dhaatuen loha (lagbhag 63%) tatha nikal (lagbhag 36%) hoti hain; isi anupat par uska prasaar gunank lagbhag shunya ho jaata hai. Isi karan ise naapi-patti tatha standard metre banane mein istemal karte hain, kyunki mausam ke saath unka naap nahi badalna chahiye; ismein chromium tatha cobalt mukhya nahi hote. Iske ulat peetal tatha kansa ke gun isse bilkul alag hain, isliye wo naam galat honge. Exam point: Invar mishradhatu ke mukhya tatva loha tatha nikal hote hain - isi karan ye tapman ke saath failti nahi.

qe: Which process is used to separate 'Mercury' from its ore Cinnabar?
qh: 'पारा' को उसके अयस्क सिनाबार से अलग करने के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Cinnabar (HgS) paara (mercury) ka pramukh ayask hota hai; isse paara nikaalne ke liye ayask ko hawa ki upasthiti mein garam kiya jaata hai, is kriya ko 'roasting' (bhunna) kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki is kriya mein sulfur oxygen ke saath jal kar SO2 gas ban jaata hai tatha paara ki bhaap nikalati hai, jise thanda karke drav paara milta hai - yahi sabse aasaan tareeka hai; iske ulat froth floatation tatha electrolysis is ayask ke liye upyukt nahi hote. Iske ulat isi karan purane rasayanik ne yahi vidhi apnayi, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cinnabar ayask se paara (mercury) nikaalne ke liye roasting (bhunna) vidhi istemal hoti hai - yahi sulfur ko SO2 ke roop mein hata kar paara deti hai.

qe: The main metal in the alloy Pewter is which of the following?
qh: प्यूटर (Pewter) मिश्र धातु का मुख्य धातु घटक निम्नलिखित में से कौन है?
e: Pewter ka mukhya dhatu ghatak tin hota hai, jismein thodi matra me tamba, antimony ya lead mili hoti hai. Tin ka pighalne ka taap kam hone se yah mithai tatha bartan banane ke liye purane samay me aasan dhaanche deta tha. Vikalp Copper, Zinc, Lead bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Tin hi milti hai. Exam point: Tin - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein. Is vishay mein poochhe jaane wale anya bindu bhi isi tathya se jude hote hain, isliye ek baar samajh lene par kaee prashnon ke jawab aasan ho jate hain.

qe: Which metal is 'Sacrificed' to protect iron ships from rusting (Cathodic Protection)?
qh: लोहे के जहाजों को जंग से बचाने के लिए किस धातु का 'बलिदान' (कैथोडिक संरक्षण) किया जाता है?
e: Jahaaz ki bhitar wali dhaatu tatha samudri paani ke sampark mein rehne wale propeller ko jang se bachane ke liye unke saath magnesium ya zinc ki plate kas di jaati hai; is vidhi mein ye sasti dhaatu khud nasht hoti hai tatha loha ko bachaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki magnesium tatha zinc loha se adhik kriya-sheel hain, isliye wo hawa tatha paani ki kriya apne upar le leti hain tatha loha ke electron ko bachaa leti hain; isi liye jahaaz ke propeller par zinc ka block lagta hai tatha samay-samay par badla jaata hai. Sona tatha tamba loha se kam kriya-sheel hote hain, isliye wo khud kharab hone ke bajaye loha ko kharab hone dete hain. Exam point: jahaaz tatha propeller ki suraksha ke liye magnesium ya zinc ki 'bali' plate lagai jaati hai - yahi pehle nasht hoti hai tatha loha salamat rehta hai.

qe: Which gas is used in 'Neon' signs to produce a brilliant 'Red' light?
qh: 'नियॉन' संकेतों में शानदार 'लाल' रोशनी पैदा करने के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Neon signs mein sabse prabal taaza laal (brilliant red) roshni paida karne ke liye neon gas bhara jaata hai; yahi gas is nishaani ka khaas rang deta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki neon ke electron uttejit hokar apni khaas tarangdairdhya (laal) ki kiran chhodte hain, isliye aise sign board 'neon' naam se hi jaane jaate hain; baaki rangon ke liye argon, paara tatha anya gasen milai jaati hain. Isse alag, helium halka gulaabi tatha argon nila-bainguni roshni deta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: neon sign board se tez laal roshni paane ke liye neon gas ka istemal hota hai - yahi roshni ka apna khaas rang deta hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Nuclear Reactors' as a coolant because of its high heat capacity?
qh: उच्च ताप क्षमता के कारण परमाणु रिएक्टरों में शीतलक (Coolant) के रूप में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nabhik reactor mein ushma le jaane ke liye bahut adhik ushma-sokhne wali kshamata wale padarth ki zaroorat hoti hai, isliye wahan drav sodium (liquid sodium) ko shitalak (coolant) ke roop mein istemal karte hain; yahi reactor se nikalne wali ushma ko aage bhejta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki sodium dhaatu ki ushma-sokhne ki kshamata adhik hoti hai tatha wo kam tapman par pighal kar bah jaata hai (galaank 98 degree C), isliye ye loop mein tezi se ghoomkar ushma ikattha karta hai; paani ke saath uski prabal kriya ko rokne ke liye aise loop alag rakhe jaate hain. Paani tatha hawa utni ushma sokh nahi paate tatha unki bhaap bahut badh jaati hai, isliye dono is kaam ke liye galat chunav hain. Exam point: nabhik reactor ke andar tapman le jaane ke liye drav sodium bhara jaata hai, kyunki yahi dhaatu sabse zyada ushma sokh kar le chalti hai.

qe: Which metal is the 'Main Constituent' of Bronze?
qh: कांस्य (Bronze) का 'मुख्य घटक' कौन सी धातु है?
e: Bronze (kansa) ka mukhya hissa tamba (copper) hota hai tatha uske saath tin mila hota hai; isi mishran se kathorata tatha ghisav-rodhak gun milte hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki tin milane se mishran mazboot ho jaata hai tatha usme se ghanti jaisi awaaz nikalti hai, isliye murtiyan, ghantiyan tatha purane hathiyar isi se bante the; peetal (brass) mein zinc milta hai tatha dono mishran bilkul alag hain. Isse alag, loha tatha chromium bronze ke gun nahi dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bronze (kansa) ka mukhya mishran tamba tatha tin ka hota hai - isi karan ye mazboot tatha ghanti jaisa naad dene wala hota hai.

qe: Which metal is used in the 'Filament' of a heater?
qh: हीटर के 'फिलामेंट' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Heater tatha iron ke garam hone wale taar ke liye nichrome (nikal, chromium tatha loha ka mishran) chuna jaata hai; itna garam hone ke baad bhi ye oxid nahi hota tatha saalon chalta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki nichrome ki pratirodhakta (resistance) bahut zyada hai, isliye current guzarne par kathor garam ho jaata hai tatha tamba jaisa taar toot jaata par ye khud bardaasht kar leta hai; isi gun ke karan toaster tatha oven ke coil bhi isi se bante hain. Shudh tamba tatha aluminium uchch tapman par turant pighal jaate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: heater ke filament ke liye nichrome istemal hota hai, kyunki ye adhik garmi par bhi nahi pighalta tatha oxid nahi hota.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Rechargeable Batteries' of mobile phones?
qh: मोबाइल फोन की 'रिचार्जेबल बैटरी' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Mobile tatha laptop ki punah-charge hone wali battery mein lithium dhaatu ka upyog hota hai; har charge par uske aayan ek chhor se doosre chhor tak jaate hain tatha dhara dete hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki lithium sabse halki dhaatu hone ke saath-saath ek hi bhaar mein bahut adhik urja rakhta hai, isliye halki battery bhi der tak chalti hai tatha baar-baar charge ho jaati hai; isi karan bijli se chalne wali gaadi mein bhi yahi istemal hota hai. Loha tatha nikal wali purani batteryen bhaari tatha kam kushal hoti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rechargeable battery mein lithium istemal hota hai - ye halka hone par bhi bahut urja sambhaalta hai tatha baar-baar charge hota hai.

qe: Which metal is found in 'Liquid' state at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर कौन सी धातु 'तरल' अवस्था में पाई जाती है?
e: Ghar ke thermometer ki naali mein jo chaandi jaisa chamakdar drav dikhta hai wo paara (mercury) hai; ye garmi padne par failta hai tatha thandak mein sikudta hai, isi karan naali ke stambh ki unchai se tapman pata chalta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki paara 39 degree C se neeche bhi nahi jamta tatha kathor garam hone par bhi drav rehta hai, isliye bahut chhote-bade sabhi tapman naap sakta hai; par iski bhaap zehirili hoti hai, isliye ab alcohol bhari thermometer tatha digital model aam ho gaye hain. Isse alag, gallium 30 degree C ke aas-paas pighalta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: purane thermometer mein paara bhara jaata tha kyunki ye garmi se barabar phailta hai tatha aam tapman par drav rehta hai - zeher hone ke karan ab iska istemal ghat gaya hai.

qe: Which transition metal is 'Diamagnetic' and used to protect steel in the 'Hot-dip' process?
qh: कौन सी संक्रमण धातु 'प्रतिचुंबकीय' (Diamagnetic) है और 'हॉट-डिप' प्रक्रिया में स्टील की सुरक्षा के लिए उपयोग की जाती है?
e: Zinc ke andar sabhi electron jode ke roop mein rehte hain tatha koi bhi electron akele nahi chhoota, isliye ye diamagnetic (pratichumbakiya) kehlata hai; isi zinc ki patli parat loha par garam-dip vidhi se chadhai jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki zinc ki patli parat hawa tatha nami ko loha tak pahunchne hi nahi deti tatha khud pehle kharab hoti hai, isliye steel ke pipe, tank tatha chhat lamba chalti hain; magnet se na chipakna ushe khaas jagahon mein upyogi banata hai. Isse alag, tamba tatha nikal ke gun is kaam ke liye alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: hot-dip vidhi se steel par zinc ki parat chadhai jaati hai - zinc diamagnetic hone ke karan magnet ko asar nahi karta tatha jang rokta hai.

qe: What is 'Yellow Cake'?
qh: 'येलो केक' (Yellow Cake) क्या है?
e: Uranium ayask ke shuddhikaran ke baad jo gaadha peela churna bachta hai ushe 'yellow cake' kehte hain tatha usaka rasayanik roop uranium oxide (U3O8) hota hai; ayask ke ghatiya tatha bhaari hisse ise banaate waqt alag ho jaate hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki is roop mein ayask halka ban jaata hai, isliye lambi doori tak ushe surakshit taur par le jaana aasaan hota hai tatha wahan se aage indhan banaaya jaata hai; isi karan duniya bhar mein uranium ka vyapar aksar peele churna ke roop mein hota hai. Ye sintered fuel ya radium ka namoona nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: yellow cake uranium ka saandrit oxide (U3O8) hota hai - isi roop mein ayask ko shodhan ke baad aage bheja jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Raney Nickel'?
qh: 'रेनी निकेल' (Raney Nickel) क्या है?
o: An alloy of Nickel and Aluminum treated with NaOH
e: Nikal tatha aluminium ka barabar-barabar (lagbhag 50-50) mishran banakar ushe garam NaOH ke ghol mein daala jaata hai; kshaar aluminium ko ghula deta hai tatha nikal ka chhidrawala (spongy) dhaanch bach jaata hai tatha yahi Raney nickel hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ghulne se nikal ki satah par anek sookshm chhed bach jaate hain, isliye tel tatha gasen uske sampark mein aakar hydrogenation jaisi kriya bahut tez kar deti hain; isi karan vanaspati ghee banane ke udyog mein isaka istemal hota hai. Raney nickel banane mein tamba ya chromium ki koi bhoomika nahi hoti tatha sadharan nikal ki chaadar itni prabhavi nahi hoti. Exam point: kshaar ki sahayata se nikal-aluminium mishran se tayar hone wale chhidrawale utprek ko Raney nickel kehte hain - yahi hydrogenation mein bahut prabhavi hota hai.

qe: Which element is used to produce 'Beacon Lights' for airports because its light can penetrate fog?
qh: हवाई अड्डों के लिए 'बीकन लाइट्स' बनाने में किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि इसका प्रकाश कोहरे को भेद सकता है?
e: Airport ki beacon lights tatha anya suraksha sanchetak (signal) lamp mein neon gas ka istemal hota hai, kyunki neon ki laal roshni lambe raaste tak dikhti hai tatha dhundh (fog) se aasaani se guzar jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki neon ki roshni ki tarangdairdhya tatha uski chamak aisi hoti hai ki wo kohre me bhi pahunchti hai, isliye pilot ko door se runway ka pata chalta hai; isi karan khatre ke sanchetak lamp isi gas se bante hain. Isse alag, helium tatha argon ki roshni itni door tak prabal nahi rahti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: airport ki beacon light mein neon gas ka istemal hota hai - yahi laal roshni dhundh ko cheer kar door tak pahunchti hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Woods Metal' along with Lead, Tin, and Cadmium?
qh: लेड, टिन और कैडमियम के साथ 'वुड्स मेटल' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Wood's metal mein bismuth ki matara sabse adhik hoti hai tatha uske saath lead, tin tatha cadmium milaaye jaate hain; isi karan iska galaank bahut kam (lagbhag 70 degree C) ho jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki bismuth apne aap mein bhi kam galaank wala hai tatha anya dhaatuon ke saath milkar mishran ka galaank aur ghata deta hai, isliye yahi dhaatu aise 'fusible' mishran ka aadhaar banti hai; isi karan ye aag-bujhaane wale shower ki cap mein kaam aata hai. Tamba tatha chromium ke milane se galaank ulta badh jaata tatha ye mishran itna aasaani se nahi pighalta, isliye dono galat chunav hain. Exam point: Wood's metal mein bismuth ki matara sabse zyada hoti hai - isi karan usaka galaank itna kam reh jaata hai.

qe: What happens when Zinc reacts with 'Cold and Dilute' Nitric Acid?
qh: जब जिंक 'ठंडे और तनु' नाइट्रिक एसिड के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करता है तो क्या होता है?
e: Jab zinc par thanda tatha patla (dilute) nitric acid daala jaata hai to gas ke roop mein hydrogen nahi nikalta; acid khud reduce hokar ammonium ion banata hai, isliye zinc nitrate ke saath-saath ammonium nitrate (NH4NO3) milta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki nitric acid ek prabal oxid hai jo bane hue hydrogen ko turant paani tatha ammonia mein badal deta hai, isliye yahi kriya HCl se alag hoti hai; patla HCl se zinc hydrogen gas deta hai par patle HNO3 se nahi. Is kriya ke utpad ke roop mein hydrogen tatha carbon dioxide nahi milte tatha zinc nitrate alag banta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: zinc tatha thande-patle nitric acid ki kriya mein ammonium nitrate (NH4NO3) banta hai - HNO3 oxid hone ke karan hydrogen ko aage badal deta hai.

qe: Which 'Non-metal' is used in the manufacturing of 'Sulfuric Acid' by the Contact Process?
qh: संपर्क प्रक्रम द्वारा 'सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड' के निर्माण में किस 'अधातु' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sulfuric acid banane ki Contact vidhi mein mukhya abhikarmak sulfur hi hota hai; pehle sulfur ko jalakar SO2 banyaa jaata hai, jo aage V2O5 utprek par oxid hokar SO3 tatha phir paani se milkar H2SO4 deta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki sulfur sasta tatha aasaani se milne wala non-metal hai tatha uske oxide ko aage badalna aasaan hai, isliye yahi audyogik vidhi ka aadhaar hai; nitrogen tatha phosphorus se aisa aml nahi banta tatha chlorine tatha bromine alag aml dete hain, isliye ye chaaron wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sulfuric acid ke audyogik nirmaan mein pehla bahan sulfur hi hota hai - ise jalakar SO2 tatha uske baad SO3 tayar kiya jaata hai.

qe: Which Noble gas is the 'Most Reactive' and forms compounds with Fluorine and Oxygen?
qh: कौन सी उत्कृष्ट गैस 'सबसे अधिक क्रियाशील' है और फ्लोरीन और ऑक्सीजन के साथ यौगिक बनाती है?
e: Utkrisht (noble) gasen aam taur par kriya nahi karti, par inmein se xenon hi ekmati gas hai jo fluorine tatha oxygen ke saath sthir compound (XeF2, XeF4 tatha XeO3) deti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki xenon ke bahari kosh ka electron dheela bandha rehta hai tatha uska aakaar bada hone se wo electron aasaani se share hota hai, isliye sirf yahi gas aise compound bana paati hai; helium tatha neon ke liye aisa kuchh nahi hota. Krypton tatha argon ke compounds bahut asthir paye gaye hain tatha helium-neon to kisi aisi kriya mein nahi aate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: utkrisht gases mein sabse kriya-sheel xenon hoti hai - yahi fluorine tatha oxygen ke saath sthir compound banane mein safal hui.

qe: Which mineral is the 'Softest' on the Mohs scale?
qh: मोह्स पैमाने पर कौन सा खनिज सबसे 'नरम' है?
e: Mohs paimane par sabse narm (softest) padarth talc hai, jiska kathorata aankda 1 hota hai; yahi ekmatr aisa khanij hai jo nakhun se bhi kharocha ja sakta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki talc ki paratein kamjor bandhan se judi hoti hain, isliye wo aasaani se alag hokar chikni choor banate hain; isi karan talc ko powder tatha baby powder jaisi cheezon mein istemal karte hain, jabki heera (10) sabse kathor hai. Gypsum tatha calcite is khanij se zyada kathor hote hain tatha unhe nakhun se nahi kharocha ja sakta, isliye wo dono galat hain. Exam point: kathorata ke Mohs paimane mein sabse narm padaav talc ka hai - iski kathorata 1 hai tatha ye sabse aasaani se safed churna banaata hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in 'Water Filters' to remove odors and impurities?
qh: गंध और अशुद्धियों को दूर करने के लिए 'वाटर फिल्टर' में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Paani ke filter (water purifier) mein gandh tatha ashuddhi hatane ke liye activated charcoal (carbon ka khaas chhidrawala roop) ka istemal hota hai; yahi khaane-peene tatha kachre ki gandh ko sokh leta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki activated charcoal ki satah bahut adhik tatha chhidrawali hoti hai, isliye uske 'adsorption' gun se kolor, gandh tatha kai zehirile padarth chipak jaate hain; isliye RO tatha UV filter mein yahi kadam sabse aam hai. Isse alag, sulfur tatha chlorine gandh hatane ke bajaye khud gandh dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: water filter mein gandh tatha ashuddhi hatane ke liye activated charcoal (carbon) istemal hota hai - yahi adsorption se padarthon ko sokh leta hai.

qe: What is 'Carnallite' an ore of?
qh: 'कार्नेलाइट' (Carnallite) किसका अयस्क है?
e: Carnallite (KCl.MgCl2.6H2O) ek sammishrit (double) lavan hai jismein potassium chloride tatha magnesium chloride ek hi kristal mein jude rehte hain; isi karan ye do dhaatuon ka saanjha ayask kehlata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ise jalane tatha vidyut apghatan se saaf karne par potash (KCl) tatha magnesia (MgO) dono prapt ho jaate hain, isliye khad tatha dhaatu dono ke liye yahi sasta srot hai; sylvine mein keval potassium tatha magnesite mein keval magnesium milta hai. Is ayask mein sodium ya calcium ka dhaatu roop mukhya nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: carnallite jaisa mishrit ayask potassium tatha magnesium dono ka srot hota hai - ek hi ayask se potash tatha magnesia dono nikaale ja sakte hain.

qe: The process of 'Annealing' steel involves:
qh: स्टील के 'एनीलिंग' (Annealing) की प्रक्रिया में क्या शामिल है?
e: Annealing wo kriya hai jismein steel ko garam karke dhire-dhire (slow cooling) thanda kiya jaata hai; isse dhaatu ke andar ke stress (tanav) hat jaate hain tatha wo narm tatha aasaani se sajaane yogya ban jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki dhire thanda hone par atom apni sahi jagah baith jaate hain tatha kathor tatha brittle (brittle) banane wali sajaavat hat jaati hai; isse alag, achanak thanda karne (quenching) se dhaatu kathor tatha brittle ho jaati hai. Isse alag, ismein rang beech mein nahi badalta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: annealing mein steel ko garam karke dhire-dhire thanda kiya jaata hai - isse dhaatu narm tatha andar ke stress se mukt ho jaati hai.

qe: Which metal is 'Sacrificed' during the cathodic protection of iron pipes buried underground?
qh: जमीन के नीचे दबे लोहे के पाइपों के कैथोडिक संरक्षण के दौरान किस धातु का 'बलिदान' किया जाता है?
e: Zameen ke bhitar dabaye gaye loha ke pipe tatha tel ke tank ke saath magnesium ka ek tukda kas diya jaata hai; kuchh samay mein khud magnesium nasht hota hai tatha loha salamat rehta hai. Is vidhi ka naam sacrificial anode wala bachav hai tatha ye cathodic protection ka hissa hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki kriya-sheelata shreni mein magnesium loha se upar baithta hai, isliye wo pehle electron chhodta hai tatha loha par jang ki kriya ruk jaati hai; tukda khatam hone par naya lagana padta hai. Chandi tatha tamba loha se neeche aate hain, isliye wo loha ke bajaye khud bach jaate hain tatha ushe nasht hone se rok nahi paate. Exam point: bhumi mein dabaye loha ke pipe ki suraksha ke liye magnesium ka tukda 'bali' banaya jaata hai - yahi pehle nasht hota hai tatha pipe bachi rehti hai.

qe: Which element is used to 'Galvanize' steel buckets and pipes?
qh: स्टील की बाल्टियों और पाइपों को 'गैल्वनाइज' करने के लिए किस तत्व का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Baalti, tank tatha kheti ke auzaar par zinc ki patli parat chadhane wali kriya galvanizing kehlati hai; ismein istemal hone wala tatva zinc hi hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye parat loha ko hawa tatha paani se alag rakhti hai tatha ghis kar khulne par bhi zinc hi pehle nasht hota hai; isi karan nal, chhat ki chaadar tatha kheti ke auzaar saalon tak chalte hain. Tin tatha chromium ki plating alag kriyaen hain tatha zinc ki tulna mein mehangi padti hain, isliye tin aur chromium wale vikalp galat thehrte hain. Exam point: loha ko jang se bachaane ke liye uski satah par zinc chadhai jaati hai - isi kriya ko galvanizing kehte hain tatha ghar ke saman mein yahi sasta tareeka hai.

qe: What is 'Cinnabar' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'सिनाबार' (Cinnabar) क्या है?
e: Cinnabar ka rasayanik naam mercury(II) sulfide hota hai tatha uska sutra HgS hai; ismein paara dhan aavesh tatha sulfur rin aavesh ke roop mein juda rehta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki paara tatha sulfur ka sanyojak anupat ek ke ek (1:1) hota hai, isliye dono milkar sthir laal rang ka sulfide banate hain tatha ise bhun kar paara nikaala jaata hai. HgCl2 tatha HgO paara ke anya lavan hote hain tatha unhe ayask ke roop mein nahi khoda jaata, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: cinnabar mercury(II) sulfide (HgS) hota hai - yahi paara dhaatu ka pramukh ayask hai tatha laal rang ka dikhta hai.

qe: What is the 'Nature' of the oxide of Phosphorus ($P_4O_{10}$)?
qh: फास्फोरस के ऑक्साइड ($P_4O_{10}$) की 'प्रकृति' कैसी होती है?
e: Phosphorus ka pura oxide (P4O10) nami ke sampark mein aakar phosphoric acid (H3PO4) banata hai, isliye ye amliya (acidic) oxide hai tatha iski jal (aqueous) kriya neela litmus laal kar deti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki non-metal ke oxide paani se milkar aml banate hain, isi gun ke karan P4O10 ko khaane-paani ki cheezon se nami kheenchne (desiccant) ke liye bhi rakha jaata hai; magnesium oxide jaisa dhaatu oxide ulta kshaariya hota hai jo laal litmus ko neela kar deta hai. Ubhay-bhaavi (amphoteric) gun iske andar nahi dikhta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: phosphorus ka oxide (P4O10) amliya (acidic) hota hai - yahi paani se phosphoric acid banata hai tatha neele litmus ko laal karta hai.

qe: Which of the following is the most 'Abundant' metal in the Earth's crust?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से पृथ्वी की पपड़ी में सर्वाधिक 'प्रचुर' धातु कौन सी है?
e: Prithvi ki upari parat (crust) mein bhaar ke hisaab se sabse zyada matara aluminium ki hi hoti hai; mitti tatha patthar mein ye oxygen ke saath milkar alumino-silicate banati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki aluminium ka oxygen se rishta bahut mazboot hota hai, isliye ye kbhi shudh roop mein nahi milti tatha ishe nikaalne ke liye bhaari vidyut kharch karna padta hai; yahi gun ise sabse aam dhaatu banata hai. Tamba tatha zinc kahin-kahin hi milte hain tatha sone-chandi durlabh hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: crust mein sabse zyada matara aluminium ki hoti hai - mitti tatha patthar mein yahi dhaatu aam taur par payi jaati hai.

qe: What is the primary 'Ore' of Aluminum?
qh: एल्यूमीनियम का प्राथमिक 'अयस्क' क्या है?
e: Aluminium ka mukhya ayask bauxite (Al2O3.2H2O) hota hai; ismein aluminium oxide ke saath loha tatha silica ki ashuddhiyan mili hoti hain, jinhe baad me hata kar alumina banyaa jaata hai. Isi karan aluminium nikalne ki pehli kadi bauxite ka shuddhikaran (Baeyer vidhi) hi hoti hai, jismein NaOH se alumina alag kiya jaata hai; isse alag, kryolite keval electrolysis mein galaank ghatane ke liye milta hai. Isse alag, haematite tatha galena anya dhaatuon ke ayask hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium ka mukhya ayask bauxite (Al2O3.2H2O) hota hai - isi se Baeyer vidhi dwara alumina banaakar aluminium nikaala jaata hai.

qe: Which property allows metals to be hammered into 'Thin Sheets'?
qh: कौन सा गुण धातुओं को हथौड़े से पीटकर 'पतली चादरों' में बदलने की अनुमति देता है?
e: Hathore ke jhatke se dhaatu ka tootne ke bajaye patli chaadar mein badal jaana malleability kehlata hai tatha ismein sone tatha aluminium sabse aage hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki dhaatu ke aayan ek sajaavat (lattice) mein baithe rehte hain tatha chot lagne par ek parat doosri par khisak jaati hai, isliye dhaatu phailti chali jaati hai; isi gun se sone ki warq tatha aluminium ki foil tayar hoti hai. Sakht tatha chot se tootne wala kaanch aisa nahi karta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dhaatu ko peekar patli chaadar (sheet) banane wale gun ko malleability kehte hain - isi gun se sone ki warq tayar hoti hai.

qe: The 'Cinnabar' ore is used to extract which metal?
qh: 'सिनाबार' अयस्क का उपयोग किस धातु को निकालने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Laal rang ka sulfide ayask cinnabar paara nikaalne ka pramukh srot hai tatha isse paara bahut aasaani se alag ho jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ayask ko hawa mein garam karne par paara bhaap ban kar nikalta hai tatha sulfur dioxide gas ban jaati hai; us bhaap ko thanda karne par drav paara haath lag jaata hai. Is kriya mein paara sulfur ke saath juda hota hai, isliye seedha paara nahi milta; froth floatation tatha vidyut apghatan is ayask ke liye upyukt nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cinnabar (HgS) ko hawa mein garam karke tatha bhaap ko thanda karke paara nikaala jaata hai - yahi paara nikalne ka purana tatha saral tareeka hai.

qe: Which metal is stored in 'Kerosene' due to its extreme reactivity with air and water?
qh: हवा और पानी के साथ अत्यधिक क्रियाशीलता के कारण किस धातु को 'मिट्टी के तेल' में रखा जाता है?
e: Laboratory mein sodium ke tukhde hamesha kerosene tel ke andar doobakar rakhe jaate hain tatha kataai bhi tel ke andar hi hoti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki sodium hawa ki nami tatha oxygen se turant jud jaata hai tatha itni ushma dete hue jal jaata hai ki aag pakad leta hai, isliye tel ki parat ushe hawa se alag rakhti hai; potassium ke liye bhi yahi tareeka chalta hai. Sona tatha tamba khuli hawa mein bhi kuchh nahi karte, isliye unhe tel mein rakhna bekaar hai tatha wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sodium (tatha potassium) ko kerosene mein rakha jaata hai - tel ki parat hi unhe hawa tatha nami se door rakhkar jalne se bachaati hai.

qe: What is the 'Best Conductor' of heat and electricity among metals?
qh: धातुओं में ऊष्मा और विद्युत का 'सर्वोत्तम चालक' कौन सा है?
e: Bijli tatha ushma dono ke liye sabse achhi chaalak dhaatu chandni (silver) hai; isi karan satellite tatha mehange yantron ke sookshm jod mein uski patli chat dikhai jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki chandni ke bahari kosh ka electron bahut dheela hone ke karan tezi se chal pada hai, isliye uski pratirodhakta sabse kam tatha chaalakta sabse zyada hoti hai; mehanga hone ke karan ghar ki taar-peti tamba se banti hai. Loha tatha tin ki chaalakta iske paas bhi nahi pahunchti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: kisi dhaatu ki bijli tatha ushma chaalakta sabse achhi chandni (silver) ki hoti hai - uske baad kram hai tamba, phir sona.

qe: Which non-metal is a good 'Conductor' of electricity?
qh: कौन सी अधातु विद्युत की अच्छी 'चालक' है?
e: Bijli ke dry cell ka sentral rod tatha electrolysis ke electrode graphite se hi bante hain, kyunki non-metals mein se keval yahi padarth bijli ko aasaani se guzarne deta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki graphite ki paraton mein pratyek carbon apna ek electron khula chhod deta hai, isliye is chauthi dhaara ke karan current bahne lagta hai tatha pencil ki sikh bhi bijli guzaar deti hai. Heera, sulfur tatha iodine jaise non-metals current ko nahi guzaarne dete, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: non-metals mein keval graphite hi achha chaalak hota hai - uske carbon atomon ka ek electron khula reh jaane ke karan.

qe: The process of 'Galvanization' involves coating Iron with which metal?
qh: 'गैल्वनीकरण' की प्रक्रिया में लोहे पर किस धातु का लेप लगाया जाता है?
e: Loha ke saman ko pighle hue zinc (jasta) mein doobokar nikalne wali vidhi galvanization kehlati hai, isliye ismein chadhne wali dhaatu zinc hi hai tatha satah par uski halki chamakdar parat ban jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki zinc ki ye halki dhaal hawa tatha nami ke beech aa jaati hai, isliye chhat ki chaadar tatha pipe ki umar kai guna badh jaati hai; isi karan bijli ke khambhe tatha kholi ke darwaze bhi isi vidhi se tayar hote hain. Chrome plating mein chromium tatha kalai (tinning) mein tin chadhta hai tatha dono zinc se zyada mehange padte hain, isliye chrome tatha tin wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: galvanization ki kriya mein loha ki satah par zinc chadhta hai - yahi jang rokne wala sabse sasta audyogik tareeka hai.

qe: Which metal is found in a 'Liquid' state at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर कौन सी धातु 'तरल' अवस्था में पाई जाती है?
e: Hawa mein khuli rakhi gayi paara ki boond garmi badhne par failti hai tatha thandak mein bhi jami nahi; yahi dhaatu sadharan kamre ke tapman par drav avastha mein milti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki uske aayan aapas mein itne kamjor bandhan se jude hote hain ki kamre ki garmi hi unhe khiskaane ke liye kaafi hoti hai; isi karan purane tapman-mapi yantra tatha switch mein ise bhara jaata tha. Aluminium tatha tamba kamre ke tapman par thos hi rehte hain tatha anya padarth garmi se pighalne wale thos hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: kamre ke sadharan tapman par drav milne wali dhaatu paara (mercury) hi hai - iska galaank 39 degree C se neeche hota hai.

qe: What is 'Haematite' an ore of?
qh: 'हेमेटाइट' (Haematite) किसका अयस्क है?
e: Loha dhaatu ka pramukh ayask haematite (Fe2O3) hai; isayask mein loha oxygen se juda hota hai tatha dhaatu nikaalne ke liye oxygen hataana padta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki manav ne sabse pehle isi laal rang wale ayask ko koyle ke saath bhatti mein pighla kar loha banaaya tha, isliye aaj bhi duniya ka adhiktam loha isi se nikalta hai; magnetite mein magnetism zyada hone ke karan chumbak ushe kheenchta hai. Bauxite aluminium tatha cuprite tamba ka ayask hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: haematite (Fe2O3) loha dhaatu ka pramukh ayask hai - laal rang tatha adhik loha matara iski pehchaan hai.

qe: Which non-metal is 'Liquid' at room temperature?
qh: कमरे के तापमान पर कौन सी अधातु 'तरल' होती है?
e: Kamre ke tapman par drav rehne wala non-metal bromine hai; iska rang gehra laal-bhura hota hai tatha iski bhaap zehirili hoti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki uske atomon ke beech kamjor bandhan hote hain tatha uske do badi atom milkar drav sajaavat bana leti hain, isliye ye tikne wala drav non-metal hai; isi karan bromine ko surakshit dibbe (sealed bottle) mein rakha jaata hai. Isse alag, iodine thos hota hai tatha chlorine gas hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: kamre ke tapman par drav rehne wala non-metal bromine hai - yahi ekmatr drav non-metal hai tatha iska rang laal-bhura hota hai.

qe: Which metal is 'Soft' enough to be cut with a knife?
qh: कौन सी धातु इतनी 'नरम' है कि उसे चाकू से काटा जा सकता है?
e: Sodium dhaatu itni narm hoti hai ki ushe chaku (knife) se kata ja sakta hai, kyunki uske atomon ke beech bandhan bahut kamjor hota hai tatha uska ek valence electron dheela bandha rehta hai. Isi karan ise tel (kerosene) ke andar hi kaatna padta hai tatha ise khaane ke namak (sodium chloride) se bijli ke zariye alag kiya jaata hai; isse alag, loha tatha tamba chaku se nahi kat sakte. Isse alag, isi narmi ke kaaran sodium se taar (wire) banana mushkil hai, isliye ye vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sodium dhaatu itni narm hai ki ushe chaku se kata ja sakta hai - isliye ishe tel mein rakhkar rakha jaata hai.

qe: The 'Lustre' (shine) of a metal is due to:
qh: धातु की 'चमक' (Lustre) किसके कारण होती है?
e: Dhaatu ki chamak (lustre) dhaatu ke andar ghoomte electron ke karan hoti hai; satah par padne wali roshni in electron se takra kar wapas laut jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki dhaatu mein electron kisi ek aayan ke paas nahi thehrte balki poore tukde mein ghoomte rehte hain, isliye roshni ki lagbhag poori range wapas paravartit ho jaati hai tatha dhaatu chamakdar dikhti hai; isi karan sone tatha chandi ki satah darpan jaisi lagti hai. Lakdi tatha plastik ke electron aise aayojan mein nahi hote, isliye wo chamak nahi dikhate. Exam point: dhaatuon ki chamak unmein maujood ghoomte electron se roshni ke paravartan ke karan hoti hai - yahi unhe chamakdar tatha achha chaalak banata hai.

qe: Which ore is concentrated by the 'Froth Floatation' process?
qh: 'झाग प्लवन' (Froth Floatation) प्रक्रिया द्वारा किस अयस्क का सांद्रण किया जाता है?
e: Sulfide ayaskon ko paani-tel ke mishran mein jhaag ke saath upar tairaakar alag karne wali vidhi froth floatation kehlati hai tatha iska istemal copper pyrites jaisi sulfide ayaskon par hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki sulfide ke kan tel pakad kar hawa ke bulblon ke saath upar aa jaate hain, jabki mitti jaisi gangue paani mein neeche baith jaati hai tatha dono alag ho jaate hain; isi karan yahi vidhi sulfide ayaskon ka sasta sadhan hai. Oxide wale ayask jaise bauxite tatha haematite is vidhi se sadhte nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: froth floatation vidhi sulfide ayaskon ke liye istemal hoti hai - tel tatha paani ke gun se sulfide kan upar tairkar alag ho jaate hain.

qe: What is 'Magnesite' chemically?
qh: रासायनिक रूप से 'मैग्नेसाइट' क्या है?
e: Magnesite ka rasayanik naam magnesium carbonate (MgCO3) hai tatha ise jalane par magnesia (MgO) bachta hai, jo bahut uchch tapman sahan karne wala padarth hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki jalne se nikli carbon dioxide bahar ud jaati hai tatha pichhe bacha MgO bhatti ki antari parat (refractory lining) banaane ke liye upyukt hota hai; isi karan magnesium nikaalne ka sasta srot bhi yahi ayask hai. Magnesium sulfate (Epsom salt) ek alag padarth hai tatha dolomite mein calcium bhi mila rehta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: magnesite rasayanik roop se magnesium carbonate (MgCO3) hota hai - jalaane par magnesia (MgO) deta hai jo bhatti ki lining mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which metal does not react with 'Dilute HCl' even on heating?
qh: कौन सी धातु गर्म करने पर भी 'तनु HCl' के साथ प्रतिक्रिया नहीं करती है?
e: Tamba (copper) patle HCl ke saath garam karne par bhi kriya nahi karta, kyunki wo hydrogen se kam kriya-sheel dhaatuon mein aata hai tatha HCl ki hydrogen ko hataane layak urja usmein nahi hoti. Isse alag, zinc tatha loha HCl se kriya karke hydrogen gas dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi; isi karan gold tatha silver bhi patle HCl se surakshit rehte hain. Isse alag, tamba prabal HNO3 ya garam saandrit H2SO4 se kriya kar leta hai, isliye 'kriya hi nahi karta' sirf patle HCl ke liye sahi hai. Exam point: patle HCl ke saath garam karne par bhi tamba (copper) kriya nahi karta - kyunki wo hydrogen se kam kriya-sheel dhaatu hai.

qe: What is the common name for 'Iron Pyrites'?
qh: 'आयरन पाइराइट्स' का सामान्य नाम क्या है?
e: Iron pyrites (FeS2) ko 'fool's gold' kehte hain, kyunki uski chamakdar peeli satah sone (gold) jaisi dikhti hai; isliye bahut log ishe asli sona samajh lete hain. Isse alag, asli sona narm tatha bhaari hota hai tatha usmein sulfur nahi hota, jabki pyrite kathor hota hai tatha sookhi kharoch se halka kaala-sunahra choora deta hai; isi karan purane sone ki talaash mein dhokha khaya jaata tha. Isse alag, galena tatha chalcopyrite alag ayask hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: iron pyrites (FeS2) ko fool's gold kehte hain - iski chamak sone jaisi hoti hai par ye asli sone se alag tatha sasta hota hai.

qe: Which metal is used in the 'Filament' of an electric bulb?
qh: बिजली के बल्ब के 'फिलामेंट' में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bijli ke bulb ke andar lagne wale taar ke liye tungsten chuni jaati hai tatha iska chaalak taar 3422 degree C par pighalta hai, jo dhaatuon mein sabse zyada hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ushe dhaatu ke andar itna garam hone par bhi apna roop banaaye rakhna hota hai, isliye jaldi pighalne wala tamba tatha aluminium kaam nahi de sakte; bulb mein argon-nitrogen ki gas isliye bhari jaati hai ki tungsten ka vaasp (evaporation) dheema ho jaaye. Isi gun ke karan tungsten ka taar mahinaon tak roshni deta hai, jabki anya dhaatu ka taar turant toot jaata. Exam point: bulb ke filament ke liye tungsten dhaatu istemal hoti hai - yahi dhaatuon mein sabse uchch tapman par pighalti hai.

qe: The process of heating an ore strongly in the 'Absence' of air is called:
qh: हवा की 'अनुपस्थिति' में किसी अयस्क को तीव्रता से गर्म करने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
e: Calcination wo kriya hai jismein ayask ko bina hawa (air) ke ya bahut kam hawa mein tez tapman par garam kiya jaata hai; isse ayask ka paani tatha carbonate (CO2) nikal jaata hai tatha oxide bachta hai. Isse alag, roasting mein hawa ki upasthiti hoti hai (jisse sulfide oxide mein badalta hai), isliye dono alag kriyaen hain; chuna patthar (CaCO3) ko jalane se quicklime (CaO) banna calcination ka udaharan hai. Isse alag, ismein dhaatu shudhh nahi hota, isse oxide tayar hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ayask ko bina hawa ke ya kam hawa mein tez garam karne wali kriya calcination kehlati hai - isse paani tatha CO2 nikal jaate hain.

qe: The process of heating 'Sulfide Ores' in a regular supply of air is called:
qh: हवा की नियमित आपूर्ति में 'सल्फाइड अयस्कों' को गर्म करने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
e: Roasting wo kriya hai jismein sulfide ayask ko bahut adhik hawa (regular supply of air) ke saath garam kiya jaata hai; ismein ayask ka metal sulfide oxid hokar metal oxide tatha sulfur dioxide (SO2) banta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki hawa se sulfur jal kar gas ban jaata hai tatha dhaatu oxid ke roop mein bach jaata hai, isliye yahi sulfide ayaskon (jaise zinc blende, galena) ke liye pehla kadam hota hai; isse alag, calcination isse ulta bina hawa ke hota hai. Isse alag, ismein dhaatu seedha nahi milta, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sulfide ayaskon ko hawa ki nirantar aapurti ke saath garam karne wali kriya roasting kehlati hai - ismein oxide banata hai tatha SO2 nikalta hai.

qe: Which of the following is an 'Alloy' of Copper and Zinc?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कॉपर और जिंक का 'मिश्र धातु' है?
e: Peetal (brass) mishradhatu ka mukhya mishran tamba (copper) tatha zinc ka hota hai; ismein zinc ki matara kam-jyada hone se rang peela-sunahra hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki tamba ke saath zinc milane se dhaatu kathor tatha chamakdar ban jaati hai, isliye bartan, bijli ke pipe tatha ghar ke saman isi se bante hain; isse alag, bronze mein tin hota hai tatha dono mishran alag pehchaane jaate hain. Isse alag, chromium tatha nikal ke savdhaan is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: brass (peetal) tamba tatha zinc ki mishradhatu hoti hai - isi karan iska rang peela tatha chamakdar hota hai.

qe: What is 'Solder' (used in electronics) composed of?
qh: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स में प्रयुक्त 'सोल्डर' किससे बना होता है?
e: Electronics mein istemal hone wala solder mukhya roop se lead tatha tin ka mishran hota hai; iska ghanatva tatha galaank mishran mein sabse kam hota hai, isliye bijli ke taar tatha circuit ke jodai mein yahi lagta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki lead-tin ka mishran kam tapman par (lagbhag 180-190 degree C) pighal kar jod ko sakht kar deta hai tatha tez garam nahi hona padta, isliye electronic ke nazuk hisse kharab nahi hote; isse alag, tamba tatha zinc ke mishran itne kam tapman par nahi pighalte. Exam point: electronic kaam mein lagne wala solder lead tatha tin ka mishran hota hai - isi karan yahi kam tapman par pighal kar jodai karta hai.

qe: Which metal is the most 'Reactive' in the reactivity series?
qh: सक्रियता श्रेणी में कौन सी धातु सबसे अधिक 'अभिक्रियाशील' है?
e: Sakriyata shreni (reactivity series) mein potassium ka sthan sabse upar hai, isliye yahi sabse adhik abhikriya-sheel dhaatu maani jaati hai; ye paani ke sampark mein itni tez kriya karta hai ki jalaa aur aag pakad leta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki potassium apna ek valence electron bahut aasaani se de deta hai, isliye hawa tatha nami ke liye bhi yahi sabse pehle chuna jaata hai; isi karan iski dhaatu ko tel ke andar rakhna padta hai. Sodium thoda kam abhikriya-sheel hota hai tatha tamba tatha sone bahut kam, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sakriyata shreni mein sabse adhik abhikriya-sheel dhaatu potassium hai - yahi paani se turant kriya karke aag pakad leta hai.

qe: Which metal is extracted using 'Electrolytic Reduction' of its molten oxide?
qh: किस धातु को उसके पिघले हुए ऑक्साइड के 'इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक अपचयन' द्वारा निष्कर्षित किया जाता है?
e: Aluminium ko uske pighle oxide ke vidyut apghatan (electrolytic reduction) se nikaala jaata hai; alumina ko cryolite ke saath milaakar pighlaaya jaata hai tatha bijli ke zariye cathode par pighla aluminium jama hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki aluminium bahut abhikriya-sheel dhaatu hai, isliye kok tatha hawa jaisi sadharan vidhi se ushe nikaalna mushkil hota hai tatha yahi ek satya tareeka hai; isi karan aluminium ke plant bahut zyada bijli khaate hain. Loha tatha tamba ki vidhiyan koyle (reducing agent) par chalti hain tatha unmein bijli ki itni zaroorat nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aluminium ko uske drav oxide ke vidyut vishleshan (electrolytic reduction) dwara nikaala jaata hai - yahi Hall-Heroult vidhi hai tatha bahut bijli maangti hai.

qe: What is the 'Purity' of 24-carat gold?
qh: 24-कैरेट सोने की 'शुद्धता' क्या होती है?
e: 24-carat sone ko 100 pratishat pure (shudh) mana jaata hai, yani usmein koi anya dhaatu milai nahi hoti; isliye 24-carat ka aankda 100% hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki carat sirf shuddhta ka paimana batata hai (24 hisson mein kachche dhaatu ka kinna hissa sona hai), isliye 22-carat ka matlab 91.6 tatha 18-carat ka matlab 75 pratishat hota hai; shudh sona narm hone ke karan gehne ke liye 22-carat hi pasand kiya jaata hai. Isse alag, 80% ya 95% aankde 19.2 ya 22.8 carat banate hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: 24-carat sone ki shuddhta 100% hoti hai - yahi bilkul shudh sona hai jismein koi anya dhaatu nahi hoti.

qe: Which substance is used as a 'Flux' in the extraction of Iron to remove sand ($SiO_2$)?
qh: रेत ($SiO_2$) को हटाने के लिए लोहे के निष्कर्षण में किस पदार्थ का उपयोग 'गालक' (Flux) के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Loha nikaalne ki bhatti mein ayask ke saath jo ret (SiO2) milti hai wo loha ko kharab karti hai, isliye ushe hatane ke liye choona-patthar (limestone, CaCO3) flux ke roop mein milaya jaata hai; choona ret ke saath milkar calcium silicate banata hai. Yahi mishran gaadha (slag) ke roop mein bahar aata hai tatha loha safed (saaf) milta hai; isi karan limestone ko blast furnace ka anivarya hissa kaha jaata hai. Isse alag, silica tatha anya acidic padarth aise basic ashuddhi ke liye flux nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: loha nikaalne mein ret (SiO2) hatane ke liye limestone (CaCO3) flux ka kaam karta hai - yahi gaadha banakar ashuddhi bahar kar deta hai.

qe: Which alloy is used to make 'Aircraft' bodies due to its light weight and strength?
qh: हल्के वजन और मजबूती के कारण 'हवाई जहाज' के ढांचे बनाने के लिए किस मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Hawai jahaaz ki body tatha pankh (wings) banane mein duralumin naam ki mishradhatu ka istemal hota hai; ismein aluminium ke saath tamba, magnesium tatha manganese milaye jaate hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki is mishran ka bhaar aluminium jitna halka rehta hai par uski khinchav-saamarthya (tensile strength) steel ke kareeb pahunch jaati hai, isliye jahaaz ka dhaancha halka hote hue bhi mazboot rehta hai tatha uske kas ke rivet bhi isi se bante hain. Magnalium mein keval magnesium milta hai tatha uski mazbooti kam hoti hai, stainless steel bhaari padta hai tatha peetal (brass) mein tamba-zinc hote hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: hawai jahaaz ke dhaanche ke liye duralumin chuna jaata hai - ismein aluminium ke saath tamba, magnesium tatha manganese hote hain.

qe: The 'Thermite' reaction uses which metal as a reducing agent to join railway tracks?
qh: 'थर्माइट' प्रतिक्रिया में रेलवे ट्रैक को जोड़ने के लिए किस धातु का उपयोग अपचायक के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Rail ki patri (track) ke jodo ko jodne mein thermite kriya ka istemal hota hai tatha ismein apchayak (reducing agent) ka kaam aluminium churna karta hai; wo loha ke oxide se oxygen cheen kar drav loha bana deta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki aluminium oxide banane ke liye bahut zyada urja chhodta hai, isliye kriya itni ushma paida karti hai (lagbhag 2500 degree C) ki loha pighal kar jod weld ho jaata hai tatha patri jur jaati hai. Tamba tatha zinc aluminium se kam kriya-sheel hain tatha loha to khud hi reduce hona hai, isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: thermite kriya mein aluminium apchayak hota hai - yahi loha ke oxide se oxygen le kar drav loha tatha itni ushma deta hai ki jod pakka ho jaata hai.

qe: Which metal is liquid at room temperature and is used in clinical thermometers?
qh: कौन सी धातु कक्ष तापमान पर द्रव रहती है तथा चिकित्सीय तापमापी में प्रयुक्त होती है?
e: Mercury yaani para ek hi dhatu hai jo room temperature par taral rehti hai tatha garmi phailne se seedha-upar chadhati hai, isliye yah thermometer me istemal hoti hai. Aluminum, zinc tatha lead sab thos dhatuyein hain. Aluminium, Zinc, Lead in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Mercury hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Mercury - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein. Tathya ko vyakti, sthan tatha saal ke saath jodkar padhne se yaad rakhna aasan hota hai tatha vikalpon ka bhram door hota hai.

qe: Which component of 'Stainless Steel' makes it resistant to rusting?
qh: 'स्टेनलेस स्टील' का कौन सा घटक इसे जंग प्रतिरोधी बनाता है?
e: Stainless steel ko jang se bachaane wala mukhya ghatak chromium hai tatha uski matara kam se kam 10.5 pratishat honi chahiye; chromium hawa ki oxygen ke saath milkar satah par Cr2O3 ki patli tatha chipkili (adherent) parat bana leta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye parat tootne par turant dobara ban jaati hai, isliye nami tatha hawa uske aage nahi badh paate; carbon steel ko kathor banata hai, manganese use tedhepan se rokti hai tatha tamba tar (weld) mein madad karta hai, par jang rokne ka kaam chromium hi karta hai. Baaki teeno ghatak ye raksha nahi de sakte, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: stainless steel ko jang-rahit banane wala mukhya ghatak chromium hai - yahi hawa ki oxygen se milkar iski satah par chipkili rakshak parat banata hai.

qe: Which metal is found in 'Nature' in its free (native) state?
qh: प्रकृति में कौन सी धातु अपनी स्वतंत्र (मूल) अवस्था में पाई जाती है?
e: Sone (gold) ek aisi dhaatu hai jo prakruti mein shudh tatha mukta (native) avastha mein hi mil jaati hai; nadiyon ki ret tatha pattharon ke beech chamakdar kanon ke roop mein yahi dhaatu saikdon saal se gati ja rahi hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki sone ki kriya-sheelata bahut kam hoti hai, isliye wo hawa ki oxygen tatha paani se kriya karke compound nahi banati; iske ulat calcium, sodium tatha aluminium bahut kriya-sheel hain tatha prakruti mein chloride, carbonate tatha silicate jaise ayaskon ke roop mein hi milti hain. Ye teeno dhaatuen kathin vidhiyon se hi nikaali jaati hain, isliye wo mukta avastha wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: prakruti mein mukta (native) avastha mein sone ki dhaatu hi milti hai - iski kriya-sheelata kam hone ke karan ye compound nahi banati.

qe: Gun metal (गन मेटल) is an alloy of copper with which metals?
qh: गन मेटल (Gun metal) तांबे के साथ किन धातुओं का मिश्रण होता है?
e: Gun metal me tamba ke saath tin tatha zinc milaye jaate hain, isliye yah mazboot tatha jang se bachne wala dhaancha banata hai. Pahle isse top tatha bhaari machine ke purze banae jaate the, isi se iska naam pada. Nickel and Silver, Lead and Iron, Aluminium and Magnesium alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yahi sahi uttar Tin and Zinc hai. Exam point: Tin and Zinc - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye. Tathya ko vyakti, sthan tatha saal ke saath jodkar padhne se yaad rakhna aasan hota hai tatha vikalpon ka bhram door hota hai.

qe: Which process is used for the 'Refining' of blister copper?
qh: ब्लिस्टर कॉपर के 'शोधन' के लिए किस प्रक्रिया का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Blister copper ko shudh karne ke liye vidyut apghatan (electrolytic refining) ka istemal hota hai; ismein ganda tamba ka mota patra anu (anode) banta hai tatha shudh tamba ki patli chat kat (cathode) rakhi jaati hai, dono ke beech acid-yukt copper sulfate ka ghol hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki bijli ke aayan tamba ki or chalte hain, isliye gandhiyan anu ke neeche baith jaati hain tatha kat par 99.99 pratishat shudh tamba jama hota hai; ye shuddhta bijli ke taar tatha motor ke liye zaroori hai. Chumbakiy prithakkar tatha pehla tasfiya (liquation) itni shuddhta nahi dete tatha tamba aasaani se vaprit nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: blister copper ko shudh karne ke liye vidyut apghatan vidhi chalti hai - ismein shudh tamba kat par jama hota hai tatha gandhiyan anu ke neeche.

qe: What is 'Galena' an ore of?
qh: 'गैलेना' किसका अयस्क है?
e: Galena (PbS) sisa (lead) ka pramukh ayask hai tatha iska rang dhantla kaala-grey tatha chamak dhaatu jaisi hoti hai; ise 'lead glance' bhi kehte hain tatha ye ghan tapman par aasaani se pighalta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ismein sisa tatha sulfur milkar sulfide banate hain, isliye hawa mein garam karne par sulfur dioxide nikalta hai tatha sisa oxide bachta hai, jise aage koyle se jalakar drav sisa nikaala jaata hai; isi sisa se gaadi ki battery tatha vikiran dhaal banti hai. Zinc blende tatha tamba ke ayask alag hote hain tatha loha ka ayask haematite laal dikhta hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: galena (PbS) sisa dhaatu ka pramukh ayask hai - iski chamak dhaatu jaisi hoti hai tatha isse gaadi ki battery ka sisa banta hai.

qe: The 'Non-metal' used in the vulcanization of rubber is:
qh: रबर के वल्कनीकरण में प्रयुक्त होने वाली 'अधातु' कौन सी है?
e: Rabar ko ushma tatha khinchav sahan karne yogya banane ke liye usmein sulfur milakar garam kiya jaata hai tatha is kriya ko vulcanization kehte hain; sulfur praakritik rabar ki lambi anuon ke beech pull (cross link) bana deta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye pull anuon ko ek doosre par sarakne nahi dete, isliye rabar garmi mein chipchipa nahi hota tatha kheenchne par wapas apni jagah aa jaata hai; zyada sulfur milane par sakht ebonite banta hai jise bijli ke switch mein lagaya jaata hai. Silicon tatha carbon rabar ke saath aise pull nahi banaate tatha phosphorus to khud hawa mein kriya karta hai, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: rabar ke vulcanization mein sulfur non-metal istemal hota hai - yahi anuon ke beech pull bana kar rabar ko mazboot tatha lachakdar banata hai.

qe: Which metal is used in 'Galvanized' iron pipes to prevent rusting?
qh: जंग को रोकने के लिए 'गैल्वेनाइज्ड' लोहे के पाइपों में किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Paani ki pipeline tatha chhat ke pipe par jasta yaani zinc ki parat chadhai jaati hai tatha aise pipe galvanized pipe kehlate hain; inhe jang se bachaane wala tatva zinc hi hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki zinc loha se pehle kriya karta hai, isliye pipe ki satah par laal-bhoore jang ke chhale nahi ubhte tatha pipe saalon chalti hai; lep katne par bhi aas-paas ka zinc loha ko bachaa leta hai. Nikal tatha chromium ki plating mehangi padti hai tatha tin ki kalai alag kriya hai jo khaane ke dibbon par chadhti hai, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: galvanized loha ke pipe par zinc ki parat hoti hai - yahi pehle kharab hokar pipe ko jang se bachaati hai.

qe: Which of the following metals reacts with 'Cold Water' most vigorously?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी धातु 'ठंडे पानी' के साथ सबसे तीव्रता से प्रतिक्रिया करती है?
e: Thande paani ke saath sabse tez kriya potassium dhaatu hi karti hai; paani ki satah par rakhi uski goli turant ushma tatha hydrogen gas chhodti hai tatha lilac (bainguni) lau ke saath jal uthti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki potassium ki kriya-sheelata calcium, magnesium tatha aluminium se sabse adhik hoti hai, isliye wo thande paani se hi hydrogen ko aag lagaane layak ushma de deti hai; calcium paani par tairta hai, magnesium garam paani ya bhaap maangta hai tatha aluminium ki satah par oxide ki parat kriya rok deti hai. Isi karan potassium ko tel ke andar rakha jaata hai, isliye baaki teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: thande paani se sabse tez kriya potassium karta hai - yahi turant hydrogen banaakar aag pakad leta hai.

qe: What is the 'Reducing Agent' used in the Blast Furnace to extract Iron from Haematite?
qh: हेमेटाइट से लोहा निकालने के लिए वात्या भट्टी में प्रयुक्त 'अपचायक' कौन सा है?
e: Vaatya bhatti (blast furnace) mein loha ke oxide ko reduce karne wala mukhya padarth carbon monoxide (CO) gas hota hai; neeche ke hisse mein coke jalkar pehle carbon dioxide banata hai, jo upar chadhte hue garam coke se milkar CO ban jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki hawa ki tez dhara se ye gas bhatti ke oopri-madhya bhaag mein banti rehti hai tatha wahan haematite se oxygen le kar loha tatha carbon dioxide deti hai, isliye theth koyle se seedha loha nahi banta. Chuna patthar (limestone) yahan ashuddhi hatane wala gaalak (flux) hota hai tatha oxygen to ayask ko ulta oxid kar deti, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: vaatya bhatti mein asli apchayak carbon monoxide (CO) gas hoti hai - yahi haematite se oxygen le kar drav loha deti hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used in the 'De-galvanization' or cleaning of metals?
qh: धातुओं की सफाई या डी-गैल्वनाइजेशन में किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Dhaatu ki satah ko saaf karne tatha galvanized parat utaarne (de-galvanization) ke liye chlorine ka istemal hota hai; sadharan taur par ise hydrochloric acid (HCl) ke ghol ke roop mein lagaya jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki chlorine ek prabal kriya-sheel non-metal hai jo zinc ke saath milkar ghulansheel zinc chloride bana deta hai tatha oxide tatha jang ki parat utaar deta hai, isliye satah chamakdar ho jaati hai. Nitrogen snigdh (inert) gas hone ke karan kuchh nahi karta tatha uska upyog bachav ke liye khaane ke packet mein hota hai; hydrogen dhaatu ke andar ghuskar ushe brittle kar deta hai tatha sulfur satah par mala (tarnish) banaata hai. Exam point: dhaatu ki safai tatha de-galvanization ke liye chlorine istemal hota hai - HCl ke roop mein yahi zinc ki parat tatha jang hataata hai.

qe: What is 'Pig Iron'?
qh: 'पिग आयरन' (कच्चा लोहा) क्या है?
e: Vaatya bhatti (blast furnace) se nikalne wala pehla loha kaccha loha ya pig iron kehlata hai tatha usmein 3 se 4 pratishat carbon tatha sulfur, phosphorus jaisi ashuddhiyan mili hoti hain; thanda hone par ye brittle hota hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ise bhatti ke saanchod mein gaadhe roop mein utaara jaata hai jisse suar ke bachhde jaisi dhaulakti banati hain tatha naam 'pig' pad gaya; ise dobara pighlakar manhole ke dakhke tatha engine ke bhaari parts banaye jaate hain. Steel mein carbon ki matara 1.5 pratishat se kam hoti hai tatha pitwa loha carbon ki bahut kam matara wala shudh loha hota hai, isliye wo dono vikalp galat hain. Exam point: pig iron vaatya bhatti se nikalne wala kaccha loha hai jismein 3 se 4 pratishat carbon hota hai - carbon adhik hone ke karan ye brittle hota hai.

qe: Which metal forms a 'Protective Oxide Layer' that prevents further corrosion (Self-passivation)?
qh: कौन सी धातु एक 'सुरक्षात्मक ऑक्साइड परत' बनाती है जो आगे के संक्षारण को रोकती है?
e: Aluminium ki satah par hawa ki oxygen se milkar Al2O3 ki ek patli tatha paardarshi (transparent) rakshak parat turant ban jaati hai, isliye aage koi kriya nahi hoti tatha aluminium jang se bacha rehta hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye parat chipkili hoti hai tatha tutne par turant dobara ban jaati hai, isliye khaane ke bartan tatha aakash-chitra (satellite) ke hisse isi roop mein salamat rehte hain; isi parat ko aur mota karne ke liye anodizing kiya jaata hai. Loha ki satah par banti laal-bhooree jang parat chedili tatha phatne wali hoti hai jo nayi satah khol deti hai tatha tamba par hari parat bahut dheere banti hai, isliye wo dono galat chunav hain. Exam point: aluminium hawa mein aa kar Al2O3 ki suraksha-parat bana leta hai - yahi parat use aage kharab hone se rokti hai.

qe: What is 'Wrought Iron'?
qh: 'पिटवा लोहा' (Wrought Iron) क्या है?
o: The purest commercial form of iron
e: Pitwa loha (wrought iron) loha ka sabse shudh vyavsayik roop hota hai jismein carbon ki matara keval 0.12 se 0.25 pratishat rehti hai; ise bhatti mein pighlakar hathore se peetkar (peetna) tayar kiya jaata tha. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki itna kam carbon ushe aasaani se jodne, modne tatha taar tatha kileed (chain) banane mein lachakdar banata hai, isliye purane faaton tatha bandhanak vaale darwaze isi se bante the; ismein gaadhe (slag) ke baareek resh bhi milte hain. Cast iron mein carbon 3 se 4 pratishat hota hai tatha wo chot se toot jaata hai tatha aam steel mein bhi carbon thoda adhik hota hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: pitwa loha loha ka sabse shudh vyavsayik roop hai - ismein carbon keval 0.12 se 0.25 pratishat hota hai tatha ye lachakdar hota hai.

qe: Which gas is used in 'Food Packaging' (like Chips) to prevent the oxidation of fats and oils?
qh: वसा और तेलों के ऑक्सीकरण को रोकने के लिए 'खाद्य पैकेजिंग' (जैसे चिप्स) में किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Chips tatha namkeen ke packet mein nitrogen gas bhari jaati hai tatha yahi tel wale khaane ko kharab hone se bachaati hai; packet ke andar ki hawa hataakar nitrogen bhari jaati hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki nitrogen ek snigdh (inert) gas hai jo hawa ki oxygen ko khaane tak pahunchne nahi deti, isliye akshidan (oxidation) tatha vikrit gandh (rancidity) nahi hoti tatha swaad nahi badalta; isi karan chips ke bikaash mein yahi gas bhari jaati hai. Oxygen khud tel ko kharab karti hai tatha hydrogen tatha chlorine khaane ke saath kriya kar sakti hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: chips ke packet mein bhari jaane wali gas nitrogen hai - yahi akshidan rokkar khaane ko taaza rakhti hai.

qe: What is 'Aqua Regia' primarily used for in metallurgy?
qh: धातु विज्ञान में 'एक्वारेजिया' (Aqua Regia) का मुख्य उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
e: Aqua regia teen hisse saandrit hydrochloric acid tatha ek hissa saandrit nitric acid ka mishran hota hai; ismein sone tatha platinum jaise bahut kam kriya-sheel dhaatuen bhi ghul jaati hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki is mishran mein tez oxid karne wala aml tatha chloride dono ek saath hote hain; aml dhaatu ki patli parat ko oxid karta hai tatha chloride turant ushe ghulansheel complex bana deta hai, isliye ghulne ki kriya rukti nahi; isi karan sone ki shuddhta jaanchne tatha e-kachare se kimti dhaatuen nikaalne mein iska istemal hota hai. Iron ki safai tatha aluminium nikaalne ke kaam alag aml tatha vidhiyon se hote hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: aqua regia se sone tatha platinum jaisi dhaatuen ghulti hain - yahi iska mukhya upyog hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Metalloid' used in making microchips?
qh: माइक्रोचिप बनाने में प्रयुक्त होने वाला उपधातु निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
e: Computer tatha mobile ke microchip banane mein silicon ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye ek upadhaatu (metalloid) hai jo dhaatu tatha adhaatu dono ke gun dikhata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki silicon ke electron keval khaas sharton par bahne dete hain, isliye ise dop kar p-typ tatha n-typ banaa kar chhote switch tayar kiye jaate hain; ise ati-shudh roop mein paane ke liye zone refining kaam aati hai. Carbon adhaatu hai tatha loha tatha aluminium dhaatuen hain tatha unmein aisa aadha-chaalak gun nahi hota, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: microchip ke liye silicon upadhaatu ka istemal hota hai - yahi dhaatu tatha adhaatu ke beech ka gun rakhne ke karan computer ka aadhar hai.

qe: What is 'Slag' in the context of iron extraction?
qh: लोहा निष्कर्षण के संदर्भ में 'धातुमल' (Slag) क्या है?
e: Loha nikaalne ki bhatti mein dhaatumaal (slag) ek pighla hua gaadha padarth hota hai jiska mukhya hissa calcium silicate (CaSiO3) hota hai; chuna patthar tatha ret ki ashuddhi kriya karke ise banate hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye gaadha loha se halka hone ke karan uske upar tairta hai tatha alag naali se nikala jaata hai, isliye drav loha saaf milta hai; iske upyog se cement tatha sadak ki neev banti hai. Shudh loha ya bhatti ki gas isse alag hote hain, isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: loha nikaalne ki bhatti ka dhaatumaal pighla hua calcium silicate (CaSiO3) hota hai - yahi loha ke upar tairkar ashuddhi ko bahar le jaata hai.

qe: Which non-metal is found in the 'Earth's Crust' in the highest percentage?
qh: पृथ्वी की पपड़ी में सर्वाधिक प्रतिशत में कौन सी अधातु पाई जाती है?
e: Prithvi ki upari parat (crust) mein sabse adhik matara oxygen ki hai (lagbhag 46 pratishat); ye hawa mein azad gas ke roop mein to hai hi, sath hi paani, mitti, patthar tatha lagbhag har oxide tatha silicate mein juda hua hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki oxygen kai tatvon ke saath aasaani se milkar sthir compound banata hai, isliye upari parat ka lagbhag aadha hissa hi yahi tatva hota hai. Silicon doosre sthan par aata hai par wo oxygen ke saath juda hota hai tatha upadhaatu hai, jabki hydrogen tatha nitrogen ki matara bahut kam hai. Exam point: prithvi ki upari parat mein sabse adhik non-metal oxygen hai - yahi paani tatha silikat khanijon ka mukhya hissa hai.

qe: Which metal reacts with 'Steam' but not with hot or cold water?
qh: कौन सी धातु 'भाप' के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करती है लेकिन गर्म या ठंडे पानी के साथ नहीं?
e: Loha dhaatu keval laal-tapt (red hot) hone par bhaap ke saath kriya karta hai tatha lauh-chumbakiya oxide (Fe3O4) banta hai sath hi hydrogen gas nikalta hai; thande tatha garam paani dono ke saath wo kriya nahi karta.
