Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki loha ki kriya-sheelata madhyam hai, isliye bhaap ki uchch urja hi uski satah par kriya shuru kar paati hai; isi karan purane bhaap engine ki boiler mein andar se jang lagne ka khatra rehta hai. Calcium tatha sodium to thande paani se hi tez kriya karte hain tatha tamba paani aur bhaap dono se nahi karta, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: loha keval bhaap (steam) ke saath kriya karta hai - yahi uchch tapman par oxide tatha hydrogen banata hai.

qe: What is 'Steel' primarily an alloy of?
qh: 'स्टील' मुख्य रूप से किसका मिश्र धातु है?
e: Sadharan steel loha (iron) tatha carbon ka mishran hota hai jismein carbon ki matara 0.1 se 1.5 pratishat tak hoti hai; carbon ki matara badhne par kathorata badhti hai tatha lachak ghatti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki carbon ke chhote aayan loha ke aayanon ke beech phans jaate hain, isliye paraten aasaani se nahi sarakti; isi karan motor ke shaft ke liye kam carbon tatha katar (drill) aur chakku ke liye adhik carbon wala steel chuna jaata hai. Tamba, tin tatha zinc steel ke mukhya ghatak nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: steel mukhya roop se loha tatha carbon ka mishran hota hai - carbon ki matara hi uski kathorata tatha lachak tay karti hai.

qe: Which metal is used as a 'Catalyst' in the hydrogenation of vegetable oils?
qh: वनस्पति तेलों के हाइड्रोजनीकरण में किस धातु का उपयोग 'उत्प्रेरक' के रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Vanaspati ghee banane ke liye telon mein hydrogen jodne ki kriya (hydrogenation) mein utprek (catalyst) ke roop mein nikal hi lagta hai; ismein tel ko lagbhag 150 se 200 degree C par hydrogen gas tatha nikal ki upasthiti mein garam kiya jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki nikal ki satah hydrogen ke anuon ko aasaani se pakad leti hai tatha unhe tel ke anuon tak pahuncha deti hai, isliye tel gaadha hokar vanaspati bana jaata hai; sasta hone ke karan yahi utprek udyog mein sabse zyada chalta hai. Zinc, loha tatha tamba is kriya ke liye itne prabhavi utprek nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: telon ke hydrogenation mein nikal utprek istemal hota hai - yahi tel ko gaadha karke vanaspati ghee banata hai.

qe: What is 'White Phosphorus' stored in?
qh: 'सफेद फास्फोरस' को किसमें संग्रहित किया जाता है?
e: Safed (white) phosphorus ko paani ke andar doobakar rakha jaata hai, kyunki uska jvalan taap (ignition temperature) keval lagbhag 30 se 34 degree C hota hai jo kamre ke tapman se bhi thoda hi adhik hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki itni kam ushma par bhi ye hawa ki oxygen se mil kar aag pakad leta hai, isliye paani ki parat ushe hawa se alag rakhkar surakshit rakhti hai; paani iske saath kriya nahi karta tatha ismein ye ghulta bhi nahi. Kerosene tatha alcohol mein rakhne par aisa bachav nahi milta, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: safed phosphorus ka bhandaran paani mein hi kiya jaata hai - iska jvalan taap kamre ke tapman se thoda hi adhik hota hai.

qe: The 'Diamond' is an allotrope of which non-metal?
qh: 'हीरा' किस अधातु का अपररूप है?
e: Heera (diamond) carbon ka ek aprarup (allotrope) hai, jismein har carbon aayan chaar anya carbon aayanon se juda hota hai tatha ek sakht chaturbhuji (tetrahedral) jaali banaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye bandhan poore dhaanche mein faila hone ke karan kisi bhi dishaa mein nahi tootta, isliye ye duniya ka sabse kathor padarth hai tatha kaanch katne wali tatha khanan ke drill ki nok isi se banti hai; anmol gehno mein yahi sabse priya maana jaata hai. Silicon, boron tatha sulfur carbon ke aprarup nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: heera carbon ka aprarup hai - iska chaar-konana bandhan ise sabse kathor padarth banata hai.

qe: Which metal is found in 'Chlorophyll' in green plants?
qh: हरे पौधों में 'क्लोरोफिल' में कौन सी धातु पाई जाती है?
e: Chlorophyll ke kendra mein magnesium (Mg) dhaatu baithi hoti hai tatha yahi use hara tatha prakash-sanshleshan ke liye saksham banati hai; paudhe ise mitti se aayanon ke roop mein lete hain tatha magnesium ki kami hone par patte peele pad jaate hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki magnesium ke aayan suraj ki urja ko aage badhane mein sahayak hote hain, isliye paudhon ke liye magnesia wali khaad ka khaas sthan hota hai. Zinc tatha calcium chlorophyll ka kendra nahi hote tatha loha haemoglobin mein hota hai, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: chlorophyll ka kendra-bindu magnesium (Mg) hota hai - isi dhaatu ke karan paudhe hara dikhte hain tatha khaana banaate hain.

qe: What is 'Monazite' sand an ore of?
qh: 'मोनाज़ाइट' रेत किसका अयस्क है?
e: Kerala ke tatiy kshetron ki ret mein pai jaane wali monazite thorium ka sabse bada srot hai; ye ek phosphate ayask hai jismein thorium ke saath durlabh mrida (rare earth) tatva bhi milte hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki thorium ek halka radio-dharmi tatva hai jise nabhik indhan ke roop mein istemal karne ki sambhavna dekhi ja rahi hai tatha pehle isse gas-laite jalne ke liye istemal hoti thi; isi karan iski ret ko rakshak bhaag mein rakhkar store kiya jaata hai. Titanium ilmenite tatha rutile se tatha uranium apne uraninite jaisi ayaskon se nikaala jaata hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: monazite ret thorium ka sabse bada srot hai - yahi bhavishya ke nabhik indhan ki drishti se mahatvapurna mana jaata hai.

qe: Which non-metal is used for 'Sterilizing' water?
qh: पानी को 'जीवाणुरहित' करने के लिए किस अधातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Nal ke paani ko jeevanu-rahit (bacteria-free) karne ke liye chlorine ka istemal hota hai; ise gas ke roop mein, bleaching powder ke roop mein ya chlorine tablet ke roop mein paani mein milaya jaata hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki chlorine paani mein milkar paida hone wale padarth ke zariye bacteria tatha kai vishaanu ko maar deta hai tatha kuchh samay tak paani mein bachaav bana rehta hai; isliye nagar-palika ke bade filter plant isi par chalte hain. Fluorine tatha iodine paani ki safai ke liye aam nahi hain tatha nitrogen snigdh hone ke karan kuchh nahi karta, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: paani ko jeevanu-rahit karne ke liye chlorine istemal hota hai - yahi bacteria ko maarkar paani ko peene yogya banata hai.

qe: Which metal is the 'Heaviest' (densest) among the following?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी धातु सबसे 'भारी' (अधिकतम घनत्व वाली) है?
e: Osmium dhaatuon mein sabse bhaari hai, jiska ghanatva (density) lagbhag 22.59 gram prati ghan centimeter (g/cm3) hota hai; isi karan iski thodi-si miqdaar bhi bahut bhaari lagti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki osmium ke aayan bahut bhaari hote hain tatha chhoti sajaavat (lattice) mein kas kar baithe rehte hain, isliye ek hi aayatan (volume) mein bahut zyada dravyaman sama jaata hai; iski kathorata ke karan fountain pen ki nok tatha bijli ke contact mein iske mishran kaam aate hain. Sisa (11.3), paara (13.6) tatha sona (19.3) isse halke hote hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: dhaatuon mein sabse zyada ghanatva osmium ka hota hai - isi karan ise sabse bhaari dhaatu kehte hain.

qe: Which alloy is used to make 'Permanent Magnets'?
qh: 'स्थायी चुंबक' बनाने के लिए किस मिश्र धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Sthayi chumbak banane ke liye alnico mishradhatu ka istemal hota hai, jismein aluminium, nikal, cobalt tatha loha milte hain; naam ke akshar hi iske ghatak batate hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki is mishran ki chumbakiyata bahut adhik rehti hai tatha hataye jaane ke baad bhi bani rehti hai, isliye speaker, mike tatha meter ki sui isi se banti hai; soft iron par chumbak lagaakar hatane par wo turant apni chumbakiyata kho deta hai. Peetal tatha kansa mein aisa gun nahi hota tatha solder keval jodne wala mishran hai, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: sthayi chumbak ke liye alnico ka istemal hota hai - ismein aluminium, nikal tatha cobalt milte hain tatha yahi chumbakiyata bani rakhta hai.

qe: The 'Anode Mud' collected during electrolytic refining of copper contains:
qh: कॉपर के विद्युत अपघटनी शोधन के दौरान एकत्रित 'एनोड मड' में क्या होता है?
o: Precious metals like Gold and Silver
e: Tamba ke vidyut apghatan ke dauran anu ke neeche jo keechad jama hota hai ushe anod mud kehte hain; ismein sona, chandi tatha platinum jaise dhaatuen hoti hain, kyunki tamba ghulne ke baad bhi yahi dhaatuen ghulti nahi. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye dhaatuen tamba se kam kriya-sheel hoti hain, isliye bijli ki dhara unhe ghula nahi paati tatha wo baareek kanon ke roop mein neeche baith jaate hain; isi anod mud se hi sona-chandi nikaal kar labh kamaya jaata hai. Aluminium oxide, loha-zinc tatha silica is keechad ka hissa nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: anod mud mein sona, chandi tatha platinum jaisi kimti dhaatuen hoti hain - isi karan copper refining ka ye keechad bahut mol-bhaav rakhta hai.

qe: The 'Green Coating' formed on Copper vessels in moist air is:
qh: नम हवा में तांबे के बर्तनों पर बनने वाली 'हरी परत' क्या है?
e: Nami, hawa tatha carbon dioxide ke milkar tamba ki satah par jo hari parat banti hai wo baseey copper carbonate [CuCO3.Cu(OH)2] hoti hai; ise patina bhi kehte hain tatha yahi barish ke paani se bache purane tamba ke sikke tatha purane mandiron ke upar dikhti hai. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki tamba hawa ki oxygen tatha CO2 ke saath dheere-dheere milkar sthir hara lavan banaata hai, isliye yahi parat aage jang nahi badhne deti; gili hawa mein kabhi hara-bhootla copper chloride bhi banta hai. Shudh copper oxide kaala-bhoora hota hai tatha copper nitrate neela hota hai, isliye wo dono is parat ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: nami wali hawa mein tamba par banne wali hari parat baseey copper carbonate hoti hai - isi ko patina kehte hain.

qe: Which non-metal is the most 'Lustrous' (shiny)?
qh: कौन सी अधातु सबसे अधिक 'चमकदार' होती है?
e: Adhaatuon mein halogen iodine hi aisa thos hai jiski satah par dhaatu jaisi chamak (lustre) dikhti hai; uske crystal suraj ki roshni mein sheeshe jaise chamakte hain. Iske peeche ki asli vajah yahi hoti hai ki iodine ke aayan sajaavat mein sahi taur par baithe hote hain tatha unke electron roshni ko paravartit karte hain, isliye yahi adhaatuon mein asadharan dikhta hai; garam karne par ye seedha bhaap ban jaata hai tatha uski bainguni bhaap jaani-pehchaani hai. Sulfur tatha phosphorus peele tatha madhyam (dull) hote hain tatha carbon kaala hai, isliye wo teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: adhaatuon mein sabse zyada chamakdar padarth iodine hai - uske thos crystal suraj ki roshni mein chamak dete hain.
